entry.title: Basic Electricity Chapter 1:PARTA Atomic Structure and Properties
entry.content:
Basic Electricity Chapter 1:PARTA Atomic Structure and Properties

Atomic Structure

  • The center of an atom contains a nucleus, which consists of positively charged protons and electrically neutral neutrons.
  • Negatively charged electrons orbit around the nucleus. For teaching purposes, different orbits are distinguished by different colors.
  • An atom is electrically neutral because the positive charge of protons in the nucleus equals and cancels out the negative charge of electrons outside the nucleus.
  • Electrons in the outermost orbit are called valence electrons, and their number determines the element’s valence in the periodic table.

Atomic Number

  • The atomic number represents the number of protons in the atomic nucleus.
  • In a neutral atom, the atomic number also equals the number of electrons outside the nucleus.
  • The periodic table is arranged according to atomic numbers.
  • Examples: Hydrogen (H) has atomic number 1, meaning it has 1 proton and 1 electron. An atom with atomic number 5 has 5 protons and 5 electrons.
  • Common element examples: Copper (Cu) has atomic number 29 (29 protons and 29 electrons), Germanium (Ge) has atomic number 32 (32 protons and 32 electrons), and Silicon (Si) has atomic number 14 (14 protons and 14 electrons).

Electron Orbital Distribution

  • Electrons outside the nucleus are distributed in different orbits in layers.
  • The maximum number of electrons each layer can hold can be calculated using the formula 2n², where n is the orbit number (n=1, 2, 3, 4…).
  • This formula is only applicable for orbits n ≤ 4.
  • The first layer (n=1), also called K shell, can hold up to 2 × (1)² = 2 electrons.
  • The second layer (n=2), also called L shell, can hold up to 2 × (2)² = 8 electrons.
  • The third layer (n=3), also called M shell, can hold up to 2 × (3)² = 18 electrons.
  • The fourth layer (n=4), also called N shell, can hold up to 2 × (4)² = 32 electrons.
  • The outermost electron layer is called the valence shell.
  • Example: Silicon (Si) has atomic number 14, with electron distribution: 2 electrons in K shell, 8 electrons in L shell, and 4 electrons in M shell. Therefore, silicon has 4 valence electrons and is a tetravalent atom.

Electric Charge and Mass

  • The unit of electric charge is Coulomb (C).
  • Electrons carry negative charge of -1.602 × 10⁻¹⁹ Coulombs.
  • Protons carry positive charge of +1.602 × 10⁻¹⁹ Coulombs. The charge magnitudes of electrons and protons are equal but opposite in sign.
  • Neutrons carry no charge (0).
  • The unit of mass is kilograms (kg).
  • Electron mass is approximately 9.107 × 10⁻³¹ kg.
  • Proton mass is approximately 1.6729 × 10⁻²⁷ kg.
  • Proton mass is much larger than electron mass, about 1840 times greater.

Summary and Recommendations

  • This lesson introduced the basic structure of atoms.
  • Students are recommended to practice drawing atomic structures of Copper (Cu), Germanium (Ge), and Silicon (Si), showing electron distribution and valence electrons, using the 2n² formula.

基本電學 第一章：PARTA 原子結構與特性

原子結構

  • 原子中心有一個原子核，原子核由帶正電荷的質子和不帶電荷的中子組成。
  • 帶負電荷的電子在原子核外的軌道上運行。為了方便講解，軌道會用不同顏色區分。
  • 原子是電中性的，因為原子核內質子的正電荷與核外電子的負電荷數量相等且互相抵消。
  • 最外層軌道的電子稱為價電子，價電子的數量決定了該元素在元素週期表上的價數。

原子序

  • 原子序代表了該原子核中的質子數量。
  • 在電中性的原子中，原子序也等於核外電子的數量。
  • 元素週期表是根據原子序排列的。
  • 例如：原子序為 1 的氫原子，其原子核中含有 1 個質子，核外也有 1 個電子。原子序為 5 的原子，其原子核中有 5 個質子，核外有 5 個電子。
  • 常見元素的原子序例子：銅 (Cu) 的原子序是 29，表示其有 29 個質子和 29 個電子；鍺 (Ge) 的原子序是 32，表示其有 32 個質子和 32 個電子；矽 (Si) 的原子序是 14，表示其有 14 個質子和 14 個電子。

原子軌道分佈

  • 核外電子是分層分佈在不同的軌道上。
  • 每個電子層能容納的最大電子數可以用公式 2n² 計算，其中 n 是軌道數目（n=1, 2, 3, 4…）。
  • 這個公式只適用於軌道數小於等於 4 的情況。
  • 第一層 (n=1) 又稱為 K 層，最多可容納 2 × (1)² = 2 個電子。
  • 第二層 (n=2) 又稱為 L 層，最多可容納 2 × (2)² = 8 個電子。
  • 第三層 (n=3) 又稱為 M 層，最多可容納 2 × (3)² = 18 個電子。
  • 第四層 (n=4) 又稱為 N 層，最多可容納 2 × (4)² = 32 個電子。
  • 最外層的電子層又稱為價層。
  • 矽 (Si) 的原子序是 14，其電子分佈為：第一層 (K) 2 個電子，第二層 (L) 8 個電子，第三層 (M) 4 個電子。因此，矽原子最外層有 4 個價電子，是四價原子。

帶電量與質量

  • 電荷的單位是庫侖 (Coulomb)。
  • 電子帶負電荷，電荷量為 -1.602 × 10⁻¹⁹ 庫侖。
  • 質子帶正電荷，電荷量為 +1.602 × 10⁻¹⁹ 庫侖。電子和質子的電荷量大小相等，符號相反。
  • 中子不帶電荷，電荷量為 0。
  • 質量的單位是公斤 (kg)。
  • 電子的質量約為 9.107 × 10⁻³¹ 公斤。
  • 質子的質量約為 1.6729 × 10⁻²⁷ 公斤。
  • 質子的質量遠大於電子的質量，約為電子的 1840 倍。

總結與建議

  • 本次課程介紹了原子的基本結構。
  • 建議同學練習繪製銅 (Cu)、鍺 (Ge) 和矽 (Si) 的原子結構圖，標示出電子分佈和價電子，並善用 2n² 公式。

entry.title: Basic Electricity Chapter 1 Introduction to Electricity
entry.content:
Basic Electricity Chapter 1: Introduction to Electricity

1-1 Characteristics of Electricity

Definition of Electricity

Electricity is a form of energy that is colorless, odorless, soundless, and formless.

During its work process, electricity does not require oxygen, making it pollution-free and environmentally friendly.

All electrical appliances in daily life rely on electrical energy to operate, such as flashlights emitting light, electric pots heating, and computers for internet access.

Formation of Electricity

Natural Formation:

  • Lightning: Accumulation of charges in the atmosphere produces discharge phenomena, as demonstrated by Franklin’s kite experiment, which led to the invention of the lightning rod.
  • Frictional Electricity: Rubbing fur against a plastic rod can generate charges that attract small pieces of paper.
  • Electrostatic Induction: Charged objects can induce charges in neutral objects, such as changing water flow direction with a rubbed plastic rod.

Artificial Formation (Power Generation Methods):

  • Hydropower: Using water flow to drive generators, a clean energy source.
  • Thermal Power: Burning coal, petroleum, and natural gas, high energy but with serious pollution.
  • Wind Power: Using wind energy to drive windmills, clean but weather-dependent.
  • Nuclear Power: Using nuclear fission, high efficiency but with radioactive pollution risks.
  • Solar Power: Converting light energy to electricity through photovoltaic effect, environmentally friendly but low efficiency.

Matter, Molecules, and Atoms

  • Matter: Something that has mass and occupies space.
  • Molecules: The smallest particles that maintain the basic properties of matter (e.g., water molecule H₂O).
  • Atoms: The basic units constituting molecules, such as H (hydrogen atom) and O (oxygen atom).

Summary

Electricity is a form of energy that can improve human life.

Understanding electricity sources (natural vs. artificial) and different power generation methods, each with its advantages and disadvantages.

Matter is composed of molecules, which are further composed of atoms, laying the foundation for learning atomic structure.

➡️ Next Lesson: Structure of Atoms

基本電學 第一章：電學概論

1-1 電的特性

電的定義

電是一種無色、無味、無聲、無形的能量。

電在做功的過程中不需要氧氣，因此無污染，符合環保需求。

日常生活中所有電器都依賴電能運行，例如：手電筒發光、電鍋加熱、電腦上網等。

電的形成

自然形成：

  • 閃電：大氣中電荷積累產生放電現象，例如富蘭克林的風箏實驗發現電可以被導引，並發明避雷針。
  • 摩擦生電：毛皮摩擦塑膠棒可產生電荷，吸引碎紙片等。
  • 靜電感應：帶電物體可使中性物體產生感應電荷，如摩擦塑膠棒可改變水流方向。

人為形成（發電方式）：

  • 水力發電：利用水流推動發電機，清潔能源。
  • 火力發電：燃燒煤、石油、天然氣，能量大但污染嚴重。
  • 風力發電：利用風能推動風車發電，清潔但受天氣影響。
  • 核能發電：利用核裂變發電，效率高但存在放射性污染風險。
  • 太陽能發電：利用光電效應轉化為電能，環保但效率低。

物質、分子與原子

  • 物質：具有質量和佔據空間的東西。
  • 分子：保持物質基本特性的最小微粒（例如水的分子 H₂O）。
  • 原子：構成分子的基本單位，例如 H（氫原子）、O（氧原子）。

總結

電是一種能量，可以改善人類生活。

了解電的來源（自然 vs. 人為），不同的發電方式各有優缺點。

物質由分子構成，分子進一步由原子組成，為後續學習原子結構打下基礎。

➡️ 下節課主題：原子的結構

entry.title: Understand electronic circuits briefly in 11 minutes electricity, circuits, resistors, capacitors, inductors, diodes, triodes, MO
entry.content:
Basic Electronics: Understanding Circuits and Components

Fundamentals of Electricity

  • Electrons are the smallest fundamental particles that constitute electricity, existing within atoms.
  • When electrons leave atoms and flow freely, they form an electric current.
  • Copper, silver, and gold are excellent conductors because they have only one electron in their outermost shell. Copper is widely used in wires due to its availability.
  • Voltage is the pressure that drives electron flow, moving from high voltage to low voltage, measured in Volts (V). Physically, it represents the energy in Joules required to move one Coulomb of charge.
  • Current is the number of charges passing per second, measured in Amperes (A). One ampere equals 6.24150934 × 10¹⁸ electrons per second.
  • Current direction is conventionally defined as the direction of positive charge flow.
  • Power (P) is energy consumed per second, calculated by P = IV (Power = Current × Voltage), measured in Watts (W).

Electric Circuits

  • A circuit is a closed loop of conductors providing a path for current to flow.
  • Kirchhoff’s laws state that the sum of currents entering a junction equals the sum leaving it, and the sum of voltage changes around any closed loop must be zero.
  • Direct Current (DC) has constant voltage magnitude and direction, like batteries.
  • Alternating Current (AC) has voltage magnitude and direction that change periodically with time, like power outlets.
  • A short circuit occurs when there’s no resistance, causing excessive current that can burn out the circuit or cause fires.

Passive Components

  • Resistance opposes current flow, measured in Ohms (Ω).
  • Ohm’s Law describes the relationship between voltage, current, and resistance: V = IR (Voltage = Current × Resistance). Higher resistance means lower current at the same voltage.
  • Resistors provide resistance, but all electronic components, including wires and power sources, have some internal resistance.
  • Capacitors store positive and negative charges under voltage, buffering voltage changes, measured in Farads (F), with formula C = Q/V (Capacitance = Charge / Voltage). They act like reservoirs for DC and conduct for AC.
  • Inductors, mainly coils, use electromagnetic induction to store and release magnetic energy, creating temporary voltage to oppose current changes, smoothing current variations. They act like water pipes with turbines for DC and form impedance for AC. They can also be used for AC voltage transformation.
  • Resistors, capacitors, and inductors are typically passive components that support other components.

Active Components

  • Active components can actively control current flow and switching, typically serving as core logic elements in electronic devices.
  • Semiconductors have properties between conductors and insulators, ideal for precise current control, primarily made of silicon (Si).
  • N-type semiconductors are doped with elements having one extra electron (like phosphorus), making them more likely to lose electrons.
  • P-type semiconductors are doped with elements having one fewer electron (like boron), making them more likely to accept electrons.
  • Diodes allow current flow in only one direction, using semiconductor PN junctions. They conduct under forward voltage and block under reverse voltage, like one-way valves.
  • Transistors use NPN or PNP arrangements, utilizing NP semiconductor concentration differences to achieve current amplification. A small base (B) current controls large current between emitter (E) and collector (C), useful for amplifying analog signals or as digital switches.
  • MOSFETs (Metal-Oxide-Semiconductor Field-Effect Transistors) control signals with voltage. Enhancement-type MOSFETs conduct between source (S) and drain (D) when voltage is applied to the gate (G); depletion-type MOSFETs are normally conductive and close the channel when voltage is applied to the gate.
  • Various logic gates can be built from active components, enabling complex computations through gate combinations.

Electronic Circuit Composition and Applications

  • Complete electronic circuits typically include power sources (heart), passive components (voltage and current stabilization), active components (brain), and input/output components.
  • Input components include switches, buttons, keyboards, variable resistors, photoresistors, thermistors, microphones, etc., for control or sensing external environments.
  • Output components include light bulbs, LEDs, speakers, motors, etc., for visual, audio, or power output.

Power Generation and Distribution

  • Mainstream power generation uses electromagnetic induction, generating current by rotating magnets with kinetic energy.
  • Solar power generation uses diode concepts, creating current when sunlight hits NP semiconductors.
  • Power is typically transmitted at high voltage to reduce losses, then stepped down through multiple stages before entering household distribution boxes.
  • Taiwanese household distribution boxes typically have +110V and -110V hot lines, 0V neutral line, and ground wire for leakage prevention.
  • 220V outlets for air conditioners use both +110V and -110V hot lines.
  • Many appliances need AC to DC conversion, commonly achieved using diode rectification and capacitor smoothing.
  • Common appliances like LED bulbs have built-in AC to DC transformers; fans control current through different inductor stages to drive motors; rice cookers and water heaters convert electrical energy to heat using heating elements.

Summary and Reflection

  • Humans manipulate electricity through simple or complex electronic circuits to produce various products, improving quality of life.
  • While enjoying the benefits of electricity, we should also be aware of its environmental impact and consider sustainable development.

十一分鐘略懂電子電路：電、電路、電阻、電容、電感、二極體、三極體、MOSFET 簡介及相關應用

電的基礎

  • 電子是構成電的最小基本粒子，在原子中存在。
  • 當電子離開原子自由流動時，形成電流。
  • 銅、銀、金因最外層只有一顆電子，容易成為良好導體，其中銅因容易取得而被廣泛使用於導線。
  • 電壓是推動電子流動的壓力，會從高電壓流向低電壓形成電流，單位是伏特 (V)，物理意義是移動每庫倫電荷所需的焦耳能量。
  • 電流是每秒通過的電荷數量，單位是安培 (A)，1 安培等於每秒通過 6.24150934 × 10¹⁸ 個電子。
  • 電流的方向通常以正電荷流的想像方向為準。
  • 功率 (P) 是每秒消耗的能量，可以透過公式 P = IV（功率 = 電流 × 電壓）計算，單位是瓦特 (W)。

電路

  • 電路是由導體組成的封閉迴路，提供電流往返的路徑。
  • 克希荷夫定律說明進入分岔點的電流總和等於離開分岔點的電流總和，且迴路的電壓升降總和必定為 0。
  • 直流電 (DC) 的電壓大小與方向固定，例如電池。
  • 交流電 (AC) 的電壓大小與方向隨時間週期性變化，例如電源插座。
  • 短路是指電路上毫無阻力導致電流過大，可能燒毀電路甚至引起火災。

被動元件

  • 電阻是阻礙電流通過的能力，單位是歐姆 (Ω)。
  • 歐姆定律描述電壓、電流和電阻之間的關係：V = IR（電壓 = 電流 × 電阻）。在相同電壓下，電阻越大電流越小。
  • 電阻器是提供電阻的元件，但任何電子元件甚至導線和電源本身也都有微小電阻。
  • 電容能在電壓帶動下儲存正負電荷，進而緩衝電壓變化，單位是法拉 (F)，公式為 C = Q/V（電容 = 電荷量 / 電壓）。對直流電而言，電容像水庫；對交流電而言，電容則像通路一樣充放電。
  • 電感主要由線圈組成，利用電磁感應儲存與釋放磁能，產生臨時電壓以抵抗電流的改變，有平滑電流變化的效果。對直流電而言，像裝有渦輪的水管；對交流電而言，則形成阻抗。電感也能用於交流電的變壓。
  • 電阻、電容、電感通常作為被動配合輔助其他元件的角色，因此稱為被動元件。

主動元件

  • 主動元件能主動控制電流的流向與開關，通常作為電器中的核心邏輯運算角色。
  • 半導體的特性介於導體和絕緣體之間，適合用來精準控制電流的通過與否，主要材料是矽 (Si)。
  • N 型半導體是摻入多一顆電子的元素（如磷），使其更容易丟失電子。
  • P 型半導體是摻入少一顆電子的元素（如硼），使其更容易吸收電子。
  • 二極體只允許電流單方向通過，利用半導體的 PN 接合實現。順向電壓導通，逆向電壓不導通，像單向水閥。
  • 三極體 (電晶體) 透過 NPN 或 PNP 的排列，利用 NP 型半導體濃度的差異來產生電流放大的效果。基極 (B) 的小電流可以控制射極 (E) 和集極 (C) 之間的大電流，可用於放大類比訊號或作為數位開關。
  • MOSFET (金屬氧化物半導體場效電晶體) 以電壓來控制訊號。增強型 MOS 在閘極 (G) 施加電壓時導通源極 (S) 和汲極 (D) 之間的通道；空乏型 MOS 原本導通，在閘極施加電壓時關閉通道。
  • 基於主動元件可以組合出各種邏輯閘，再透過邏輯閘的搭配進行複雜的運算。

電子電路的組成與應用

  • 完整的電子電路通常包含電源（心臟）、被動元件（穩定電壓與電流）、主動元件（大腦）、以及輸入與輸出元件。
  • 輸入元件例如開關、按鍵、鍵盤、可變電阻、光敏電阻、熱敏電阻、麥克風等，用於控制或感測外部環境。
  • 輸出元件例如燈泡、LED、喇叭、馬達等，用於輸出視覺、聲音或動力。

電力的生產與配送

  • 主流發電原理是電磁感應，利用動能帶動磁鐵轉動產生電流。
  • 太陽能發電利用二極體的概念，讓太陽光照射 NP 半導體產生電流。
  • 電力通常以高壓電輸送以減少損耗，再經過層層降壓後進入家戶配電箱。
  • 台灣家戶配電箱通常有 +110V、-110V 兩條火線和 0V 中性線，以及地線用於預防漏電。
  • 冷氣所需的 220V 插座會同時使用 +110V 和 -110V 的火線。
  • 許多電器需要交流電轉直流電，常見的做法是使用二極體整流，再利用電容緩衝平滑波形。
  • 常見電器如 LED 燈泡內建 AC 轉 DC 變壓器；電扇透過不同段位的電感控制電流驅動馬達；電鍋和熱水器利用加熱片將電能轉為熱能。

總結與反思

  • 人類透過簡單或複雜的電子電路來操縱電力，生產出各式各樣的產品，提升生活品質。
  • 在享受電力帶來好處的同時，也應意識到電力生產對環境的影響，並思考如何兼顧環境的永續經營。

Reference Video

entry.title: High School Basic Electricity: Current Direction and Magnitude - 高中基本電學：電流的方向與大小
entry.content:
Introduction

Understanding current direction and magnitude is fundamental to electrical engineering. This article explores the basic concepts of current flow, its direction, and how to calculate its magnitude in practical applications. We will cover both theoretical concepts and practical examples to help you better understand current in electrical circuits.

引言

理解電流的方向和大小是電機工程的基本要素。本文將探討電流流動的基本概念、方向以及如何在實際應用中計算其大小。我們將涵蓋理論概念和實際範例，幫助您更好地理解電路中的電流。

Definition of Current

Current is defined as the rate of flow of electric charge. It represents the amount of charge passing through a conductor's cross-section per unit time. This fundamental concept is essential for understanding how electricity works in circuits.

Current is measured in amperes (A)

One ampere equals one coulomb per second

Current can be either direct (DC) or alternating (AC)

電流的定義

電流被定義為電荷流動的速率。它代表單位時間內通過導體截面的電荷量。這個基本概念對於理解電路中電的工作原理至關重要。

電流以安培(A)為單位

一安培等於每秒一庫侖

電流可以是直流(DC)或交流(AC)

Direction of Current

Conventional Current

Conventional current flows from positive to negative terminal

This concept originated from Benjamin Franklin's hypothesis in the 18th century

The conventional current direction is still used in circuit analysis and schematics

This direction is opposite to the actual electron flow

Electron Flow

In reality, electrons flow from negative to positive terminal

Electron flow represents the actual movement of charge carriers

Understanding both concepts is crucial for circuit analysis

Electron flow is important for understanding semiconductor behavior

電流的方向

傳統電流

傳統電流從正極流向負極

這個概念源自18世紀班傑明・富蘭克林的假設

傳統電流方向仍用於電路分析和電路圖

這個方向與實際的電子流動方向相反

電子流動

實際上，電子從負極流向正極

電子流動代表電荷載子的實際運動

理解這兩個概念對電路分析至關重要

電子流動對於理解半導體行為很重要

Magnitude of Current

Basic Formula

The magnitude of current is calculated using the formula:

I = Q/t

Where:

I = Current in amperes (A)

Q = Charge in coulombs (C)

t = Time in seconds (s)

Important Relationships

Current is directly proportional to charge (I ∝ Q)

Current is inversely proportional to time (I ∝ 1/t)

Current can be measured using an ammeter

Current is a fundamental quantity in electrical circuits

電流的大小

基本公式

電流的大小使用以下公式計算：

I = Q/t

其中：

I = 電流，單位為安培(A)

Q = 電荷量，單位為庫侖(C)

t = 時間，單位為秒(s)

重要關係

電流與電荷量成正比 (I ∝ Q)

電流與時間成反比 (I ∝ 1/t)

電流可以用電流表測量

電流是電路中的基本量

Practical Examples

Example 1: Calculating Average Current

If 3000 coulombs of charge flow through a conductor in 5 minutes:

Time = 5 minutes = 300 seconds

Charge = 3000 coulombs

Current = 3000/300 = 10 amperes

This represents a relatively high current flow

Example 2: Battery Charging Time

For a 1750mAh battery charged at 1 ampere:

Battery capacity = 1750mAh = 1.75Ah

Charging current = 1A

Charging time = 1.75 hours

This is a typical charging scenario for mobile devices

Example 3: Household Circuit

In a typical household circuit:

Standard voltage = 110V or 220V (depending on region)

Typical current = 15-20 amperes

Power = Voltage × Current

This current rating is for safety and practical usage

實際範例

範例1：計算平均電流

如果在5分鐘內有3000庫侖的電量流過導體：

時間 = 5分鐘 = 300秒

電荷量 = 3000庫侖

電流 = 3000/300 = 10安培

這代表一個相對較高的電流

範例2：電池充電時間

對於1750mAh的電池以1安培充電：

電池容量 = 1750mAh = 1.75Ah

充電電流 = 1A

充電時間 = 1.75小時

這是移動設備的典型充電情況

範例3：家用電路

在典型的家用電路中：

標準電壓 = 110V或220V（依地區而定）

典型電流 = 15-20安培

功率 = 電壓 × 電流

這個電流額定值是基於安全和實際使用考慮

Summary

Current is the flow of electric charge through a conductor

Conventional current flows from positive to negative

Electron flow is in the opposite direction

Current magnitude is calculated using I = Q/t

Understanding current is essential for circuit analysis

總結

電流是電荷在導體中的流動

傳統電流從正極流向負極

電子流動方向與之相反

電流大小使用I = Q/t計算

理解電流對電路分析至關重要

Reference

For more details, watch the video here.

entry.title: High School Basic Electricity: Fundamental Theories of Electricity - Charge Part A - 高中基本電學：電學基礎理論 - 電荷 PART A
entry.content:
Introduction

The study of electricity begins with understanding the fundamental concept of electric charge. This article explores the historical development of charge theory and introduces key scientific contributions that shaped our understanding of electricity.

引言

電學的研究始於理解電荷的基本概念。本文探討電荷理論的歷史發展，並介紹塑造我們對電學理解的關鍵科學貢獻。

Historical Background

The understanding of electric charge has evolved through the contributions of several important scientists:

Sir Isaac Newton (1643-1727): His work on universal gravitation influenced later theories of electrical forces

Charles-Augustin de Coulomb (1736-1806): Formulated Coulomb's law describing electrical forces

John Dalton (1766-1844): Proposed atomic theory, though later modified

Robert Millikan (1868-1953): Measured the charge of a single electron

Ernest Rutherford (1871-1937): Contributed to understanding atomic structure

歷史背景

對電荷的理解通過幾位重要科學家的貢獻而發展：

艾薩克・牛頓爵士(1643-1727)：他對萬有引力的研究影響了後來的電力理論

查爾斯・奧古斯丁・庫侖(1736-1806)：提出描述電力作用的庫侖定律

約翰・道耳吞(1766-1844)：提出原子理論，後被修正

羅伯特・密利根(1868-1953)：測量單一電子的電荷

歐內斯特・拉塞福(1871-1937)：對理解原子結構做出貢獻

Basic Charge and Electric Quantity

The fundamental unit of electric charge is the coulomb (C)

One electron carries a charge of -1.6 × 10^-19 coulombs

One proton carries a charge of +1.6 × 10^-19 coulombs

The charge of an electron is equal in magnitude but opposite in sign to that of a proton

基本電荷與電量

電量的基本單位是庫侖(C)

一個電子帶有-1.6 × 10^-19庫侖的電量

一個質子帶有+1.6 × 10^-19庫侖的電量

電子的電量與質子大小相等但符號相反

Key Scientific Contributions

Newton's Law of Universal Gravitation

Influenced the development of Coulomb's law

Demonstrated the concept of action at a distance

Established mathematical relationships for forces

Coulomb's Law

Describes the force between two point charges

Like charges repel, unlike charges attract

Force is proportional to the product of charges

Force is inversely proportional to the square of distance

Dalton's Atomic Theory

Atoms are indivisible (later revised)

All atoms of an element are identical

Atoms combine in simple whole number ratios

Millikan's Oil Drop Experiment

Measured the charge of a single electron

Determined the basic charge unit

Confirmed the quantization of electric charge

關鍵科學貢獻

牛頓的萬有引力定律

影響了庫侖定律的發展

展示了超距作用的概念

建立了力的數學關係

庫侖定律

描述兩個點電荷之間的力

同性相斥，異性相吸

力與電荷乘積成正比

力與距離平方成反比

道耳吞的原子理論

原子是不可分割的（後被修正）

同一元素的所有原子都相同

原子以簡單整數比結合

密利根的油滴實驗

測量單一電子的電荷

確定了基本電荷單位

證實了電荷的量子化

Charge Calculations

Example 1: Total Charge Calculation

Calculate the total charge of 5 × 10^19 electrons:

Q = 5 × 10^19 × (-1.6 × 10^-19)

Q = -8 coulombs

The negative sign indicates excess electrons

Example 2: Number of Electrons

Calculate the number of electrons in 1 coulomb:

Number of electrons = 1 / (1.6 × 10^-19)

Number of electrons = 6.25 × 10^18

電荷計算

範例1：總電量計算

計算5 × 10^19個電子的總電量：

Q = 5 × 10^19 × (-1.6 × 10^-19)

Q = -8庫侖

負號表示過量的電子

範例2：電子數量

計算1庫侖中的電子數量：

電子數量 = 1 / (1.6 × 10^-19)

電子數量 = 6.25 × 10^18

Summary

Electric charge is a fundamental property of matter

The basic unit of charge is the coulomb

Charges interact through Coulomb's law

Understanding charge is essential for electricity

Historical experiments shaped our understanding

總結

電荷是物質的基本屬性

電量的基本單位是庫侖

電荷通過庫侖定律相互作用

理解電荷對電學至關重要

歷史實驗塑造了我們的理解

Reference

For more details, watch the video here.

entry.title: High School Basic Electricity: Characteristics of Static Charge and Example Exercises - 高中基本電學：靜電荷的特性與範例練習
entry.content:
Introduction

Static charge is a fundamental concept in electricity that helps us understand the behavior of electric charges at rest. This article explores the basic characteristics of static charge, including the concepts of electrons and coulombs, and provides practical examples to enhance understanding.

引言

靜電荷是電學中的基本概念，幫助我們理解靜止狀態下電荷的行為。本文將探討靜電荷的基本特性，包括電子和庫侖的概念，並提供實際範例以加深理解。

Basic Unit of Electric Charge

The fundamental unit of electric charge is the coulomb (C)

One electron carries a charge of -1.6 × 10^-19 coulombs

One proton carries a charge of +1.6 × 10^-19 coulombs

The charge of an electron is equal in magnitude but opposite in sign to that of a proton

電量的基本單位

電量的基本單位是庫侖(C)

一個電子帶有-1.6 × 10^-19庫侖的電量

一個質子帶有+1.6 × 10^-19庫侖的電量

電子的電量與質子大小相等但符號相反

Definition of Static Charge

Static charge refers to electric charge that is at rest

It is the accumulation of electric charge on the surface of an object

Static charge can be generated through friction, contact, or induction

The charge remains stationary until it is discharged or neutralized

靜電荷的定義

靜電荷指的是靜止不動的電荷

它是物體表面電荷的累積

靜電荷可以通過摩擦、接觸或感應產生

電荷保持靜止直到被放電或中和

Characteristics of Static Charge

Like Charges Repel

Charges of the same type repel each other

Positive charges repel other positive charges

Negative charges repel other negative charges

This is a fundamental property of electric charges

Opposite Charges Attract

Charges of different types attract each other

Positive and negative charges are attracted to each other

This attraction is the basis of many electrical phenomena

The force of attraction increases with decreasing distance

Electrostatic Induction

Neutral objects can be affected by nearby charged objects

Charges in the neutral object redistribute themselves

This creates temporary charge separation

The effect is stronger at closer distances

靜電荷的特性

同性相斥

相同類型的電荷互相排斥

正電荷排斥其他正電荷

負電荷排斥其他負電荷

這是電荷的基本特性

異性相吸

不同類型的電荷互相吸引

正電荷和負電荷互相吸引

這種吸引力是許多電學現象的基礎

吸引力隨距離減少而增加

靜電感應

中性物體會受到附近帶電物體的影響

中性物體中的電荷會重新分布

這會產生暫時的電荷分離

距離越近，效果越強

Franklin's Experiment

Benjamin Franklin conducted experiments with static electricity

He rubbed a glass rod with silk to generate static charge

The glass rod became positively charged

The silk became negatively charged

This experiment demonstrated the transfer of electrons

富蘭克林的實驗

班傑明・富蘭克林進行了靜電實驗

他通過摩擦玻璃棒和絲綢產生靜電

玻璃棒帶正電

絲綢帶負電

這個實驗展示了電子的轉移

Example Exercises

Example 1: Calculating Atomic Charge

Calculate the electric charge of an atom with 6 electrons and 3 protons:

Q = -6 × 1.6 × 10^-19 + 3 × 1.6 × 10^-19

Q = -4.8 × 10^-19 C

The atom has a net negative charge

Example 2: Charge Removal

Calculate the final charge after removing -1.5 microcoulombs:

Initial charge = -1.5 × 10^-6 C

Removed charge = -1.5 × 10^-6 C

Final charge = 0 C (neutral)

範例練習

範例1：計算原子電量

計算帶有6個電子和3個質子的原子電量：

Q = -6 × 1.6 × 10^-19 + 3 × 1.6 × 10^-19

Q = -4.8 × 10^-19 C

該原子帶有淨負電荷

範例2：電荷移除

計算移去-1.5微庫侖電荷後的帶電量：

初始電量 = -1.5 × 10^-6 C

移除電量 = -1.5 × 10^-6 C

最終電量 = 0 C（中性）

Summary

Static charge is electric charge at rest

Like charges repel, opposite charges attract

Electrostatic induction affects neutral objects

Charge can be calculated using the number of electrons and protons

Understanding static charge is fundamental to electricity

總結

靜電荷是靜止的電荷

同性相斥，異性相吸

靜電感應影響中性物體

電量可以通過電子和質子數量計算

理解靜電荷是電學的基礎

Reference

For more details, watch the video here.

entry.title: High School Basic Electricity: Voltage - 高中基本電學：電壓
entry.content:
Introduction

Voltage is one of the fundamental concepts in electricity, playing a crucial role in understanding how electrical circuits work. This article will explain voltage through everyday examples and analogies, making it easier to grasp this important concept.

引言

電壓是電學中的基本概念之一，對於理解電路運作起著至關重要的作用。本文將通過日常生活中的例子和類比來解釋電壓，使這個重要概念更容易理解。

What is Voltage?

Voltage can be understood through a simple water analogy:

  • Just as water flows from high to low levels, electricity flows from high to low voltage
  • Water pressure pushes water through pipes, voltage pushes electrons through wires
  • The greater the height difference, the stronger the water flow; similarly, the greater the voltage difference, the stronger the current

什麼是電壓？

電壓可以通過簡單的水流類比來理解：

  • 就像水從高處流向低處，電流從高電壓流向低電壓
  • 水壓推動水通過管道，電壓推動電子通過導線
  • 高度差越大，水流越強；同樣，電壓差越大，電流越強

Definition of Voltage

Voltage is defined as the energy required to move electric charges in a circuit. It is measured in volts (V) and represents the potential energy difference between two points in an electrical circuit.

電壓的定義

電壓被定義為在電路中移動電荷所需的能量。它以伏特(V)為單位，代表電路中兩點之間的電位能差。

Types of Voltage

  • Electric Potential: The potential energy at a specific point in an electric field
  • Potential Difference: The difference in electric potential between two points
  • Electromotive Force (EMF): The energy provided by a power source to move charges
  • Voltage Drop: The decrease in voltage across a component in a circuit

電壓的類型

  • 電位：電場中特定點的電位能
  • 電位差：兩點之間的電位差異
  • 電動勢：電源提供的移動電荷的能量
  • 電壓降：電路中元件兩端的電壓降低

Key Concepts

Voltage and Current Flow

Voltage is the driving force behind current flow, similar to how water pressure drives water flow. The relationship can be expressed as:

VAB = VA - VB

For example, if point A has a potential of 100V and point B has 60V:

VAB = 100V - 60V = 40V

重要概念

電壓與電流流動

電壓是推動電流流動的力量，類似於水壓推動水流動。其關係可以表示為：

VAB = VA - VB

例如，如果A點電位為100V，B點電位為60V：

VAB = 100V - 60V = 40V

Unit of Voltage

The volt (V) is the SI unit of voltage, named after Alessandro Volta, who invented the first chemical battery. One volt is defined as the potential difference that will drive one ampere of current through one ohm of resistance.

電壓的單位

伏特(V)是電壓的國際單位，以發明第一個化學電池的亞歷山大·伏特命名。一伏特被定義為能夠驅動一安培電流通過一歐姆電阻的電位差。

Reference

For more details, watch the video here.

entry.title: Atomic Theory Summary
entry.content:
Atomic Theory Summary

1. Structure of Atoms

  • Nucleus: Contains protons and neutrons.
  • Protons carry a positive charge, while neutrons are neutral.
  • Electrons: Carry a negative charge and orbit around the nucleus.

2. Atomic Number

  • Definition: The atomic number is the number of protons in an atom, which equals the number of electrons.
  • Example: Copper has an atomic number of 29, indicating 29 protons and 29 electrons.

3. Atomic Orbitals

  • Maximum electron capacity formula: (2N^2), where N is the orbital layer number.
  • First layer (K layer): Can hold up to 2 electrons.
  • Second layer (L layer): Can hold up to 8 electrons.
  • Third layer (M layer): Can hold up to 18 electrons.
  • Fourth layer: Can hold up to 32 electrons.

4. Valence Electrons

  • Definition: Valence electrons are the outermost electrons that determine the chemical properties and reactivity of an element.
  • Example: Silicon has an atomic number of 14 and 4 valence electrons, meaning it typically forms four covalent bonds in chemical reactions.

5. Charge and Mass of Particles

Particle Charge (C) Mass (kg)
Electron -1.602 × 10⁻¹⁹ 9.107 × 10⁻³¹
Proton +1.602 × 10⁻¹⁹ 1.6729 × 10⁻²⁷
Neutron 0 1.675 × 10⁻²⁷

Summary

  • Atoms are electrically neutral, as the number of protons equals the number of electrons.
  • The atomic number is a fundamental characteristic of an element that influences its chemical properties and reactivity.
  • Understanding the structure and properties of atoms is crucial for studying electricity and other scientific fields.

原子理论总结

1. 原子结构

  • 原子核: 包含质子和中子。
  • 质子带有正电荷，中子不带电。
  • 电子: 带有负电荷，围绕在原子核外的轨道上。

2. 原子序

  • 定义: 原子序是指原子中质子的数量，等于电子的数量。
  • 例子: 铜的原子序为29，表示有29个质子和29个电子。

3. 原子轨道

  • 最大电子数公式: (2N^2)，其中N为轨道层数。
  • 第一层 (K层): 最多可容纳2个电子。
  • 第二层 (L层): 最多可容纳8个电子。
  • 第三层 (M层): 最多可容纳18个电子。
  • 第四层: 最多可容纳32个电子。

4. 价电子

  • 定义: 价电子是最外层的电子，决定元素的化学性质和反应性。
  • 例子: 硅的原子序为14，价电子数为4，这意味着它在化学反应中通常会形成四个共价键。

5. 粒子的电荷和质量

粒子 电荷 (C) 质量 (kg)
电子 -1.602 × 10⁻¹⁹ 9.107 × 10⁻³¹
质子 +1.602 × 10⁻¹⁹ 1.6729 × 10⁻²⁷
中子 0 1.675 × 10⁻²⁷

总结

  • 原子是电中性的，因为质子和电子的数量相等。
  • 原子序是元素的基本特征，影响其化学性质和反应行为。
  • 理解原子的结构和性质对于学习电学及其他科学领域至关重要。

Reference

For more information, you can watch the video here.

entry.title: High School Basic Electricity: Fundamental Theories of Electricity - Current Part B - 高中基本電學：電學基礎理論 - 電流 PART B
entry.content:
Introduction

Current is a fundamental concept in electricity that describes the flow of electric charge. This article explores an alternative method for calculating current based on the physical properties of conductors and electron movement.

引言

電流是電學中的基本概念，描述電荷的流動。本文探討基於導體物理特性和電子運動的電流計算替代方法。

Current Definition and Basic Formula

Current (I) is defined as the amount of charge (Q) passing through a conductor's cross-section per unit time (t):

I = Q/t

電流定義與基本公式

電流(I)定義為單位時間(t)內通過導體截面的電荷量(Q)：

I = Q/t

Alternative Current Calculation Method

Current can also be calculated using the following formula:

I = N × A × v × e

Where:

  • N: Number of free electrons per cubic meter
  • A: Cross-sectional area of the conductor (m²)
  • v: Velocity of electron flow (m/s)
  • e: Charge of an electron (approximately 1.6 × 10^-19 coulombs)

電流計算的替代方法

電流也可以使用以下公式計算：

I = N × A × v × e

其中：

  • N：每立方公尺的自由電子數量
  • A：導體的截面積（m²）
  • v：電子的移動速率（m/s）
  • e：電子的電荷量（約1.6 × 10^-19庫侖）

Calculation Examples

Example 1: Current Calculation in Copper Wire

Given:

  • Free electron density (N) = 8.5 × 10^28 electrons/m³
  • Cross-sectional area (A) = 1 × 10^-6 m²
  • Electron velocity (v) = 0.1 mm/s

Calculate the current:

I = N × A × v × e

I = (8.5 × 10^28) × (1 × 10^-6) × (0.1 × 10^-3) × (1.6 × 10^-19)

I = 1.36 A

Example 2: Electron Velocity Calculation

Given:

  • Current (I) = 2 A
  • Free electron density (N) = 8.5 × 10^28 electrons/m³
  • Cross-sectional area (A) = 2 × 10^-6 m²

Calculate the electron velocity:

v = I / (N × A × e)

v = 2 / [(8.5 × 10^28) × (2 × 10^-6) × (1.6 × 10^-19)]

v ≈ 0.074 mm/s

計算範例

範例1：銅線中的電流計算

已知：

  • 自由電子密度(N) = 8.5 × 10^28 電子/m³
  • 截面積(A) = 1 × 10^-6 m²
  • 電子速度(v) = 0.1 mm/s

計算電流：

I = N × A × v × e

I = (8.5 × 10^28) × (1 × 10^-6) × (0.1 × 10^-3) × (1.6 × 10^-19)

I = 1.36 A

範例2：電子速度計算

已知：

  • 電流(I) = 2 A
  • 自由電子密度(N) = 8.5 × 10^28 電子/m³
  • 截面積(A) = 2 × 10^-6 m²

計算電子速度：

v = I / (N × A × e)

v = 2 / [(8.5 × 10^28) × (2 × 10^-6) × (1.6 × 10^-19)]

v ≈ 0.074 mm/s

Summary

Understanding current calculation methods is essential for electrical engineering

Both basic and alternative formulas provide valuable insights

Proper unit conversion is crucial for accurate calculations

Physical properties of conductors affect current flow

總結

理解電流計算方法對電機工程至關重要

基本公式和替代公式都提供了寶貴的見解

正確的單位轉換對準確計算至關重要

導體的物理特性影響電流流動

entry.title: Voltage Division Rule (3-4) / 分壓定則（3-4）
entry.content:
Voltage Division Rule (3-4)

Key Points

  • A voltage source ( E ) is connected to two resistors ( R_1 ) and ( R_2 ) in series.
  • According to Kirchhoff’s Voltage Law, total voltage ( E = I \times R_T ), where total resistance ( R_T = R_1 + R_2 ).
  • Total current ( I = \frac{E}{R_1 + R_2} ) (Ohm’s Law).
  • Voltage division:
    [
    V_1 = I \times R_1 = E \times \frac{R_1}{R_1 + R_2}
    ]
    [
    V_2 = I \times R_2 = E \times \frac{R_2}{R_1 + R_2}
    ]
  • Voltage division rule: Voltage across series resistors divides proportionally to their resistance; larger resistance gets higher voltage.
  • Extension: For multiple series resistors, voltage across each resistor equals the fraction of that resistor over total resistance times total voltage.

Reference Video

YouTube Video: Voltage Division Rule

分壓定則（3-4）

重點歸納

  • 電壓源 ( E ) 透過兩個串聯電阻 ( R_1 ) 和 ( R_2 ) 形成串聯迴路。
  • 根據克希荷夫電壓定律，總電壓 ( E = I \times R_T )，其中總電阻 ( R_T = R_1 + R_2 )。
  • 總電流 ( I = \frac{E}{R_1 + R_2} )（歐姆定律）。
  • 電壓分配：
    [
    V_1 = I \times R_1 = E \times \frac{R_1}{R_1 + R_2}
    ]
    [
    V_2 = I \times R_2 = E \times \frac{R_2}{R_1 + R_2}
    ]
  • 分壓定則：電壓在串聯電阻上按電阻大小比例分配，電阻越大，分得電壓越高。
  • 延伸應用：多個串聯電阻時，每個電阻的電壓降為該電阻與總電阻比值乘以總電壓。

entry.title: Y-Δ Transformation Method PART A / Y形-Δ形互換法 PART A
entry.content:
Y-Δ Transformation Method PART A: Understanding Y and Delta Configurations and Delta to Y Conversion

Key Points

  • Introduces Y (star) and Delta (Δ, pi) resistor connection types.
  • Y-connection has three resistors connected at a common point, shaped like a Y or star.
  • Delta connection forms a triangle with resistors between nodes labeled 1, 2, and 3.
  • Delta can be transformed into Y to simplify complex resistor networks.
  • Transformation formulas:
    [
    R_a = \frac{R_2 R_3}{R_1 + R_2 + R_3}, \quad R_b = \frac{R_1 R_3}{R_1 + R_2 + R_3}, \quad R_c = \frac{R_1 R_2}{R_1 + R_2 + R_3}
    ]
  • This transformation helps analyze circuits that cannot be simplified by Wheatstone bridge methods.

Reference Video

YouTube Video: Y-Δ Transformation Method

Y形-Δ形互換法 PART A：Y形與三角形的認識及Δ形化為Y形

重點歸納

  • 介紹Y形（星形）與三角形（Δ形、π形）電阻連接方式。
  • Y形是三個電阻連接於同一點，呈Y字形或星形。
  • 三角形連接是三個電阻形成三角形，端點分別標為1、2、3。
  • 三角形可轉換為Y形以簡化複雜電阻網路計算。
  • 轉換公式：
    [
    R_a = \frac{R_2 R_3}{R_1 + R_2 + R_3}, \quad R_b = \frac{R_1 R_3}{R_1 + R_2 + R_3}, \quad R_c = \frac{R_1 R_2}{R_1 + R_2 + R_3}
    ]
  • 轉換有助於解析惠斯登電橋無法簡化的電路。

entry.title: 2-5.3 How to Read Color Code Resistors / 2-5.3 色碼電阻器的判讀方法
entry.content:
2-5.3 How to Read Color Code Resistors

Key Points

Resistor Value Indication Methods

  • Resistors indicate resistance values by two methods:
    • Color code (for small resistors)
    • Numeric code (for larger resistors)

Color Code Classification

  • Color code resistors are classified by tolerance:
    • 3-band resistors (±20% tolerance)
    • 4-band resistors (±5% tolerance)
    • 5-band resistors (precision resistors)

Color Code Meaning

  • Colors represent:
    • Digits (first bands)
    • Multipliers (middle bands)
    • Tolerance (last band)
  • Example: Brown represents:
    • Digit: 1
    • Multiplier: 10¹
    • Tolerance: ±1%

Reading Color Codes

  • Reading process:
    1. First bands: represent digits
    2. Middle bands: represent multiplier
    3. Last band: represents tolerance

Numeric Code System

  • Used mainly for high-power resistors
  • Indicates:
    • Power rating
    • Resistance value
    • Tolerance

電阻值標示方法

    • 數字標示法（大體積電阻）

色碼分類

  • 色碼標示法依誤差範圍分為：
    • 三環（誤差±20%）
    • 四環（誤差±5%）
    • 五環（精密電阻）

色碼意義

  • 色碼代表：
    • 數字（前幾環）
    • 倍率（中間環）
    • 誤差（最後一環）
  • 例如：棕色代表：
    • 數字：1
    • 倍率：10¹
    • 誤差：±1%

色碼判讀方法

    1. 前幾環：代表數字
    2. 中間環：代表倍率
    3. 最後一環：代表誤差

數字標示法

entry.content:
2-5.2 Introduction and Characteristics of Common Resistors

Key Points

Resistor Selection Considerations

  • When selecting resistors, consider specifications such as rated power, tolerance, operation mode, and material.
  • Rated power: Maximum power the resistor can handle; larger size means higher power capacity.
  • Tolerance: Possible deviation in resistance value, affecting overall circuit accuracy.

Operation Modes

  • Operation modes include fixed resistors, variable resistors, and semi-variable resistors.

Fixed Resistor Types by Material

  1. Carbon Composition Resistors

    • Low cost
    • Large tolerance
    • Suitable for low power applications

  2. Carbon Film Resistors

    • Smaller tolerance
    • Low power applications

  3. Wire-wound Resistors

    • High power capacity
    • Low tolerance
    • Higher cost

  4. Cement Resistors

    • Good heat resistance
    • Suitable for high power and low tolerance applications

  5. Chip Resistors

    • Small size
    • Used in 3C products

  6. Metal Film Resistors

    • High power capacity
    • Low tolerance
    • High stability

Variable Resistors

  • Variable Resistors (VR)

    • Manually adjustable resistance
    • Commonly used for volume or light dimming

  • Semi-variable Resistors (SVR)

    • Adjusted with tools
    • Usually operated by professionals

2-5.2 常用電阻器介紹與特性解析

重點歸納

電阻器選擇考量

  • 電阻器選擇需考慮規格，包括額定功率、誤差值、工作方式與材質。
  • 額定功率：電阻器能承受的最大功率，體積越大功率越高。
  • 誤差值：電阻值的可能偏差，影響整體電路精度。

工作方式

  • 工作方式分為固定電阻、可變電阻與半固定可變電阻。

固定電阻材質分類

  1. 碳質電阻

    • 成本低
    • 誤差大
    • 適用小功率

  2. 碳膜電阻

    • 誤差較小
    • 小功率應用

  3. 線繞電阻

    • 高功率
    • 誤差小
    • 成本較高

  4. 水泥電阻

    • 耐熱性好
    • 適合高功率低誤差應用

  5. 晶片電阻

    • 體積小
    • 適用3C產品

  6. 金屬膜電阻

    • 高功率
    • 低誤差
    • 高穩定性

可變電阻

  • 可變電阻（VR）

    • 可手動調整電阻值
    • 常用於音量或燈光調節

  • 半固定可變電阻（SVR）

    • 需工具調整
    • 通常由專業人員操作

entry.title: Basic Electricity 1 - Section 3-8: Current Division Rule / 磨課師基本電學1 3-8 分流定則
entry.content:
Basic Electricity 1 - Section 3-8: Current Division Rule

Key Points

  • Current Division Rule: In parallel circuits, total current divides inversely proportional to resistance; smaller resistance branches carry larger current
  • Total Resistance Calculation: For two parallel resistors,
    [ R_T = \frac{R_1 R_2}{R_1 + R_2} ]
  • Current Division Formula:
    [ I_1 = \frac{R_2}{R_1 + R_2} I, \quad I_2 = \frac{R_1}{R_1 + R_2} I ]
  • Multiple Parallel Resistors: Current through the (n)-th resistor is
    [ I_n = \frac{R_T}{R_n} I ]
  • Example: For 30Ω and 60Ω resistors in parallel with total current 9A, currents are 6A and 3A respectively, consistent with Kirchhoff’s Current Law
  • Voltage Calculation: Voltage across parallel resistors is the same, equal to total current times total resistance

Reference Video

YouTube Video: Current Division Rule

磨課師基本電學1 3-8 分流定則

重點歸納

  • 分流定則（電流分配原理）：並聯電路中，總電流會依電阻大小分配，電阻越小的支路電流越大，電阻越大的支路電流越小
  • 總電阻計算：兩個並聯電阻的總電阻為
    [ R_T = \frac{R_1 R_2}{R_1 + R_2} ]
  • 電流分配公式：
    [ I_1 = \frac{R_2}{R_1 + R_2} I, \quad I_2 = \frac{R_1}{R_1 + R_2} I ]
  • 多個並聯電阻：第 (n) 個電阻的電流為
    [ I_n = \frac{R_T}{R_n} I ]
  • 實例計算：30歐姆和60歐姆並聯，總電流9A，分別分得6A和3A，符合克希荷夫電流定律
  • 電壓計算：並聯電阻兩端電壓相同，等於總電流乘以總電阻

entry.title: Example Problem of Current Source / 電流源範例例題解析
entry.content:
Example Problem of Current Source

Key Points

  • An ideal current source in series with a circuit maintains a fixed current equal to the source value (e.g., 10A)
  • The current through the 5-ohm resistor is 10A
  • Voltage across the resistor ( V_L = I \times R = 10A \times 5\Omega = 50V )
  • Voltage across the current source ( V_{ab} ) is calculated using Kirchhoff’s Voltage Law, resulting in 40V
  • The sum of voltage rises equals the sum of voltage drops; the current source voltage is part of the voltage drop

Reference Video

YouTube Video: Current Source Example

電流源範例例題解析

重點歸納

  • 理想電流源串聯於電路中，電流固定為電流源值（例：10A）
  • 流經5歐姆電阻的電流即為10A
  • 電阻兩端電壓 ( V_L = I \times R = 10A \times 5\Omega = 50V )
  • 電流源兩端電壓 ( V_{ab} ) 透過克希荷夫電壓定律計算，結果為40V
  • 電壓升等於電壓降總和，電流源端電壓是電壓降的一部分

entry.title: Current Source Types / 電流源類型
entry.content:
Current Source Types

Key Points

  • Current Source Classification: Two types—real current source and ideal current source
  • Real Current Source: Consists of a constant current source and a parallel internal resistance ( r ); larger ( r ) means less current through internal resistance, so load current approaches source current
  • Ideal Current Source: Internal resistance ( r \to \infty ), provides constant current regardless of load changes
  • Short Circuit Condition: When real current source terminals are shorted, output current equals source current
  • Load Current Formula:
    [ I_L = I \times \frac{r}{r + R_L} ]
  • Effect of Internal Resistance: Larger internal resistance makes load current closer to source current
  • Ideal Current Source Feature: Load current remains constant and equals source current; voltage varies with load

Reference Video

YouTube Video: Current Source Types

電流源類型

重點歸納

  • 電流源分類：分為實際電流源與理想電流源兩種
  • 實際電流源：由恆定電流源與並聯內部電阻 ( r ) 組成，內阻越大，流經內阻的電流越小，負載端電流越接近電流源電流
  • 理想電流源：內阻 ( r \to \infty )，提供固定電流，不受負載變化影響
  • 短路狀態：實際電流源短路時，外部電流等於電流源電流
  • 負載電流計算：
    [ I_L = I \times \frac{r}{r + R_L} ]
  • 內阻對負載電流影響：內阻越大，負載電流越接近電流源電流
  • 理想電流源特性：負載電流恆定等於電流源電流，電壓隨負載變化

entry.title: 2-5.6 Classification of Induced EMF / 2-5.6 應電勢的分類
entry.content:
2-5.6 Classification of Induced EMF

Key Points

Types of Induced EMF

  • Self-induced EMF:

    • Generated by magnetic flux change in a single coil
    • Occurs within the same coil
    • Important for understanding inductance

  • Mutual-induced EMF:

    • Induced in neighboring coils
    • Results from magnetic flux changes in adjacent coils
    • Basis for transformer operation

Self-induced EMF Calculation

  • Using Faraday’s law:
    $$ e = L \frac{\Delta i}{\Delta t} $$
  • Alternative method:
    • Number of turns × Change in magnetic flux
  • Key for inductance analysis

Mutual-induced EMF Calculation

  • Formula:
    $$ e_M = M \frac{\Delta i_1}{\Delta t} $$
  • Polarity determination:
    • Using Lenz’s law
    • Applying right-hand rule
  • Essential for transformer design

互感應電勢計算

entry.title: 2-5.7 Induced EMF Formula Memorization / 2-5.7 應電勢公式記憶法
entry.content:
2-5.7 Induced EMF Formula Memorization

Key Points

Formula Types

  • Two types of induced EMF formulas:
    • Self-induced EMF
    • Mutual-induced EMF
  • Both formulas are challenging to memorize

LION Formula Method

  • Basic formula: LI = NΦ
  • Divide both sides by time t
  • Results in induced EMF formula
  • Helps in understanding relationships

Memorization Techniques

  • Self-induced EMF:

    • Use “1111” mnemonic
    • L₁, i₁, N₁, Φ₁
    • All subscripts are 1

  • Mutual-induced EMF:

    • Use “1212” mnemonic
    • Involves mutual inductance M
    • Relates to N₂ and Φ₁₂

Example Applications

  • Case 1:

    • N₁ = 1000 turns
    • Magnetic flux increases 0.1 Wb/s
    • e_ab = 100V
    • Positive polarity

  • Case 2:

    • N₂ = 5000 turns
    • Coupling coefficient K = 1
    • e_cd = 500V
    • Negative polarity

Polarity Determination

  • Use Ampere’s right-hand rule
  • Direction opposes flux change
  • Determines current direction
  • Sets EMF polarity

entry.title: 2-4.4 Joule's Law and Electric Current Heat Effect / 2-4.4 焦耳定律與電流熱效應重點歸納
entry.content:
2-4.4 Joule’s Law and Electric Current Heat Effect

Key Points

  • Discoverer of Joule’s Law: British physicist James Joule (1841)
  • Electric Current Heat Effect: Heat generated by collisions of charged particles when current passes through a resistor
  • Joule’s Law Formula:
    $$ H = I^2 \times R \times t $$
    where
    • (H): Heat energy (Joule, J)
    • (I): Current (Ampere, A)
    • (R): Resistance (Ohm, Ω)
    • (t): Time (seconds, s)
  • Heat Unit Conversion:
    • 1 calorie (cal) = 4.185 Joules (J)
    • 1 Joule (J) = 0.24 calories (cal)
  • Imperial Heat Unit: 1 BTU = 252 cal = 1055 J
  • Application of Heat Calculation: Use Joule’s law to calculate heat produced by resistors, convertible to cal or BTU
  • Heat and Temperature Change Relation:
    $$ H = m \times s \times \Delta T $$
    where
    • (m): Mass (grams, g)
    • (s): Specific heat (cal/g°C)
    • (\Delta T): Temperature change (°C)

Reference Video

YouTube Video: Joule’s Law and Electric Current Heat Effect

You can enable YouTube auto-translation by turning on “Subtitles” and selecting “Auto-translate” in the video settings.

2-4.4 焦耳定律與電流熱效應重點歸納

重點歸納

  • 焦耳定律發現者：英國物理學家詹姆斯·焦耳（1841年）
  • 電流熱效應：電流通過電阻器時，帶電粒子碰撞產生熱能
  • 焦耳定律公式：
    $$ H = I^2 \times R \times t $$
    其中，
    • (H)：熱量（焦耳，J）
    • (I)：電流（安培，A）
    • (R)：電阻（歐姆，Ω）
    • (t)：時間（秒，s）
  • 熱量單位轉換：
    • 1卡（cal）= 4.185焦耳（J）
    • 1焦耳（J）= 0.24卡（cal）
  • 英制熱量單位：1 BTU = 252卡 = 1055焦耳
  • 熱量計算應用：利用焦耳定律計算電阻器產生的熱量，並可轉換成卡或BTU
  • 熱量與溫度變化關係：
    $$ H = m \times s \times \Delta T $$
    其中，
    • (m)：質量（克，g）
    • (s)：比熱（cal/g°C）
    • (\Delta T)：溫度變化（°C）

entry.title: Basic Electricity 1 - Section 3-7: Kirchhoff's Current Law / 克希荷夫電流定律（3-7）
entry.content:
Basic Electricity 1 - Section 3-7: Kirchhoff’s Current Law

Key Points

  • Kirchhoff’s Current Law (KCL): At any node in an electrical circuit, the total current entering equals the total current leaving.
  • Formula:
    $$
    \sum I_{\text{in}} = \sum I_{\text{out}}
    $$
    or algebraic sum equals zero:
    $$
    \sum I = 0
    $$
  • The algebraic sum of currents at a node (inflows positive, outflows negative) is zero.
  • Use examples to calculate currents and find unknown values.
  • In parallel circuits, node currents conserve and voltages are equal.
  • Examples include calculating currents and resistances to verify KCL.

  • 公式表示：
    $$
    \sum I_{\text{流入}} = \sum I_{\text{流出}}
    $$
    或代數和為零：
    $$
    \sum I = 0
    $$
  • 節點電流的代數和（流入為正，流出為負）等於零。
  • 透過實例計算節點電流，求出未知電流值。

entry.title: 2-5.5 Lenz's Law and Electromagnetic Induction / 2-5.5 楞次定律與電磁感應
entry.content:
2-5.5 Lenz’s Law and Electromagnetic Induction

Key Points

Lenz’s Law Fundamentals

  • Induced current creates a magnetic field that opposes the change in original magnetic flux
  • Complements Faraday’s Law by explaining EMF polarity
  • Essential for understanding electromagnetic induction phenomena

N Pole Approaching the Coil

  • Induced current creates magnetic field opposing N pole approach
  • Magnetic field direction: right to left
  • Current flows from B to A
  • EMF polarity: A positive, B negative

N Pole Moving Away from the Coil

  • Coil end forms S pole to attract N pole
  • Magnetic field direction: to the right
  • Current flows from A to B
  • EMF polarity: B positive, A negative

Practical Applications

  • Use Ampere’s Right-Hand Rule for current direction
  • Understanding through “chasing girlfriend” analogy
  • Important for electromagnetic device design

Reference Video

YouTube Video: Lenz’s Law and Electromagnetic Induction

You can enable YouTube auto-translation by turning on “Subtitles” and selecting “Auto-translate” in the video settings.

2-5.5 楞次定律與電磁感應

重點歸納

楞次定律基礎

  • 感應電流產生磁場，反抗原有磁通的變化
  • 補充法拉第定律，說明電動勢極性
  • 理解電磁感應現象的關鍵

N極靠近線圈

  • 感應電流產生磁場反抗N極接近
  • 磁場方向：由右到左
  • 電流方向：由B流入A流出
  • 電動勢極性：A正B負

N極遠離線圈

  • 線圈端產生S極吸引N極
  • 磁場方向：向右
  • 電流方向：由A流入B流出
  • 電動勢極性：B正A負

實際應用

  • 使用安培右手定則判斷電流方向
  • 透過「追女朋友」比喻理解
  • 電磁裝置設計的重要依據

entry.title: 2-4.1 Ohm's Law Practice Examples / 2-4.1 歐姆定律範例練習
entry.content:
2-4.1 Ohm’s Law Practice Examples

Summary

  • Ohm’s Law formula:
    $$ R = \frac{V}{I} $$
    Resistance (R) equals voltage (V) divided by current (I).

  • Example explanations:

    • Select points from voltage-current graph and calculate resistance using Ohm’s law.
    • Voltage difference calculation: (V_{AB} = V_A - V_B).
    • Current flows from higher to lower potential.
    • Current magnitude calculation:
      $$ I = \frac{V_{AB}}{R} $$

  • Resistor and heating wire example:

    • Heating wire resistance is 20 ohms, voltage 110V, current 5.5A.
    • When the wire length is halved, resistance halves, current doubles to 11A.
    • Increased current may cause the wire to burn out.

  • Multiple resistor current calculation:

    • Use node voltages to find voltage differences across resistors.
    • Apply the same current formula.

Reference Video

YouTube Video: Ohm’s Law Practice Examples

You can enable YouTube auto-translation by turning on “Subtitles” and selecting “Auto-translate” in the video settings.

2-4.1 歐姆定律範例練習

重點歸納

  • 歐姆定律公式：
    $$ R = \frac{V}{I} $$
    電阻 (R) 等於電壓 (V) 除以電流 (I)。

  • 例題說明：

    • 從電壓與電流圖中選點，代入歐姆定律計算電阻值。
    • 電位差計算：兩點電位差 (V_{AB} = V_A - V_B)。
    • 電流方向由高電位流向低電位。
    • 電流大小計算：
      $$ I = \frac{V_{AB}}{R} $$

  • 電阻與電熱絲例題：

    • 電熱絲電阻為20歐姆，110伏特電壓，電流為5.5安培。
    • 電熱絲長度減半，電阻減半，電流變為11安培。
    • 電流增大可能導致電熱絲燒毀。

  • 多電阻電流計算：

    • 利用節點電位差計算各電阻電流。
    • 電流計算公式同上。

entry.title: 2-4.2 Ohm's Law Summary / 2-4.2 歐姆定律重點歸納
entry.content:
2-4.2 Ohm’s Law Summary

Key Points

  • Ohm’s Law was discovered by German physicist Georg Ohm in 1862, describing the relationship between voltage (V), current (I), and resistance (R) across a resistor.
  • Applying voltage ( V ) across a resistor causes current ( I ) to flow.
  • When resistance ( R ) is constant, increasing voltage ( V ) increases current ( I ).
  • When voltage ( V ) is constant, decreasing resistance ( R ) increases current ( I ).
  • Mathematical expressions:
    • ( I = \frac{V}{R} ) (Current equals voltage divided by resistance)
    • ( R = \frac{V}{I} ) (Resistance equals voltage divided by current)
    • ( V = I \times R ) (Voltage equals current times resistance)
  • Units:
    • Voltage ( V ): Volt (V)
    • Current ( I ): Ampere (A)
    • Resistance ( R ): Ohm (Ω)
  • Voltage and current are proportional; the proportionality constant is the resistance.
  • The voltage-current graph is a straight line with slope equal to the resistance.

Reference Video

YouTube Video: Ohm’s Law Summary

You can enable YouTube auto-translation by turning on “Subtitles” and selecting “Auto-translate” in the video settings.

2-4.2 歐姆定律重點歸納

重點歸納

  • 歐姆定律由德國物理學家奧爾格·歐姆於1862年發現，描述電阻器上的電壓 (V)、電流 (I) 與電阻值 (R) 之間的關係。
  • 電阻器兩端加電壓 ( V )，會產生電流 ( I )。
  • 在電阻值 ( R ) 不變時，電壓 ( V ) 增大，電流 ( I ) 也會增大。
  • 在電壓 ( V ) 不變時，電阻 ( R ) 減小，電流 ( I ) 會增大。
  • 數學表達式：
    • ( I = \frac{V}{R} ) （電流等於電壓除以電阻）
    • ( R = \frac{V}{I} ) （電阻等於電壓除以電流）
    • ( V = I \times R ) （電壓等於電流乘以電阻）
  • 單位：
    • 電壓 ( V )：伏特 (Volt, V)
    • 電流 ( I )：安培 (Ampere, A)
    • 電阻 ( R )：歐姆 (Ohm, Ω)
  • 電壓與電流成正比，比例常數即為電阻值。
  • 電壓-電流關係圖為一條斜率為電阻值的直線。

entry.title: Application Examples of Parallel Circuits (3-9) / 並聯電路應用實例（3-9）
entry.content:
Application Examples of Parallel Circuits (3-9)

Key Points

  • Ammeter Structure: Composed of a galvanometer and internal resistance RA in series; the lower the internal resistance, the better, ideally zero
  • Current Measurement: The ammeter must be connected in series with the component being measured
  • Multiplier (Shunt Resistor): To extend the ammeter’s measuring range, a low-resistance resistor RS is connected in parallel, called a shunt resistor
  • Multiplier Formula:
    [ n = \frac{I_T}{I_A} = 1 + \frac{R_A}{R_S} ]
  • Shunt Resistor Calculation:
    [ R_S = \frac{R_A}{n - 1} ]
  • Examples:
    • Ammeter full scale 10mA, internal resistance 50Ω, to measure 1A, parallel a 0.5Ω shunt resistor
    • If RS is 1/9 of RA, the measuring range is extended 10 times
  • Parallel Appliances Rated Voltage Judgment:
    • Appliances with matching rated voltage work normally (e.g., computer, refrigerator at 110V)
    • Appliances with rated voltage lower than supply voltage will be damaged (e.g., 24V intercom connected to 110V)
    • Appliances with rated voltage higher than supply voltage cannot operate properly (e.g., 220V air conditioner connected to 110V)

Reference Video

YouTube Video: Application Examples of Parallel Circuits

並聯電路應用實例（3-9）

重點歸納

  • 電流表結構：由檢流計與內電阻RA串聯組成，內電阻越低越好，理想為零
  • 測量電流：電流表必須與被測元件串聯
  • 倍增器（分流器）：為擴大電流表測量範圍，並聯一個低阻值電阻RS，稱為分流器
  • 倍增率公式：
    [ n = \frac{I_T}{I_A} = 1 + \frac{R_A}{R_S} ]
  • 分流器電阻計算：
    [ R_S = \frac{R_A}{n - 1} ]
  • 實例：
    • 電流表滿刻度10mA，內阻50Ω，要測量1A，需並聯0.5Ω分流器
    • 若RS是RA的1/9，測量範圍擴大為10倍
  • 並聯電器額定電壓判斷：
    • 額定電壓相符可正常工作（如電腦、冰箱110V）
    • 額定電壓低於供電電壓會燒毀（如24V對講機接110V）
    • 額定電壓高於供電電壓無法正常運作（如220V冷氣接110V）

entry.title: Application Examples of Parallel Circuits (3-9) / 並聯電路應用實例（3-9）
entry.content:
Application Examples of Parallel Circuits (3-9)

Key Points

  • Ammeter Structure: Composed of a galvanometer and internal resistance RA in series; the lower the internal resistance, the better, ideally zero
  • Current Measurement: The ammeter must be connected in series with the component being measured
  • Multiplier (Shunt Resistor): To extend the ammeter’s measuring range, a low-resistance resistor RS is connected in parallel, called a shunt resistor
  • Multiplier Formula:
    [ n = \frac{I_T}{I_A} = 1 + \frac{R_A}{R_S} ]
  • Shunt Resistor Calculation:
    [ R_S = \frac{R_A}{n - 1} ]
  • Examples:
    • Ammeter full scale 10mA, internal resistance 50Ω, to measure 1A, parallel a 0.5Ω shunt resistor
    • If RS is 1/9 of RA, the measuring range is extended 10 times
  • Parallel Appliances Rated Voltage Judgment:
    • Appliances with matching rated voltage work normally (e.g., computer, refrigerator at 110V)
    • Appliances with rated voltage lower than supply voltage will be damaged (e.g., 24V intercom connected to 110V)
    • Appliances with rated voltage higher than supply voltage cannot operate properly (e.g., 220V air conditioner connected to 110V)

Reference Video

YouTube Video: Parallel Circuit Applications

並聯電路應用實例（3-9）

重點歸納

  • 電流表結構：由檢流計與內電阻RA串聯組成，內電阻越低越好，理想為零
  • 測量電流：電流表必須與被測元件串聯
  • 倍增器（分流器）：為擴大電流表測量範圍，並聯一個低阻值電阻RS，稱為分流器
  • 倍增率公式：
    [ n = \frac{I_T}{I_A} = 1 + \frac{R_A}{R_S} ]
  • 分流器電阻計算：
    [ R_S = \frac{R_A}{n - 1} ]
  • 實例：
    • 電流表滿刻度10mA，內阻50Ω，要測量1A，需並聯0.5Ω分流器
    • 若RS是RA的1/9，測量範圍擴大為10倍
  • 並聯電器額定電壓判斷：
    • 額定電壓相符可正常工作（如電腦、冰箱110V）
    • 額定電壓低於供電電壓會燒毀（如24V對講機接110V）
    • 額定電壓高於供電電壓無法正常運作（如220V冷氣接110V）

entry.title: Basic Electricity 1 - Parallel Circuit Definition and Characteristics / 並聯電路定義及特性
entry.content:
Basic Electricity 1 - Parallel Circuit Definition and Characteristics

Key Points

  1. Definition: A parallel circuit consists of two or more components, where one end of each component is connected together and the other end is also connected together.
  2. Characteristics:
    • Equal Voltage: The voltage across all components is the same.
    • Independence: If one component fails, it does not affect the operation of other components.
    • Total Resistance: The formula for total resistance ( R_T ) is:
      $$
      \frac{1}{R_T} = \frac{1}{R_1} + \frac{1}{R_2} + \cdots + \frac{1}{R_n}
      $$
    • Conductance: The total conductance ( G_T ) is the sum of the conductances of each branch.

Reference Video

YouTube Video: Parallel Circuit Definition and Characteristics

You can enable YouTube auto-translation by turning on “Subtitles” and selecting “Auto-translate” in the video settings.

並聯電路定義及特性

重點歸納

  1. 定義：並聯電路由兩個或以上元件組成，所有元件的一端相連，另一端也相連。
  2. 特性：
    • 電壓相等：所有元件的電壓相同。
    • 獨立性：某一元件斷路不影響其他元件的運作。
    • 總電阻：總電阻 ( R_T ) 計算公式為：
      $$
      \frac{1}{R_T} = \frac{1}{R_1} + \frac{1}{R_2} + \cdots + \frac{1}{R_n}
      $$
    • 電導：總電導 ( G_T ) 為各支路電導之和。

entry.title: 2-5.8 RC Charging Circuit Transient Characteristics / 2-5.8 RC充電電路暫態特性與時間常數
entry.content:
2-5.8 RC Charging Circuit Transient Characteristics

Key Points

RC Circuit Structure

  • Capacitor and resistor in series
  • Charging starts when switch closes
  • Basic configuration for transient analysis

Initial Conditions

  • At switch closure:
    • Capacitor acts as short circuit
    • Voltage across capacitor = 0
    • Maximum current: (I_{\max} = \frac{E}{R})

Charging Process

  • Capacitor voltage (V_C(t)) increases over time
  • Resistor voltage (V_R(t)) decreases over time
  • Current (i(t)) decreases over time
  • Exponential relationship in all changes

Fully Charged State

  • Capacitor voltage equals source voltage (E)
  • Resistor voltage becomes 0
  • Current becomes 0
  • Circuit behaves as open circuit

Time Constant (\tau)

  • Defined as: ( \tau = R \times C )
  • Benchmark for transient duration
  • Larger (\tau) = longer charging time
  • Smaller (\tau) = shorter charging time

Reference Video

YouTube Video: RC Charging Circuit Transient Characteristics

You can enable YouTube auto-translation by turning on “Subtitles” and selecting “Auto-translate” in the video settings.

2-5.8 RC充電電路暫態特性與時間常數

重點歸納

RC充電電路結構

  • 電容器與電阻串聯
  • 開關閉合時開始充電
  • 暫態分析的基本配置

瞬間特性

  • 開關剛閉合時：
    • 電容器等效短路
    • 電容兩端電壓為0
    • 電流最大：(I_{\max} = \frac{E}{R})

充電過程

  • 電容電壓 (V_C(t)) 隨時間增加
  • 電阻電壓 (V_R(t)) 隨時間減少
  • 電流 (i(t)) 隨時間減少
  • 所有變化呈指數關係

充飽狀態

  • 電容電壓達到電源電壓 (E)
  • 電阻兩端電壓為0
  • 電流為0
  • 電路呈斷路狀態

時間常數 (\tau)

  • 定義為：( \tau = R \times C )
  • 表示暫態持續時間的基準
  • 時間常數越大，充電時間越長
  • 時間常數越小，充電時間越短

entry.title: 2-5.9 RC Charging Circuit Transient Current Formula / 2-5.9 RC充電電路暫態電流公式解析
entry.content:
2-5.9 RC Charging Circuit Transient Current Formula

Key Points

Initial Conditions

  • Capacitor connected to DC circuit
  • Switch S closed
  • Initial capacitor voltage = 0
  • Maximum current: ( i(0) = \frac{E}{R} )

Circuit Analysis

  • Following Kirchhoff’s voltage law:
    [
    E = V_R(t) + V_C(t)
    ]
  • Voltage relationships:
    • Resistor voltage: ( V_R(t) = i(t) \times R )
    • Capacitor voltage: ( V_C(t) = \frac{Q(t)}{C} )
    • Charge: ( Q(t) = \int i(t) dt )

Current Formula

  • Derived differential equation solution:
    [
    i(t) = \frac{E}{R} e^{-\frac{t}{RC}}
    ]
  • Formula components:
    • ( \frac{E}{R} ): Initial current at switch closure
    • ( t ): Time
    • ( RC ): Time constant
    • ( e ): Euler’s number (~2.71828)

Time Characteristics

  • Current decays exponentially
  • Approaches zero at ( 5 \times RC )
  • Circuit stabilizes at full charge

Common Exponential Values

  • ( e^{-1} = 0.368 )
  • ( e^{-2} = 0.135 )
  • ( e^{-3} = 0.05 )
  • ( e^{-4} = 0.018 )
  • ( e^{-5} \approx 0 )

Reference Video

YouTube Video: RC Charging Circuit Transient Current Formula

You can enable YouTube auto-translation by turning on “Subtitles” and selecting “Auto-translate” in the video settings.

2-5.9 RC充電電路暫態電流公式解析

重點歸納

初始條件

  • 電容器接入直流電路
  • 開關S閉合
  • 電容器初始電壓為0
  • 電流最大值：( i(0) = \frac{E}{R} )

電路分析

  • 根據克希荷夫電壓定理：
    [
    E = V_R(t) + V_C(t)
    ]
  • 電壓關係：
    • 電阻電壓：( V_R(t) = i(t) \times R )
    • 電容電壓：( V_C(t) = \frac{Q(t)}{C} )
    • 電量：( Q(t) = \int i(t) dt )

電流公式

  • 微分方程解：
    [
    i(t) = \frac{E}{R} e^{-\frac{t}{RC}}
    ]
  • 公式組成：
    • ( \frac{E}{R} )：開關閉合瞬間的初始電流
    • ( t )：時間
    • ( RC )：時間常數
    • ( e )：自然指數（約2.71828）

時間特性

  • 電流呈指數衰減
  • 約在 ( 5 \times RC ) 時趨近於0
  • 電容充電完成，電路穩定

常用自然指數值

  • ( e^{-1} = 0.368 )
  • ( e^{-2} = 0.135 )
  • ( e^{-3} = 0.05 )
  • ( e^{-4} = 0.018 )
  • ( e^{-5} \approx 0 )

entry.title: 2-5.10 RC Charging Circuit Transient Formula Review / 2-5.10 RC充電電路暫態公式複習
entry.content:
2-5.10 RC Charging Circuit Transient Formula Review

Key Points

Transient Changes

  • In RC charging circuit:
    • Resistor voltage changes
    • Capacitor voltage changes
    • Circuit current changes
  • All changes are time-dependent

Mathematical Description

  • Changes described by formulas
  • Natural exponential function: ( e^{-\frac{t}{RC}} )
  • Time constant: ( \tau = RC )

Voltage and Current Formulas

  • Capacitor voltage ( V_C(t) ):

    • Increases over time
    • Formula: ( 1 - e^{-\frac{t}{RC}} )

  • Resistor voltage ( V_R(t) ):

    • Decreases over time
    • Formula: ( e^{-\frac{t}{RC}} )

  • Circuit current ( i(t) ):

    • Decreases over time
    • Formula: ( e^{-\frac{t}{RC}} )

Time Characteristics

  • Time constant ( \tau = RC )
  • Transient disappears at ( 5\tau )
  • Circuit reaches steady state

2-5.10 RC充電電路暫態公式複習

重點歸納

暫態變化

  • RC充電電路中：
    • 電阻兩端電壓變化
    • 電容兩端電壓變化
    • 迴路電流變化
  • 所有變化都與時間相關

數學描述

  • 變化可用數學公式描述
  • 自然指數函數：( e^{-\frac{t}{RC}} )
  • 時間常數：( \tau = RC )

電壓與電流公式

  • 電容電壓 ( V_C(t) )：

    • 隨時間增加
    • 公式：( 1 - e^{-\frac{t}{RC}} )

  • 電阻電壓 ( V_R(t) )：

    • 隨時間減少
    • 公式：( e^{-\frac{t}{RC}} )

  • 迴路電流 ( i(t) )：

    • 隨時間減少
    • 公式：( e^{-\frac{t}{RC}} )

時間特性

  • 時間常數 ( \tau = RC )
  • 約在 ( 5\tau ) 時暫態消失
  • 電路進入穩定狀態

entry.title: 2-5.1 Resistance Temperature Coefficient Examples / 2-5.1 電阻溫度係數範例練習
entry.content:
2-5.1 Resistance Temperature Coefficient Examples

Key Points

  1. Definition of Temperature Coefficient of Resistance (TCR)
    The TCR (α) represents the fractional change in resistance per degree Celsius increase in temperature, calculated by:
    $$
    \alpha_{t1} = \frac{R_2 - R_1}{(t_2 - t_1) R_1}
    $$
    where (R_1) and (R_2) are the resistances at temperatures (t_1) and (t_2) respectively.

  2. Example Calculations

    • At 20°C, resistance is 2Ω; at 220°C, resistance is 4Ω; TCR at 20°C is 0.005.
    • Resistance at other temperatures can be found by:
      $$
      R_2 = R_1 \times [1 + \alpha_{t1} (t_2 - t_1)]
      $$
      For example, resistance at 200°C is 3.8Ω.

  3. Positive Temperature Coefficient
    Resistance increases with temperature, known as positive temperature coefficient.

  4. TCR Variation at High Temperatures
    Use a modified formula to calculate TCR at high temperatures (e.g., 2500°C).

  5. Copper Wire Resistance Calculation
    Calculate resistance at different temperatures using copper’s absolute temperature property.

Reference Video

YouTube Video: Resistance Temperature Coefficient Examples

You can enable YouTube auto-translation by turning on “Subtitles” and selecting “Auto-translate” in the video settings.

2-5.1 電阻溫度係數範例練習

重點歸納

  1. 電阻溫度係數定義
    電阻溫度係數（α）表示溫度每升高1°C時，電阻值增加的比例，計算公式為：
    $$
    \alpha_{t1} = \frac{R_2 - R_1}{(t_2 - t_1) R_1}
    $$
    其中，(R_1)和(R_2)分別是溫度(t_1)和(t_2)時的電阻值。

  2. 範例計算

    • 例題中，20°C時電阻為2Ω，220°C時電阻為4Ω，計算20°C時的電阻溫度係數為0.005。
    • 利用電阻溫度係數計算其他溫度下的電阻值，公式為：
      $$
      R_2 = R_1 \times [1 + \alpha_{t1} (t_2 - t_1)]
      $$
      例如，計算200°C時的電阻值為3.8Ω。

  3. 正溫度係數特性
    電阻隨溫度升高而增加，稱為正溫度係數。

  4. 高溫下電阻溫度係數變化
    利用變形公式計算高溫（如2500°C）時的電阻溫度係數。

  5. 銅線電阻計算
    利用銅的絕對溫度特性計算不同溫度下的電阻值。

entry.title: 3-5 Examples of Series Circuit Applications / 3-5 串聯電路應用實例
entry.content:
3-5 Examples of Series Circuit Applications

Key Points Summary

  • Voltmeter and Multiplier: The voltmeter measures a fixed voltage; adding a series multiplier resistor extends the measurement range.
  • Multiplier Principle: Series resistors adjust voltage division, allowing the voltmeter to measure higher voltages.
  • Multiplier Ratio Calculation: The multiplier ratio is the ratio of total measured voltage ( V_T ) to the voltmeter’s original voltage ( V_V ).
  • Example Calculation:
    • To measure 100V with a 10V full-scale voltmeter, a 9KΩ resistor is connected in series.
    • Multi-range voltmeters (10V, 100V, 250V) use different series resistors (9.9KΩ, 90KΩ, 150KΩ) to achieve measurement.
  • Ammeter Multiplier: Similar to the voltmeter, series resistors extend the measurement range.
  • Role of Series Resistors: Solve the problem of limited measurement range by voltage division.

Reference Video

YouTube Video: Series Circuit Applications

You can enable YouTube auto-translation by turning on “Subtitles” and selecting “Auto-translate” in the video settings.

3-5 串聯電路應用實例

重點歸納

  • 電壓表與倍增器：電壓表量測固定電壓，串聯倍增器（電阻）可擴大量測範圍。
  • 倍增器原理：串聯電阻調整電壓分壓，讓電壓表能量測更高電壓。
  • 倍增率計算：倍增率 = 待測總電壓 VT 與電壓表原始量測電壓 VV 的比值。
  • 實例計算：
    • 量測100伏特時，10伏特滿刻度電壓表需串聯9K歐姆電阻。
    • 多範圍電壓表（10V、100V、250V）透過串聯不同電阻（9.9K、90K、150K歐姆）達成量測。
  • 安培表倍增器：類似電壓表，透過串聯電阻擴大量測範圍。
  • 串聯電阻的作用：解決量測範圍不足的問題，透過分壓原理實現。

entry.title: 2-4.3 Series and Parallel Circuits / 2-4.3 串並聯電路與電路組成基本型態
entry.content:
2-4.3 Series and Parallel Circuits

Key Points Summary

  • Basic Circuit Components:

    • Power source: supplies energy
    • Wires: medium to transfer energy
    • Load: consumes energy, mainly resistive loads (inductive and capacitive loads introduced later)

  • Current Flow Conditions:

    • Closed circuit (conducting path): energy flows normally
    • Open circuit: switch open or load damaged, no current flow
    • Short circuit: load terminals connected by a short wire, current bypasses load

  • Example Problems:

    • Example 1: Calculate current in closed circuit using Ohm’s law ( I = \frac{V}{R} )
    • Example 2: Current is zero in open circuit
    • Example 3: Large current in short circuit, no current through load

  • Overcurrent Protector:

    • Disconnects circuit when current is too high to prevent wire overheating and fire

2-4.3 串並聯電路與電路組成基本型態

重點歸納

  • 電路基本組成：

    • 電源：提供能量
    • 導線：傳遞能量的媒介
    • 負載：消耗能量，主要以電阻性負載為主（後續章節介紹電感性與電容性負載）

  • 電流流通情形：

    • 通路：形成封閉迴路，能量正常傳遞
    • 斷路：開關開啟或負載燒毀，電流無法通過
    • 短路：負載兩端被短路線接通，電流走無阻路徑，負載無電流通過

  • 例題說明：

    • 例題一：通路中電流計算，使用歐姆定律 ( I = \frac{V}{R} )
    • 例題二：斷路時電流為零
    • 例題三：短路時電流大，負載無電流

  • 過電流保護器：

    • 當電流過大時，保護器會斷開電路，防止導線過熱走火

entry.title: Conversion Between Voltage Source and Current Source / 電壓源與電流源的互換
entry.content:
Conversion Between Voltage Source and Current Source

Key Points

  • Voltage source model: voltage ( E ) in series with internal resistance ( r )
  • Current source model: current ( I ) in parallel with internal resistance ( r )
  • Equivalence condition: internal resistance ( r ) is the same
  • Conversion formulas:
    [
    I = \frac{E}{r}, \quad E = I \times r
    ]
  • Ideal voltage source has zero internal resistance; ideal current source has infinite internal resistance; they cannot be converted in these ideal cases
  • Example calculations:
    • Voltage source to current source: ( I = \frac{E}{r} )
    • Current source to voltage source: ( E = I \times r )
  • Conversion helps simplify circuit analysis in practical applications

Reference Video

YouTube Video: Source Conversion

電壓源與電流源的互換

重點歸納

  • 電壓源模型：外加電壓 ( E ) 串聯內電阻 ( r )
  • 電流源模型：電流 ( I ) 並聯內電阻 ( r )
  • 兩者等效條件：內阻 ( r ) 相等
  • 互換關係：
    [
    I = \frac{E}{r}, \quad E = I \times r
    ]
  • 理想電壓源內阻為0，理想電流源內阻趨近無限大，無法互換
  • 範例計算：
    • 電壓源轉電流源：( I = \frac{E}{r} )
    • 電流源轉電壓源：( E = I \times r )
  • 實際應用中可用互換簡化電路計算

entry.title: Conversion Between Voltage Source and Current Source / 電壓源與電流源的互換
entry.content:
Conversion Between Voltage Source and Current Source

Key Points

  • Voltage source model: voltage ( E ) in series with internal resistance ( r )
  • Current source model: current ( I ) in parallel with internal resistance ( r )
  • Equivalence condition: internal resistance ( r ) is the same
  • Conversion formulas:
    [
    I = \frac{E}{r}, \quad E = I \times r
    ]
  • Ideal voltage source has zero internal resistance; ideal current source has infinite internal resistance; they cannot be converted in these ideal cases
  • Example calculations:
    • Voltage source to current source: ( I = \frac{E}{r} )
    • Current source to voltage source: ( E = I \times r )
  • Conversion helps simplify circuit analysis in practical applications

Reference Video

YouTube Video: Source Conversion

電壓源與電流源的互換

重點歸納

  • 電壓源模型：外加電壓 ( E ) 串聯內電阻 ( r )
  • 電流源模型：電流 ( I ) 並聯內電阻 ( r )
  • 兩者等效條件：內阻 ( r ) 相等
  • 互換關係：
    [
    I = \frac{E}{r}, \quad E = I \times r
    ]
  • 理想電壓源內阻為0，理想電流源內阻趨近無限大，無法互換
  • 範例計算：
    • 電壓源轉電流源：( I = \frac{E}{r} )
    • 電流源轉電壓源：( E = I \times r )
  • 實際應用中可用互換簡化電路計算

entry.title: Basic Introduction to Voltage and Current Sources / 電壓源及電流源基礎介紹
entry.content:
Basic Introduction to Voltage and Current Sources

Key Points

  • Power Source Classification: Divided into voltage sources and current sources, which can be equivalently transformed
  • Real Voltage Source: Composed of a fixed electromotive force (E) in series with an internal resistance (r)
  • Ideal Voltage Source: Has zero internal resistance (r=0), providing a constant output voltage regardless of load current
  • Load Effect: When connected to a load, terminal voltage (V_L = E - Ir), current (I = \frac{E}{r + R_L})
  • Internal Resistance Effect: The smaller the internal resistance, the closer the terminal voltage is to (E), stabilizing the load voltage
  • Example Calculations:
    • Open-circuit load: terminal voltage equals electromotive force (E)
    • Load of 20 ohms: calculate current and terminal voltage, demonstrating voltage drop across internal resistance
  • Parameter Back-Calculation: Use different load and terminal voltage data to solve for (E) and (r)
  • Conclusion: An ideal voltage source should have low internal resistance to maintain stable load voltage

Reference Video

YouTube Video: Basic Introduction to Voltage and Current Sources

電壓源及電流源基礎介紹

重點歸納

  • 電源分類：分為電壓源與電流源，兩者可互相等效轉換
  • 實際電壓源：由固定電動勢 (E) 與內部電阻 (r) 串聯組成
  • 理想電壓源：內阻 (r=0)，輸出電壓固定不變，與負載電流無關
  • 負載影響：連接負載時，端電壓 (V_L = E - Ir)，電流 (I = \frac{E}{r + R_L})
  • 內阻影響：內阻越小，端電壓越接近電動勢 (E)，負載端電壓越穩定
  • 範例計算：
    • 負載為開路時，端電壓等於電動勢 (E)
    • 負載為20歐姆時，計算電流與端電壓，示範內阻電壓降
  • 反求電壓源參數：透過不同負載與端電壓數據反推 (E) 與 (r)
  • 結論：理想電壓源應具備低內阻特性，確保負載端電壓穩定

entry.title: Ideal and Practical Voltage Sources / 理想電壓源與實際電壓源
entry.content:
Ideal and Practical Voltage Sources

Key Points

  • Ideal Voltage Source: Internal resistance ( r = 0 ), provides a fixed voltage at the load regardless of current changes
  • Load Voltage: Load voltage ( V_L ) always equals the source voltage ( E )
  • Practical Example: A 1.5V dry cell maintains 1.5V across different loads
  • Load Resistance Effect: Changing load resistance ( R_L ) adjusts current ( I ), voltage remains constant
  • Example Calculations:
    • ( V_{ab} = 12V ) (ideal voltage source voltage)
    • ( I_1 = \frac{12V}{6\Omega} = 2A )
    • ( V_1 = 12V - 4V = 8V )
    • ( I_2 = \frac{8V}{2\Omega} = 4A )

Reference Video

YouTube Video: Ideal and Practical Voltage Sources

理想電壓源與實際電壓源

重點歸納

  • 理想電壓源：內阻 ( r = 0 )，提供負載端固定電壓，不受電流變化影響
  • 負載端電壓：負載端電壓 ( V_L ) 始終等於電壓源電壓 ( E )
  • 實際例子：1.5V 乾電池，接不同負載，電壓仍維持1.5V
  • 負載電阻影響：調整負載電阻 ( R_L ) 可改變電流 ( I )，電壓不變
  • 範例計算：
    • ( V_{ab} = 12V )（理想電壓源電壓）
    • ( I_1 = \frac{12V}{6\Omega} = 2A )
    • ( V_1 = 12V - 4V = 8V )
    • ( I_2 = \frac{8V}{2\Omega} = 4A )

Key Points

  • Wheatstone bridge is used to measure unknown resistor ( R_s ).
  • Bridge balance condition: galvanometer reads zero, meaning the product of opposite resistors are equal.
  • At balance, use the formula ( R_1 \times R_x = R_2 \times R_3 ) to find the unknown resistor.
  • The middle resistor can be considered open circuit at balance, simplifying to series-parallel circuits.
  • Example calculates unknown resistor ( R_s = 3 \Omega ).
  • Use balance condition to identify bridge structure and calculate terminal resistance ( R_{ab} ).

entry.title: Introduction and Application Highlights of the Wheatstone Bridge / 惠斯登電橋介紹與應用重點
entry.content:
Introduction and Application Highlights of the Wheatstone Bridge

Key Points

  • Function: Used to measure an unknown resistor (RX).
  • Main Components:
    • RX: Unknown resistor
    • Rs: Variable resistor for adjustment
    • G: Galvanometer (current meter)
  • Bridge Balance Condition: The bridge is balanced when the galvanometer shows zero current.
  • Resistance Relationship at Balance:
    $$
    R_X = \frac{R_2}{R_1} \times R_s
    $$
  • Equivalent Circuit: At balance, the galvanometer current is zero, voltages at two points are equal, and the middle bridge is effectively open.
  • Application: By adjusting Rs to balance the bridge, the unknown resistance can be precisely measured.

Reference Video

YouTube Video: Introduction to Wheatstone Bridge

惠斯登電橋介紹與應用重點

重點歸納

  • 惠斯登電橋功能：用於測量未知電阻值（RX）。
  • 主要元件：
    • RX：待測電阻
    • Rs：可變電阻，用於調整
    • G：檢流計（電流表）
  • 電橋平衡條件：當檢流計指示電流為0時，電橋達到平衡。
  • 平衡時的電阻關係式：
    $$
    R_X = \frac{R_2}{R_1} \times R_s
    $$
  • 等效電路：平衡時檢流計電流為0，兩點電壓相等，電橋中間點可視為開路。
  • 應用：透過調整Rs使電橋平衡，精確測量未知電阻。

entry.title: Summary of Energy and Work
entry.content:
Summary of Energy and Work

1. Definitions of Energy and Work

English:

  • Energy: The capacity of matter to do work.
  • Work: The process of energy transformation, measured in joules (J).

中文:

  • 能量: 物质做功的能力。
  • 功: 能量的转化过程，单位为焦耳 (J)。

2. Work Calculation

English:

  • Work formula:
    [
    W = F \times S
    ]
    • W: Work (Joules)
    • F: Applied force (Newtons)
    • S: Displacement (meters)

中文:

  • 功的公式：
    [
    W = F \times S
    ]
    • W：功 (焦耳)
    • F：施加的力 (牛顿)
    • S：位移 (米)

3. Example Illustrations

English:

  • Pushing a Handcart:

    • Applying 20 Newtons of force to move 4 meters.
    • Work = 20 N × 4 m = 80 J.

  • Diving Athlete:

    • Weight of 60 kg, potential energy calculation:
      [
      F = m \times g = 60 , \text{kg} \times 9.8 , \text{m/s}^2 = 588 , \text{N}
      ]
    • Work done climbing 5 meters:
      [
      W = F \times h = 588 , \text{N} \times 5 , \text{m} = 2940 , \text{J}
      ]
    • During the dive, potential energy converts to kinetic energy.

中文:

  • 推手推车：

    • 施加20牛顿的力，推动4米。
    • 功 = 20 N × 4 m = 80 J。

  • 跳水选手：

    • 重60公斤，位能计算：
      [
      F = m \times g = 60 , \text{kg} \times 9.8 , \text{m/s}^2 = 588 , \text{N}
      ]
    • 爬升5米的功：
      [
      W = F \times h = 588 , \text{N} \times 5 , \text{m} = 2940 , \text{J}
      ]
    • 跳水时，位能转化为动能。

4. Energy Conversion

English:

  • Electrical energy powers technological products, such as electric cars and televisions, improving human life.

中文:

  • 电能可以驱动科技产品，例如电动汽车和电视，改善人类生活。

entry.title: High School Basic Electricity: Conductance and Conductance Coefficient - 高中基本電學：電導與電導係數
entry.content:
Introduction

This article introduces the fundamental concepts of conductance and conductance coefficient, including their definitions, mathematical relationships, and the factors that affect conductance in materials.

Key Points

  1. Definition of Conductance:
    Conductance describes the ability of a material to allow charged particles to flow, which is the opposite of resistance.
  2. Relationship Between Conductance and Resistance:
    Conductance \( G \) and resistance \( R \) are reciprocals:
    $$ G = \frac{1}{R} $$
    Conductance formula:
    $$ G = \gamma \cdot \frac{A}{L} $$
    Where \( \gamma \) is the conductance coefficient, \( A \) is the cross-sectional area, and \( L \) is the length of the object.
  3. Factors Affecting Conductance:
    Conductance Coefficient (\( \gamma \)): The conductivity of the material.
    Length of the Object (\( L \)): Longer lengths result in lower conductance.
    Cross-sectional Area (\( A \)): Larger areas result in higher conductance.
  4. Percentage Conductance Coefficient:
    Used to compare the conductivity of materials against standard copper.

引言

本文介紹電導與電導係數的基本概念，包括其定義、數學關係以及影響材料電導的因素。

重點歸納

  1. 電導的定義：
    電導是描述物體允許帶電粒子流動的能力，與電阻相反。
  2. 電導與電阻的關係：
    電導 \( G \) 與電阻 \( R \) 互為倒數：
    $$ G = \frac{1}{R} $$
    電導公式：
    $$ G = \gamma \cdot \frac{A}{L} $$
    其中，\( \gamma \) 是電導係數，\( A \) 是截面積，\( L \) 是物體長度。
  3. 影響電導的因素：
    電導係數（\( \gamma \)）：材質的導電能力。
    物體長度（\( L \)）：長度越長，電導越小。
    截面積（\( A \)）：截面積越大，電導越大。
  4. 百分率電導係數：
    用於比較材料的導電能力，以標準韌銅為基準。

Reference

entry.title: High School Basic Electricity: Parallel Combination of Inductors (Without Mutual Inductance, With Mutual Inductance) - 高中基本電學：電感器並聯組合(無互感、互感)
entry.content:
Introduction

This article introduces the calculation methods for parallel combinations of inductors, including both cases without mutual inductance and with mutual inductance. It also explains how the direction of mutual inductance (assisting or opposing) affects the total inductance.

引言

本文介紹電感器並聯組合的計算方法，包含無互感與有互感兩種情況，並說明互感方向（互助或互消）對總電感量的影響。

Key Points

  1. Parallel Inductors Without Mutual Inductance:
    The formula is similar to parallel resistors:
    $$L_T = \frac{L_1 \times L_2}{L_1 + L_2}$$
  2. Parallel Inductors With Mutual Inductance:
    Determine if the mutual effect is assisting (same magnetic field direction) or opposing (opposite magnetic field direction).
    The formula is:
    $$L_T = \frac{L_1 L_2 - M^2}{L_1 + L_2 \mp 2M}$$
    Use minus sign (−2M) for assisting mutual inductance (larger total inductance).
    Use plus sign (+2M) for opposing mutual inductance (smaller total inductance).

重點歸納

  1. 無互感並聯電感：
    計算公式與電阻並聯相似：
    $$L_T = \frac{L_1 \times L_2}{L_1 + L_2}$$
  2. 有互感並聯電感：
    需判斷互感是互助（磁場方向相同）或互消（磁場方向相反）。
    公式：
    $$L_T = \frac{L_1 L_2 - M^2}{L_1 + L_2 \mp 2M}$$
    互助取負號（−2M），電感量較大。
    互消取正號（+2M），電感量較小。

Reference

entry.title: High School Basic Electricity: Inductance and Electromagnetism - Inductors in Series (Without and With Mutual Inductance) - 高中基本電學：電感與電磁_電感量_PART F 電感器串聯組合(無互感、有互感)_陳政旭
entry.content:
Introduction

This article summarizes the calculation of total inductance for inductors in series, both without and with mutual inductance. It explains the difference between series aiding and series opposing, and how to use the dot convention to determine the polarity of coils.

引言

本文整理電感器串聯組合的總電感量計算，包含無互感與有互感的情況，說明串聯互助與互消的差異，以及如何利用打點法則判斷線圈極性。

Key Points

  1. Inductors in Series without Mutual Inductance:
    The total inductance is the sum of the individual inductances:
    $$L_{total} = L_1 + L_2$$
  2. Inductors in Series with Mutual Inductance:
    It is necessary to determine whether the mutual inductance is aiding or opposing.
    Series Aiding (Mutual Inductance Aiding):
    The magnetic fields have the same direction, so the mutual inductance is positive.
    $$L_{total} = L_1 + L_2 + 2M$$
    Series Opposing (Mutual Inductance Opposing):
    The magnetic fields have opposite directions, so the mutual inductance is negative.
    $$L_{total} = L_1 + L_2 - 2M$$
  3. Marking Polarity (N-dot Convention):
    Use dots to indicate the polarity (N-pole direction) of the coils to determine whether the mutual inductance is aiding or opposing.

重點歸納

  1. 無互感串聯電感：
    總電感量為各電感相加：
    $$L_{total} = L_1 + L_2$$
  2. 有互感串聯電感：
    需判斷互助（助磁）或互消（消磁）。
    串聯互助：
    磁場方向相同，互感為正。
    $$L_{total} = L_1 + L_2 + 2M$$
    串聯互消：
    磁場方向相反，互感為負。
    $$L_{total} = L_1 + L_2 - 2M$$
  3. 標示N極方向（打點法則）：
    用點標示線圈N極方向，判斷互助或互消。

Reference
