entry.title: High School Basic Electricity: Inductance and Electromagnetism - Inductance Part G Example: Series Inductance Calculation Without and With Mutual Inductance - 高中基本電學：電感與電磁_電感量_PART G 範例：不考慮互感的串聯總電感運算、考慮互感的串聯總電感運算_陳政旭
entry.content:
Introduction

This article explains how to calculate the total inductance of inductors in series, both without and with mutual inductance. It also covers the effect of mutual aiding and opposing (magnetic flux direction) on the total inductance.

引言

本文說明如何計算串聯電感的總電感量，包含不考慮互感與考慮互感的情況，並介紹互助與互消（磁力線方向）對總電感的影響。

Key Points

  1. Series Inductance without Mutual Inductance:
    Total inductance is the sum of each inductance, similar to resistors in series.
    $$L_{total} = L_1 + L_2 + L_3$$
  2. Series Inductance with Mutual Inductance:
    For three inductors (L_1, L_2, L_3) in series with mutual inductances (M_{12}, M_{23}, M_{31}):
    Mutual aiding (same magnetic field direction) uses addition; mutual opposing uses subtraction.
    Total inductance formula:
    $$L_{total} = L_1 + L_2 + L_3 \pm 2M_{12} \pm 2M_{23} \pm 2M_{31}$$
  3. Example Calculations:
    Without mutual inductance: 12H + 4H + 6H = 22H.
    With mutual inductance: Determine aiding or opposing by magnetic flux direction, then calculate using the formula.

重點歸納

  1. 不考慮互感的串聯電感計算：
    總電感為各電感直接相加，類似電阻串聯計算。
    $$L_{total} = L_1 + L_2 + L_3$$
  2. 考慮互感的串聯電感計算：
    三個電感 (L_1, L_2, L_3) 串聯，考慮互感 (M_{12}, M_{23}, M_{31})。
    互助（磁力線方向相同）取加號，互消（磁力線方向相反）取減號。
    總電感公式：
    $$L_{total} = L_1 + L_2 + L_3 \pm 2M_{12} \pm 2M_{23} \pm 2M_{31}$$
  3. 範例計算：
    不考慮互感：12H + 4H + 6H = 22H。
    考慮互感：根據磁力線方向判斷互助或互消，代入公式計算。

entry.title: High School Basic Electricity: Inductance and Electromagnetism - Inductance Part I Example: Parallel Inductance Calculation - 高中基本電學：電感與電磁_電感量_PART I 範例：並聯總電感的運算
entry.content:
Introduction

This article explains how to calculate the total inductance of parallel inductors, both with and without considering mutual inductance. It also discusses the effect of the dot convention on mutual inductance in parallel circuits.

引言

本文說明如何計算並聯電感的總電感量，包含不考慮與考慮互感的情況，並介紹互感方向（打點法則）對並聯電感計算的影響。

Key Points

  1. Parallel Inductance Calculation (Ignoring Mutual Inductance):
    $$L_{total} = \frac{L_1 \times L_2}{L_1 + L_2}$$
    Example: For L1=20mH and L2=30mH, total inductance is 12mH.
  2. Parallel Inductance Calculation (Considering Mutual Inductance):
    $$L_{total} = \frac{L_1 \times L_2 - M^2}{L_1 + L_2 - 2M}$$
    Example: For L1=8H, L2=2H, and M=2H, total inductance is 2H.
  3. Mutual Inductance Direction (Dot Convention):
    The direction of mutual inductance (dot convention) affects the calculation. Head-to-head and tail-to-tail with dots in the same direction is mutual assistance in parallel.

重點歸納

  1. 並聯電感計算（不考慮互感）：
    $$L_{total} = \frac{L_1 \times L_2}{L_1 + L_2}$$
    例：L1=20mH，L2=30mH，總電感為12mH。
  2. 並聯電感計算（考慮互感）：
    $$L_{total} = \frac{L_1 \times L_2 - M^2}{L_1 + L_2 - 2M}$$
    例：L1=8H，L2=2H，M=2H，總電感為2H。
  3. 互感方向（打點法則）：
    互感方向（打點法則）會影響計算，頭接頭尾接尾且打點同向屬於互助並聯。

entry.title: High School Basic Electricity: Parallel Circuits - 高中基本電學：並聯電路
entry.content:
Introduction

This article explores the fundamental concepts of parallel circuits, including their definition, characteristics, and mathematical relationships. Understanding parallel circuits is essential for analyzing complex electrical systems and designing efficient circuits.

引言

本文探討並聯電路的基本概念，包括其定義、特性以及數學關係。理解並聯電路對於分析複雜電氣系統和設計高效電路至關重要。

Key Points

Parallel Circuit Definition and Characteristics

  1. Definition:
    A parallel circuit consists of two or more components, where one end of each component is connected together and the other end is also connected together.
  2. Characteristics:
    Equal Voltage: The voltage across all components is the same.
    Independence: If one component fails, it does not affect the operation of other components.
    Total Resistance: The formula for total resistance ( R_T ) is:
    $$\frac{1}{R_T} = \frac{1}{R_1} + \frac{1}{R_2} + \cdots + \frac{1}{R_n}$$
    Conductance: The total conductance ( G_T ) is the sum of the conductances of each branch.

重點歸納

並聯電路定義及特性

  1. 定義：
    並聯電路由兩個或以上元件組成，所有元件的一端相連，另一端也相連。
  2. 特性：
    電壓相等：所有元件的電壓相同。
    獨立性：某一元件斷路不影響其他元件的運作。
    總電阻：總電阻 ( R_T ) 計算公式為：
    $$\frac{1}{R_T} = \frac{1}{R_1} + \frac{1}{R_2} + \cdots + \frac{1}{R_n}$$
    電導：總電導 ( G_T ) 為各支路電導之和。

entry.title: High School Basic Electricity: Fundamental Theories of Electricity - Power Part A - 高中基本電學：電學基礎理論 - 電功率 PART A
entry.content:
Title & Introduction Outline

Title: High School Basic Electricity: Basic Theory of Electricity - Power Part A: Power, Horsepower, Electric Power, Examples

  • Power
  • Horsepower
  • Electric Power
  • Examples

Key Points

  1. Power
    Definition: The work done or energy used per unit time.
    Formula: $P = \frac{W}{t}$
    Unit: Watt (W)
  2. Horsepower
    Definition: The power required to lift a 76 kg weight by 1 meter in 1 second.
    Unit: Horsepower (hp)
    Conversion: 1 hp = 746 W
  3. Electric Power
    Definition: The product of voltage and current in a circuit.
    Formula: $P = VI$
    Unit: Watt (W)
  4. Examples
    • Example 1: A lamp has a potential difference of 12 V and a current of 5 A. What is the power consumed?
      $P = VI = 12 \times 5 = 60\,W$
    • Example 2: A prime mover lifts a 1000 N weight by 20 m in 4 seconds. What is the output power and its horsepower?
      Work $W = FS = 1000 \times 20 = 20,000\,J$
      Power $P = \frac{W}{t} = \frac{20,000}{4} = 5,000\,W = 5\,kW$
      Horsepower $= \frac{5,000}{746} \approx 6.7\,hp$

Vocabulary

  • Power
  • Horsepower
  • Electric Power
  • Watt

標題與前言大綱

標題：高中基本電學_電學基礎理論_電功率_PART A 功率、馬力、電功率、範例

  • 功率
  • 馬力
  • 電功率
  • 範例

詳細重點統整

  1. 功率
    定義：單位時間內所做的功或能量。
    公式：$P = \frac{W}{t}$
    單位：瓦特 (Watt, W)
  2. 馬力
    定義：一匹馬在1秒鐘內將76公斤的重物提高1公尺。
    單位：馬力 (Horsepower, hp)
    換算：1 hp = 746 W
  3. 電功率
    定義：電路中電壓和電流的乘積。
    公式：$P = VI$
    單位：瓦特 (Watt, W)
  4. 範例
    • 範例一：電燈兩端的電位差12伏特，流過電燈的電流5安培，消耗功率多少瓦特？
      $P = VI = 12 \times 5 = 60\,W$
    • 範例二：有一個原動機在4秒鐘將1000牛頓的重物提高20公尺，輸出功率多少瓦還有它的馬力是多少？
      做功 $W = FS = 1000 \times 20 = 20,000\,J$
      功率 $P = \frac{W}{t} = \frac{20,000}{4} = 5,000\,W = 5\,kW$
      馬力 $= \frac{5,000}{746} \approx 6.7\,hp$

英文翻譯

  • 功率: Power
  • 馬力: Horsepower
  • 電功率: Electric Power
  • 瓦特: Watt

entry.title: High School Basic Electricity: Fundamental Theories of Electricity - Power Part B - 高中基本電學：電學基礎理論 - 電功率 PART B
entry.content:
Introduction

This lesson, taught by Mr. Chen Zhengxu, introduces the concepts of electric energy and kilowatt-hour (kWh), including practical calculation examples.

課程簡介

高中基本電學_電學基礎理論_電功率_PART B 電能與電度，由陳政旭老師主講，主要介紹電能與電度的概念。

Key Points

  • Meaning of Electric Energy: Electric energy is the energy consumed by an electrical appliance with power P (watts) over t seconds.
    Formula: $W = P \cdot t$, unit: joule (J).
  • Kilowatt-Hour (kWh): kWh is the unit used by power companies to measure electric energy. 1 kWh = the energy consumed by a 1000-watt appliance used for 1 hour.
  • Conversion between Electric Energy and kWh: 1 kWh = $3.6 \times 10^6$ joules.

Examples

  • Example 1: How much energy (in joules) does a 4000-watt motor consume in 30 minutes?
    $W = 4000 \cdot (30 \cdot 60) = 7.2 \times 10^6$ J
  • Example 2: Calculating a household's daily electricity cost.
    Total usage: 6 kWh.
    Total cost: $6 \cdot 3 = 18$ NTD/day.
    30-day total: $18 \cdot 30 = 540$ NTD.

Vocabulary

  • Electric Energy
  • Electricity Degree or Kilowatt-Hour (kWh)
  • Electric Power

影片重點統整

  • 電能的涵義：電能是功率為P瓦特的電器用品，使用t秒鐘所消耗的能量。
    公式：$W = P \cdot t$，單位為焦耳。
  • 電度：電度是電力公司對電能的計算方式。1度電 = 1000瓦的功率的電器用品，使用1個小時所消耗的電能。
  • 電能與電度的換算：1度電 = $3.6 \times 10^6$焦耳。

範例

  • 範例一：4000瓦的電動機運轉30分鐘，共消耗電能多少焦耳？
    $W = 4000 \cdot (30 \cdot 60) = 7.2 \times 10^6$焦耳。
  • 範例二：某家庭每日用電量計算，總共要付多少電費？
    總用電量：6度電。
    總電費：$6 \cdot 3 = 18$元/天。
    30天總電費：$18 \cdot 30 = 540$元。

英文翻譯

  • 電能：Electric Energy
  • 電度：Electricity Degree or Kilowatt-Hour (kWh)
  • 電功率：Electric Power

entry.title: High School Basic Electricity: Fundamental Theories of Electricity - Power Part C - 高中基本電學：電學基礎理論 - 電功率 PART C
entry.content:
Introduction

This lesson covers the concept of efficiency in electrical power, including its definition, formula, and practical examples. Understanding efficiency is crucial for analyzing energy conversion systems and optimizing performance.

Key Points

  • Efficiency Definition: Efficiency is defined as the ratio of output energy to input energy, expressed as a percentage.
  • Efficiency Formula: Efficiency = (Output Energy / Input Energy) × 100%
  • Energy Conversion System: An energy conversion system can consist of multiple subsystems connected in series, with the overall efficiency being the product of the efficiencies of the individual subsystems.

Example Analysis

  • Example 1: A water pump motor with an input power of 880 watts and an efficiency of 0.85, find output power and loss power.
  • Example 2: A power system consisting of two subsystems with efficiencies of 0.8 and 0.9, find the overall efficiency and output energy.

前言

本課程介紹電功率中的效率概念，包括定義、公式與實際範例。理解效率對於分析能量轉換系統與提升效能至關重要。

詳細重點統整

  • 效率的定義：效率是指輸出能量與輸入能量的比值，以百分率表示。
  • 效率公式：效率 = (輸出能量 / 輸入能量) × 100%
  • 能量轉換系統：能量轉換系統可以由多個子系統串接而成，總效率為各子系統效率的乘積。

範例解析

  • 範例一：抽水馬達輸入功率 880 瓦，效率 0.85，求輸出功率和損失功率。
  • 範例二：電力系統由兩個子系統組成，效率分別為 0.8 和 0.9，求總效率和輸出能量。

entry.content:
Introduction

This article demonstrates a practical example of calculating the resistance of a copper wire, showing the step-by-step process of applying the resistance formula and unit conversions.

引言

本文展示了一個計算銅線電阻的實際範例，說明如何應用電阻公式和進行單位轉換的步驟。

Key Points

  1. Problem Background:
    Example: Calculate the resistance of a copper wire that is 2 kilometers long and has a cross-sectional area of 14 square millimeters.
  2. Parameter Identification:
    Length \( L = 2000 \, \text{m} \) (converted from kilometers)
    Cross-sectional area \( A = 14 \times 10^{-6} \, \text{m}^2 \) (converted from square millimeters)
    Resistivity of copper \( \rho = 1.724 \times 10^{-8} \, \Omega \cdot \text{m} \)
  3. Resistance Formula:
    Using the formula \( R = \frac{\rho L}{A} \)
    Calculated resistance \( R = 2.463 \, \Omega \)
  4. Unit Conversion:
    Ensure all parameters are in MKS units (meters, kilograms, seconds).

重點歸納

  1. 題目背景：
    例題：計算一條長2公里、截面積14平方公釐的銅線電阻。
  2. 參數標示：
    長度 \( L = 2000 \, \text{m} \)（轉換自公里）
    截面積 \( A = 14 \times 10^{-6} \, \text{m}^2 \)（轉換自平方公釐）
    銅的電阻係數 \( \rho = 1.724 \times 10^{-8} \, \Omega \cdot \text{m} \)
  3. 電阻公式：
    使用公式 \( R = \frac{\rho L}{A} \)
    計算得出電阻 \( R = 2.463 \, \Omega \)
  4. 單位轉換：
    確保所有參數使用MKS制（米、公斤、秒）。

entry.title: High School Basic Electricity: Resistance and Resistivity - 高中基本電學：電阻與電阻係數
entry.content:
Introduction

This article explores the fundamental concepts of electrical resistance and resistivity, including their definitions, mathematical relationships, and practical applications in electrical engineering.

引言

本文探討電阻與電阻係數的基本概念，包括其定義、數學關係以及在電氣工程中的實際應用。

Key Points

  1. Definition of Resistance:
    Resistance is the opposition encountered by electric current flowing through a material, measured in Ohms (Ω).
  2. Factors Affecting Resistance:
    Resistivity (ρ): The resistance capability of different materials.
    Length (L): Longer lengths result in higher resistance.
    Cross-sectional Area (A): Larger areas lead to lower resistance.
  3. Mathematical Formula:
    The formula for calculating resistance is:
    $$R = \frac{\rho \cdot L}{A}$$
    Where R is resistance, ρ is resistivity, L is length, and A is cross-sectional area.
  4. Relationship Between Resistance and Conductance:
    Conductance is the reciprocal of resistance, indicating the ability to conduct electricity.
  5. Practical Applications:
    Engineers use resistors to control current in circuits, ensuring stable operation.

重點歸納

  1. 電阻的定義：
    電阻是電流在物體中流動時所遇到的阻力，單位為歐姆（Ω）。
  2. 電阻的影響因素：
    電阻係數（ρ）：不同材質的電阻能力。
    物體長度（L）：長度越長，電阻越大。
    截面積（A）：截面積越大，電阻越小。
  3. 數學公式：
    電阻的計算公式為：
    $$R = \frac{\rho \cdot L}{A}$$
    其中，R為電阻，ρ為電阻係數，L為長度，A為截面積。
  4. 電阻與電導的關係：
    電導是電阻的倒數，表示導電能力。
  5. 實際應用：
    工程師利用電阻來控制電路中的電流，確保穩定操作。

entry.content:

This article introduces the fundamental concepts of magnetism, including magnet types, magnetic poles, and the characteristics of magnetic fields and field lines.

本文介紹磁學的基本概念，包括磁鐵類型、磁極以及磁場和磁力線的特性。

Key Points 重點歸納

English

  • Introduction to Magnets

    • Magnets attract iron objects
    • Two types: natural and artificial
    • Essential in electromagnetism

  • Magnet Poles

    • North (N) pole: usually red
    • South (S) pole: black or dark blue
    • Clear visual identification

  • Magnet Characteristics

    • Strongest magnetic force at poles
    • N pole points to Earth’s magnetic north
    • S pole points to Earth’s magnetic south
    • Poles always exist in pairs
    • Like poles repel, opposite poles attract

  • Magnetic Field and Field Lines

    • Field: space where magnetic forces act
    • Lines run from N to S pole
    • Form closed loops
    • Perpendicular to magnet surface
    • Never cross each other
    • Density indicates field strength
    • Tangent shows field direction

中文

  • 磁鐵介紹

    • 能吸引鐵器
    • 分為天然和人造兩種
    • 電磁學基礎元件

  • 磁極標示

    • 北極（N）：通常為紅色
    • 南極（S）：黑色或深藍色

  • 磁鐵特性

    • 兩端磁性最強
    • N極指向地磁北極
    • S極指向地磁南極
    • 磁極總是成對出現
    • 同性相斥，異性相吸

entry.title: Charged Particle Motion in Magnetic Fields: Force and Trajectory Analysis - 電荷在磁場中運動的受力與運動軌跡解析
entry.content:
Introduction 引言

This article explores the fundamental principles of charged particle motion in magnetic fields, including the Lorentz force, trajectory analysis, and practical applications.

本文探討電荷在磁場中運動的基本原理，包括洛倫茲力、運動軌跡分析以及實際應用。

Key Points 重點歸納

1. Lorentz Force and Direction 洛倫茲力與方向

  • A charged particle moving in a magnetic field experiences the Lorentz force, whose direction is determined by Fleming’s left-hand rule.

  • The direction of positive charge movement is the current direction; with the magnetic field directed into the plane, the force is perpendicular to both velocity and magnetic field.

  • 電荷在磁場中運動時會受到洛倫茲力作用，力的方向可用佛萊明左手定則判斷。

  • 正電荷運動方向為電流方向，磁場方向垂直紙面射入，受力方向垂直於速度與磁場方向。

2. Circular Motion 圓周運動

  • Positive charges undergo counterclockwise circular motion in the magnetic field, while negative charges move clockwise.

  • The force magnitude is given by ( F = B Q v ), where ( B ) is magnetic flux density, ( Q ) is charge, and ( v ) is velocity.

  • 電荷在磁場中會做逆時針圓周運動（正電荷），負電荷則為順時針圓周運動。

  • 受力大小公式為 ( F = B Q v )，其中 ( B ) 是磁通密度，( Q ) 是電荷量，( v ) 是速度。

3. Practical Applications 實際應用

  • This principle is applied in CRT displays to control electron beam deflection.

  • The understanding of charged particle motion in magnetic fields is crucial for various technologies including particle accelerators and mass spectrometers.

  • 此原理應用於CRT顯示器中控制電子束的偏轉。

  • 理解電荷在磁場中的運動對於粒子加速器和質譜儀等各種技術至關重要。

entry.title: Introduction to Coulomb's Magnetic Force Law and Magnetic Field Intensity - 庫侖磁力定律與磁場強度介紹
entry.content:
Introduction

This article explains Coulomb’s magnetic force law and its relationship with magnetic field intensity, including the mathematical formulas and practical applications in electromagnetism.

Key Points

  • Basic Concepts

    • Coulomb’s magnetic force law is analogous to Newton’s law of universal gravitation

    • Magnetic force magnitude is proportional to the product of magnetic pole strengths

    • Force is inversely proportional to the square of the distance

    • Magnetic force formula:
      $$ F = K \frac{M_1 M_2}{d^2} $$
      where:

      • F: magnetic force
      • M₁, M₂: magnetic pole strengths
      • d: distance between poles
      • K: magnetic force constant

    • Magnetic pole strength unit is Weber (Wb)

    • Magnetic force constant in air/vacuum: K = 6.33 × 10⁴ (includes Henry)

  • Magnetic Field Intensity (H)

    • Magnetic field intensity is force per unit magnetic pole:
      $$ H = \frac{F}{m} $$
      where:

      • F: force
      • m: magnetic pole strength

    • Magnetic field intensity is a vector quantity

    • Direction follows magnetic field line tangent

Reference Video

Understanding Coulomb’s Magnetic Law（Please select subtitle settings on the video page and choose auto-translate to your preferred language）

引言

本文解釋庫侖磁力定律及其與磁場強度的關係，包括數學公式和電磁學中的實際應用。

重點歸納

  • 基本概念

    • 庫侖磁力定律類似牛頓萬有引力定律

    • 磁力大小與磁極強度成正比

    • 磁力與距離平方成反比

    • 磁力公式：
      $$ F = K \frac{M_1 M_2}{d^2} $$
      其中：

      • F：磁力
      • M₁, M₂：磁極強度
      • d：磁極間距離
      • K：磁力常數

    • 磁極強度單位為韋伯（Wb）

    • 空氣或真空中磁力常數：K = 6.33 × 10⁴（含亨利）

  • 磁場強度（H）

    • 磁場強度定義為單位磁極受力：
      $$ H = \frac{F}{m} $$
      其中：

      • F：受力
      • m：磁極強度

    • 磁場強度為向量

    • 方向為磁力線切線方向

entry.title: Analysis of Coupling Coefficient, Self-Inductance, and Mutual Inductance Relationships - 耦合係數、自感與互感關係式解析
entry.content:
Introduction 引言

This article analyzes the relationships between coupling coefficient, self-inductance, and mutual inductance in electromagnetic systems. It explains the fundamental concepts and mathematical relationships that govern these interactions.

本文分析電磁系統中耦合係數、自感和互感之間的關係。內容解釋這些相互作用的基本概念和數學關係。

Key Points 重點歸納

1. Coupling Coefficient 耦合係數

  • Coupling coefficient K:

    • Represents the magnetic coupling efficiency between two coils
    • Ranges from 0 to 1
    • Closer to 1 indicates better coupling

  • 耦合係數K：

    • 表示兩線圈間磁通的導磁效率
    • 範圍為0到1
    • 越接近1表示耦合越好

2. Coupling Efficiencies 耦合效率

  • K1 and K2:

    • K1: Magnetic coupling efficiency from coil 1 to coil 2
    • K2: Magnetic coupling efficiency from coil 2 to coil 1
    • K1 = K2 in practice

  • K1與K2：

    • K1：線圈1對線圈2磁通的導磁效率
    • K2：線圈2對線圈1的導磁效率
    • 實際應用中K1 = K2

3. Magnetic Flux 磁通量

  • Magnetic flux relationships:

    • Φ12: Magnetic flux from coil 1 affecting coil 2
    • Φ21: Magnetic flux from coil 2 affecting coil 1

  • 磁通關係：

    • Φ12：線圈1產生影響線圈2的磁通
    • Φ21：線圈2影響線圈1的磁通

4. Self-Inductance 自感量

  • Self-inductance values:

    • L1: Inductance of coil 1
    • L2: Inductance of coil 2

  • 自感量：

    • L1：線圈1的電感量
    • L2：線圈2的電感量

5. Mutual Inductance 互感量

  • Mutual inductance formula:
    [
    M = K \sqrt{L_1 L_2}
    ]

  • Equality of mutual inductances:
    [
    M_{12} = M_{21} = M
    ]

  • 互感量公式：
    [
    M = K \sqrt{L_1 L_2}
    ]

  • 互感量相等關係：
    [
    M_{12} = M_{21} = M
    ]

entry.title: Direction of Force on Current-Carrying Conductor in Magnetic Field and Fleming's Left-Hand Rule - 載流導體在磁場中所受力的方向與佛萊明左手定則
entry.content:
Introduction 引言

This article explains the principles of force direction on current-carrying conductors in magnetic fields and the application of Fleming’s left-hand rule, including magnetic field interactions and practical applications.

本文解釋載流導體在磁場中受力方向的原理和佛萊明左手定則的應用，包括磁場相互作用和實際應用。

Key Points 重點歸納

1. Current-Carrying Conductor and Magnetic Field 載流導體與磁場

  • Current-Carrying Conductor: A conductor with electric current generates a magnetic field.

  • Main Magnetic Field Direction: Magnetic lines run from the North (N) pole to the South (S) pole.

  • 載流導體：導體中通有電流，會產生磁場。

  • 主極磁場方向：磁力線由N極指向S極。

2. Magnetic Field Interactions 磁場相互作用

  • Interaction of Magnetic Lines:

    • Above the conductor, magnetic lines oppose and weaken each other.
    • Below the conductor, magnetic lines align and strengthen.

  • Force Direction: The conductor is pushed from regions of higher magnetic line density to lower density, resulting in an upward force.

  • 磁力線互動：

    • 導體上方磁力線方向相反，磁力線抵銷，磁場減弱。
    • 導體下方磁力線方向相同，磁力線增強。

  • 受力方向：導體受力由磁力線密度高處推向低處，導體向上受力。

3. Fleming’s Left-Hand Rule 佛萊明左手定則

  • Fleming’s Left-Hand Rule:

    • Thumb: Force direction (F)
    • Index finger: Magnetic field direction (B)
    • Middle finger: Current direction (I)
    • All three are perpendicular; use the left hand to determine the force direction on the conductor.

  • Application: Fleming’s left-hand rule simplifies determining the force direction on a current-carrying conductor in a magnetic field.

  • 佛萊明左手定則：

    • 拇指：受力方向（F）
    • 食指：磁場方向（B）
    • 中指：電流方向（I）
    • 三者互相垂直，用左手判斷載流導體受力方向。

  • 應用：佛萊明左手定則簡化判斷載流導體在磁場中受力方向的過程。

entry.title: Magnitude of Force on a Current-Carrying Conductor in a Magnetic Field - 載流導體在磁場中所受力的大小
entry.content:
Introduction 引言

This article examines the calculation of force magnitude on a current-carrying conductor in a magnetic field, including both perpendicular and angled cases, along with practical examples.

本文探討載流導體在磁場中受力大小的計算方法，包括垂直和斜角兩種情況，並提供實際範例。

Key Points 重點歸納

1. Force Calculation Methods 受力計算方法

  • The force magnitude on a current-carrying conductor in a magnetic field is calculated in two cases:

    1. Conductor perpendicular to magnetic field:
      Formula: ( F = B l I )
      where ( F ) is force (Newtons), ( B ) is magnetic flux density (Tesla), ( l ) is effective length of conductor in the field (meters), and ( I ) is current (Amperes).
    2. Conductor at an angle (\theta) to magnetic field:
      Formula: ( F = B l I \sin \theta ), where (\sin \theta) adjusts the effective length cut by the magnetic field.

  • 載流導體在磁場中受力的大小計算分兩種情況：

    1. 導體與磁場垂直：
      公式為 ( F = B l I )
      其中，
      • ( F ) 是受力大小（牛頓，N）
      • ( B ) 是磁通密度（特斯拉，T）
      • ( l ) 是導體在磁場中的有效長度（公尺，m）
      • ( I ) 是電流大小（安培，A）
    2. 導體與磁場不垂直（與磁場成角度 (\theta)）：
      公式修正為 ( F = B l I \sin \theta )，其中 (\sin \theta) 是導體在磁場中切割的有效長度比例。

2. Force Direction 力的方向

  • The force direction is determined by Fleming’s left-hand rule:
    Thumb points to force, index finger to magnetic field, middle finger to current.

  • 力的方向可用佛萊明左手定則判斷：
    拇指指向力的方向，食指指向磁場方向，中指指向電流方向。

3. Example Calculations 範例計算

  • Example calculations:

    • Perpendicular case: ( B=2,T, l=1,m, I=10,A \Rightarrow F=20,N )
    • Angled case: ( B=0.5,T, l=0.2,m, I=10,A, \theta=30^\circ \Rightarrow F=0.5,N )

  • 範例計算：

    • 垂直情況：( B=2,T, l=1,m, I=10,A \Rightarrow F=20,N )
    • 斜角情況：( B=0.5,T, l=0.2,m, I=10,A, \theta=30^\circ \Rightarrow F=0.5,N )

entry.title: Current Magnetic Effect: Oersted's Experiment and Applications - 電流的磁效應：奧斯特實驗與應用
entry.content:
Introduction 引言

This article explains Oersted’s discovery of the magnetic effect of electric current and its significance in understanding the relationship between electricity and magnetism.

本文解釋厄斯特發現電流磁效應的過程，以及這個發現對理解電與磁關係的重要性。

Key Points 重點歸納

English

  • Oersted’s groundbreaking discovery:

    • Electric current produces a magnetic field
    • Magnetic field affects compass needle orientation
    • First demonstration of electricity-magnetism relationship

  • Current direction effects:

    • Changing current direction reverses compass deflection
    • Demonstrates vector nature of magnetic field
    • Shows field-current relationship

  • Magnetic field characteristics:

    • Field strength proportional to current magnitude
    • Field strength inversely proportional to distance
    • Field direction perpendicular to current flow

  • Ampere’s right-hand rule:

    • Thumb points in current direction
    • Fingers curl in magnetic field direction
    • Practical tool for field direction determination

  • Historical significance:

    • Oersted’s discovery (1820)
    • Foundation for electromagnetism
    • Ampere’s theoretical development

中文

  • 厄斯特的重大發現：

    • 電流會產生磁場
    • 磁場會影響磁針方向
    • 首次證明電與磁的關係

  • 電流方向效應：

    • 改變電流方向會反轉磁針偏轉
    • 顯示磁場的向量特性
    • 展示場與電流的關係

  • 磁場特性：

    • 磁場強度與電流大小成正比
    • 磁場強度與距離成反比
    • 磁場方向與電流方向垂直

  • 歷史意義：

    • 電磁學的基礎
    • 安培的理論發展

entry.title: High School Basic Electricity: Electromagnetic Effect Part A - 高中基本電學：電磁效應 PART A
entry.content:
Introduction 引言

This article explores the fundamental concepts of electromagnetic effects, including the relationship between electricity and magnetism, practical applications, and key principles.

本文探討電磁效應的基本概念，包括電與磁的關係、實際應用和重要原理。

Key Points 重點歸納

1. Electromagnetic Effect 電磁效應

  • Electromagnetic effect refers to the phenomenon where an electric current produces a magnetic field (electricity generates magnetism).

  • This fundamental principle is the basis for many electrical devices and applications.

  • 電磁效應是電流產生磁場的現象（電生磁）。

  • 這個基本原理是許多電氣設備和應用的基礎。

2. Hall Effect and Applications 霍爾效應與應用

  • The Hall effect sensor converts magnetic energy into electrical energy.

  • Applications include:

    • Smartphone smart covers
    • RFID technology in transportation cards (e.g., EasyCard)
    • Various proximity sensors

  • 霍爾效應感測器利用磁場轉換成電能。

  • 應用包括：

    • 手機智能皮套
    • 悠遊卡的RFID技術
    • 各種接近感測器

3. Magnetic Field Direction and Right-Hand Rule 磁場方向與安培右手定則

  • The magnetic field direction around a current-carrying conductor can be determined by the right-hand rule:

    • Current into the paper produces a clockwise magnetic field
    • Current out of the paper produces a counterclockwise magnetic field

  • 載流導體周圍磁場方向可用安培右手定則判定：

    • 電流流入紙面磁場為順時針
    • 電流流出紙面為逆時針

4. Electromagnetic Induction 電磁感應

  • Electromagnetic induction is the effect where a magnetic field induces an electric current.

  • When a coil moves in a magnetic field, current is induced.

  • This principle is the foundation of generator operation.

  • 電磁感應是磁生電的效應。

  • 線圈在磁場中運動會感應出電流。

  • 這是發電機運作的理論基礎。

entry.title: High School Basic Electricity: Electromagnetic Induction Examples - 高中基本電學：電磁感應範例解析
entry.content:
Introduction 引言

This article presents various examples of Faraday’s electromagnetic induction law, including basic problems, self-inductance calculations, and magnetic flux density applications.

本文介紹法拉第電磁感應定律的各種範例，包括基本題型、自感計算和磁通密度應用。

Key Points 重點歸納

1. Basic Faraday’s Law Problem 法拉第電磁感應基本題型

  • Key parameters: number of coil turns (N), change in magnetic flux (\Delta \Phi), and time interval (\Delta t).

  • Induced EMF formula:
    $$
    e = N \frac{\Delta \Phi}{\Delta t}
    $$

  • Example: 5000 turns, flux changes from 0.01Wb to 0.03Wb in 0.5s, EMF = 200V.

  • 線圈匝數 (N)、磁通變化量 (\Delta \Phi)、時間間隔 (\Delta t) 是計算感應電勢的關鍵參數。

  • 感應電勢公式：
    $$
    e = N \frac{\Delta \Phi}{\Delta t}
    $$

  • 範例：5000匝線圈，磁通0.01Wb增加到0.03Wb，0.5秒內，感應電勢為200V。

2. Advanced Problem: Self-Inductance and Current Change 進階題型：自感電感與電流變化

  • Parameters: inductance (L), current change (\Delta i), time interval (\Delta t).

  • Formula:
    $$
    e = L \frac{\Delta i}{\Delta t}
    $$

  • Example: 4H inductance, current increases from 2A to 7A in 2s, EMF = 10V.

  • 自感電感 (L)、電流變化量 (\Delta i)、時間間隔 (\Delta t) 用於計算感應電勢。

  • 公式：
    $$
    e = L \frac{\Delta i}{\Delta t}
    $$

  • 範例：4H電感，電流2秒由2A增至7A，感應電勢為10V。

3. Calculating Flux Change from Magnetic Flux Density and Area 利用磁通密度與面積計算磁通變化

  • Magnetic flux change:
    $$
    \Delta \Phi = B \times A
    $$

  • Example: 10 turns, magnetic flux density 2T, area 0.25㎡, time 0.1s, EMF = 50V.

  • 磁通密度 (B) 與磁極面積 (A) 乘積得磁通變化量：
    $$
    \Delta \Phi = B \times A
    $$

  • 例：10匝線圈，磁通密度2T，面積0.25㎡，0.1秒內感應電勢為50V。

entry.title: High School Basic Electricity: Electromagnetic Induction Part A - Faraday's Experiment and Law - 高中基本電學：電磁感應 PART A 法拉第電磁感應實驗與定律
entry.content:
Introduction 引言

This article explores Faraday’s electromagnetic induction experiment and law, explaining how changing magnetic fields can induce current in conductors and the mathematical relationships involved.

本文探討法拉第電磁感應實驗與定律，解釋磁場變化如何在導體中產生感應電流，以及相關的數學關係。

Key Points 重點歸納

1. Introduction to Electromagnetic Induction 電磁感應介紹

  • Introduction to Electromagnetic Induction: Explains Faraday’s experiment and law, showing how changing magnetic fields induce current in a conductor.

  • 電磁感應介紹：介紹法拉第電磁感應實驗與定律，說明磁場變化如何在導線中產生感應電流。

2. Experimental Phenomenon 實驗現象

  • Experimental Phenomenon: When a magnet is quickly inserted or removed from a coil, the galvanometer deflects, indicating induced current; no current when stationary.

  • Induced Current Magnitude: Proportional to the speed of magnet movement; faster movement means larger induced current.

  • 實驗現象：磁鐵快速插入或抽出線圈時，檢流計會偏轉，顯示有感應電流產生；靜止時無感應電流。

  • 感應電流大小：與磁鐵插入或抽出速度成正比，速度越快感應電流越大。

3. Mathematical Relationships 數學關係

  • Induced EMF Formula:
    $$
    e = N \frac{\Delta \Phi}{\Delta t}
    $$
    where (e) is induced EMF, (N) is coil turns, and (\frac{\Delta \Phi}{\Delta t}) is the rate of change of magnetic flux.

  • 感應電動勢公式：
    $$
    e = N \frac{\Delta \Phi}{\Delta t}
    $$
    其中 (e) 是感應電動勢，(N) 是線圈匝數，(\frac{\Delta \Phi}{\Delta t}) 是磁通量變化率。

4. Inductance and Induced EMF 電感與感應電動勢

  • Inductance and Induced EMF:
    $$
    e = L \frac{\Delta i}{\Delta t}
    $$
    where (L) is inductance and (\frac{\Delta i}{\Delta t}) is the rate of current change; both formulas are equivalent.

  • 電感與感應電動勢：
    $$
    e = L \frac{\Delta i}{\Delta t}
    $$
    (L) 是電感量，(\frac{\Delta i}{\Delta t}) 是電流變化率，兩公式等價。

entry.title: Example of Force Between Two Long Straight Conductors Carrying Current - 兩長直導體通電流所受之力範例解析
entry.content:
Introduction

This article examines the magnetic force between two long straight conductors carrying current, including the calculation formula and practical examples with different scenarios.

Key Points

1. Basic Principles

  • Two long straight conductors carrying current exert magnetic forces on each other.
  • Force magnitude formula:
    $$
    F = \frac{\mu l I_1 I_2}{2 \pi d}
    $$
    where $\mu$ is permeability, $l$ is length, $I_1, I_2$ are currents, and $d$ is distance between conductors.

2. Force Direction

  • Same current direction causes attraction; opposite direction causes repulsion.
  • The direction of force can be determined using the right-hand rule for magnetic fields.

3. Example Calculations

  • Example 1: $I_1=10A$, $I_2=20A$, $l=10m$, $d=1m$, force is $4 \times 10^{-4} N$, attractive.
  • Example 2: Two wires 0.5m apart, current 20A, length 50m, force is 0.008N, repulsive.

Reference Video

Force Between Current-Carrying Conductors（請在影片播放頁面點選字幕設定，選擇自動翻譯為所需語言）

引言

本文探討兩長直導體通電流時彼此間的磁力作用，包括計算公式和不同情況下的實際範例。

重點歸納

1. 基本原理

  • 兩長直導體通電流時，彼此會產生磁力作用。
  • 受力大小公式為：
    $$
    F = \frac{\mu l I_1 I_2}{2 \pi d}
    $$
    其中，$\mu$為磁導率，$l$為導體長度，$I_1, I_2$為電流，$d$為兩導體間距。

2. 力的方向

  • 電流方向相同時，導體間力為相吸；方向相反時，力為相斥。
  • 力的方向可用磁場的右手定則判斷。

3. 範例計算

  • 範例1：$I_1=10A$, $I_2=20A$, $l=10m$, $d=1m$，計算出力為 $4 \times 10^{-4} N$，方向相吸。
  • 範例2：電路中兩條線距離0.5m，電流20A，長度50m，計算力為0.008N，方向相斥。

entry.title: High School Basic Electricity: Inductance Calculations Part B - 高中基本電學：電感量計算 PART B
entry.content:
Introduction 引言

This article presents Part B of the inductance calculations series, focusing on basic inductance calculations with practical examples. It demonstrates how to calculate inductance using different formulas and parameters.

本文介紹電感量計算系列的B部分，重點在於基本電感計算的實際範例。內容展示如何使用不同的公式和參數來計算電感量。

Key Points 重點歸納

1. Example 1: Basic Inductance Calculation 範例一：基本電感量計算

  • Given parameters:

    • Number of turns (N) = 100
    • Current (I) = 10 A
    • Magnetic flux (Φ) = 0.2 Weber

  • Formula:
    [
    L = \frac{N \Phi}{I}
    ]

  • Calculation:
    [
    L = \frac{100 \times 0.2}{10} = 2 \text{ Henry}
    ]

  • 給定參數：

    • 匝數(N) = 100
    • 電流(I) = 10安培
    • 磁通量(Φ) = 0.2韋伯

  • 公式：
    [
    L = \frac{N \Phi}{I}
    ]

  • 計算：
    [
    L = \frac{100 \times 0.2}{10} = 2 \text{ 亨利}
    ]

2. Example 2: Inductance with Core 範例二：含鐵心電感量計算

  • Given parameters:

    • Cross-sectional area (A) = (10^{-2} m^2)
    • Length (l) = (10^{-1} m)
    • Permeability (μ) = (10^{-4} H/m)
    • Number of turns (N) = 1000

  • Formula:
    [
    L = \frac{\mu A N^2}{l}
    ]

  • Calculation:
    [
    L = \frac{10^{-4} \times 10^{-2} \times 1000^2}{10^{-1}} = 10 \text{ Henry}
    ]

  • Effect of halving turns:

    • New inductance = 2.5 Henry (1/4 of original)

  • 給定參數：

    • 截面積(A) = (10^{-2} m^2)
    • 長度(l) = (10^{-1} m)
    • 導磁係數(μ) = (10^{-4} H/m)
    • 匝數(N) = 1000

  • 公式：
    [
    L = \frac{\mu A N^2}{l}
    ]

  • 計算：
    [
    L = \frac{10^{-4} \times 10^{-2} \times 1000^2}{10^{-1}} = 10 \text{ 亨利}
    ]

  • 匝數減半的影響：

    • 新電感量 = 2.5亨利（原來的1/4）

3. Key Observations 重要觀察

  • Inductance is proportional to the square of the number of turns

  • Changes in the number of turns have a significant impact on inductance

  • Core material properties (permeability) affect inductance

  • 電感量與匝數的平方成正比

  • 匝數的變化對電感量有顯著影響

  • 鐵心材料特性（導磁係數）影響電感量

entry.title: High School Basic Electricity: Inductance Calculations Part E - 高中基本電學：電感量計算 PART E
entry.content:
Introduction 引言

This article presents Part E of the inductance calculations series, focusing on basic calculations of self-inductance (L) and mutual inductance (M), as well as comprehensive calculations involving inductance (L), coupling coefficient (K), and mutual inductance (M).

本文介紹電感量計算系列的第五部分，重點在於自感量(L)和互感量(M)的基本計算，以及包含電感量(L)、耦合係數(K)和互感量(M)的綜合計算。

Key Points 重點歸納

1. Basic Parameters 基本參數

  • Relationship between coil turns (N_1, N_2), currents (I_1, I_2), and magnetic flux (\Phi)

  • These parameters form the foundation of inductance calculations

  • 線圈匝數 (N_1, N_2)、電流 (I_1, I_2) 與磁通量 (\Phi) 的關係

  • 這些參數構成電感計算的基礎

2. Self-Inductance Formula 自感量公式

  • Self-inductance calculation:
    [
    L = \frac{N \Phi}{I}
    ]

  • This formula shows the relationship between turns, flux, and current

  • 自感量計算公式：
    [
    L = \frac{N \Phi}{I}
    ]

  • 此公式顯示匝數、磁通量和電流之間的關係

3. Mutual Inductance Formulas 互感量公式

  • Mutual inductance calculations:
    [
    M_{12} = \frac{N_2 \Phi_{12}}{I_1}, \quad M_{21} = \frac{N_1 \Phi_{21}}{I_2}
    ]

  • These formulas describe the mutual inductance between two coils

  • 互感量計算公式：
    [
    M_{12} = \frac{N_2 \Phi_{12}}{I_1}, \quad M_{21} = \frac{N_1 \Phi_{21}}{I_2}
    ]

  • 這些公式描述兩個線圈之間的互感

4. Coupling Coefficient 耦合係數

  • Coupling coefficient formula:
    [
    K = \frac{\Phi_{12}}{\Phi_1} = \frac{\Phi_{21}}{\Phi_2}
    ]

  • This coefficient measures the strength of magnetic coupling

  • 耦合係數計算：
    [
    K = \frac{\Phi_{12}}{\Phi_1} = \frac{\Phi_{21}}{\Phi_2}
    ]

  • 此係數衡量磁耦合的強度

5. Self-Inductance Ratio 自感量比值

  • Ratio of self-inductances:
    [
    \frac{L_1}{L_2} = \left(\frac{N_1}{N_2}\right)^2
    ]

  • This relationship is useful for comparing inductances

  • 自感量比值：
    [
    \frac{L_1}{L_2} = \left(\frac{N_1}{N_2}\right)^2
    ]

  • 此關係可用於比較電感量

6. Comprehensive Calculations 綜合運算

  • Examples of comprehensive calculations including:

    • Self-inductance (L)
    • Mutual inductance (M)
    • Coupling coefficient (K)

  • These calculations demonstrate the practical application of all concepts

  • 綜合運算範例，包含：

    • 自感量(L)
    • 互感量(M)
    • 耦合係數(K)

  • 這些計算展示所有概念的實際應用

entry.title: Energy Storage in Inductors: With and Without Mutual Inductance - 電感器的儲能（無互感與有互感情況）
entry.content:
Introduction 引言

This article provides a comprehensive explanation of energy storage in inductors, covering both cases with and without mutual inductance. It includes detailed formulas and practical applications.

Key Points

1. Basic Energy Storage

  • When current flows through an inductor, it creates a magnetic field that stores magnetic energy
  • Magnetic flux linkage (λ) is proportional to current (I), with inductance L as the proportionality constant
  • Stored energy is the area under the λ-I curve

2. Energy Storage Formula

  • Basic formula for single inductor:
    $$
    W = \frac{1}{2} L I^2
    $$
  • This formula represents the energy stored in the magnetic field

3. Mutual Inductance Energy Storage

  • With mutual inductance, total stored energy includes self and mutual inductance terms:
    $$
    W = \frac{1}{2} L_1 I_1^2 + \frac{1}{2} L_2 I_2^2 \pm M I_1 I_2
    $$
  • The plus sign indicates aiding mutual inductance, the minus sign indicates opposing

4. Series and Parallel Configurations

  • In series aiding or opposing cases:

    • Currents are equal
    • Formula can be simplified
    • Total inductance includes mutual inductance term

  • In parallel aiding or opposing cases:

    • Currents differ
    • Must be calculated separately
    • Consider both self and mutual inductance effects

Reference Video

Inductor Energy Storage Comprehensive（Please select subtitle settings on the video page and choose auto-translate to your preferred language）

引言

本文全面解釋電感器的儲能原理，包括有互感與無互感的情況。內容包含詳細公式和實際應用。

重點歸納

1. 基本儲能原理

  • 電感器通電後產生磁場並儲存磁能
  • 磁通鏈（λ）與電流（I）成正比，比例常數為電感量L
  • 儲存能量為磁通鏈與電流的面積

2. 儲能計算公式

  • 單一電感器基本公式：
    $$
    W = \frac{1}{2} L I^2
    $$
  • 此公式代表儲存在磁場中的能量

3. 互感儲能計算

  • 有互感時，總儲能包含自感與互感能量：
    $$
    W = \frac{1}{2} L_1 I_1^2 + \frac{1}{2} L_2 I_2^2 \pm M I_1 I_2
    $$
  • 其中正號代表互助，負號代表互消

4. 串聯與並聯配置

  • 串聯互助與互消情況：

    • 電流相等
    • 公式可簡化
    • 總電感包含互感項

  • 並聯互助與互消情況：

    • 電流不等
    • 需分別計算
    • 考慮自感與互感效應

entry.title: Inductor Energy Storage: Principles and Applications - 電感儲能：原理與應用
entry.content:
Introduction 引言

This article explains the methods for calculating energy storage in inductors, both with and without considering mutual inductance effects. It includes practical examples and formulas for different scenarios.

本文解釋電感器儲能計算的方法，包括考慮和不考慮互感效應的情況。內容包含實際範例和不同情況下的計算公式。

Key Points 重點歸納

1. Energy Storage Without Mutual Inductance 不考慮互感的儲能計算

  • Use the formula ( W = \frac{1}{2} L I^2 )

  • Example: A 10mH inductor with 6A current stores 0.18J energy

  • This is the basic formula for single inductor energy storage

  • 使用公式 ( W = \frac{1}{2} L I^2 )

  • 範例：10mH電感器通過6A電流，計算儲能為0.18J

  • 這是單一電感器儲能的基本公式

2. Energy Storage With Mutual Inductance 考慮互感的儲能計算

  • For two coils, total energy is:
    [
    W = \frac{1}{2} L_1 I_1^2 + \frac{1}{2} L_2 I_2^2 \pm M I_1 I_2
    ]

  • The sign depends on whether the mutual inductance is aiding (+) or opposing (−)

  • 兩線圈儲能為：
    [
    W = \frac{1}{2} L_1 I_1^2 + \frac{1}{2} L_2 I_2^2 \pm M I_1 I_2
    ]

  • 其中符號由互感是互助（正號）或互消（負號）決定

3. Mutual Inductance Calculation 互感計算

  • Mutual inductance can be calculated using:
    [
    M = K \sqrt{L_1 L_2}
    ]

  • where (K) is the coupling coefficient

  • 互感計算公式：
    [
    M = K \sqrt{L_1 L_2}
    ]

  • 其中 (K) 是耦合係數

4. Series Aiding Inductors 串聯互助電感

  • For series aiding inductors:

    1. Calculate total inductance:
      [
      L_{\text{total}} = L_1 + L_2 + 2M
      ]
    2. Then calculate energy:
      [
      W = \frac{1}{2} L_{\text{total}} I^2
      ]

  • 串聯互助電感總儲能：

    1. 先計算總電感：
      [
      L_{\text{total}} = L_1 + L_2 + 2M
      ]
    2. 再用公式計算儲能：
      [
      W = \frac{1}{2} L_{\text{total}} I^2
      ]

entry.title: Introduction to the Structure and Function of Inductors - 電感器的結構與功能介紹
entry.content:
Introduction 引言

This article provides a comprehensive overview of inductors, their structure, types, and working principles. It explains how inductors store energy and their role in electrical circuits.

本文全面介紹電感器的結構、種類和工作原理。解釋電感器如何儲存能量及其在電路中的作用。

Key Points 重點歸納

1. Basic Definition 基本定義

  • Symbol and Unit:

    • Symbol: L
    • Unit: Henry (H)
    • Named after Joseph Henry, who discovered inductance

  • 符號與單位：

    • 符號：L
    • 單位：亨利（H）
    • 紀念發現電感特性的科學家約瑟夫·亨利

2. Structure 結構

  • Core Components:

    • Conductor wire wound around a core
    • Core materials: air, iron, or magnetic material
    • Core material affects inductance value

  • 核心組件：

    • 導線繞在心材上
    • 心材可為空氣、鐵心或磁心
    • 心材影響電感量大小

3. Function 功能

  • Main Functions:

    • Converts electrical energy to magnetic energy
    • Stores energy in magnetic field
    • Stabilizes current flow
    • Prevents sudden current changes
    • Reduces magnetic interference

  • 主要功能：

    • 將電能轉換成磁能
    • 在磁場中儲存能量
    • 穩定電流
    • 防止電流瞬間變化
    • 減少磁干擾

4. Types 種類

  • Classification by Core Material:

    • Air-core inductors
    • Iron-core inductors
    • Magnetic-core inductors
    • Printed circuit inductors

  • 依心材分類：

    • 空氣心電感器
    • 鐵心電感器
    • 磁心電感器
    • 印刷電路電感器

5. Working Principle 工作原理

  • Charging Process:

    • Current gradually increases
    • Magnetic energy stored in inductor
    • Magnetic field builds up

  • 充電過程：

    • 電流逐漸增加
    • 磁能儲存在電感器中
    • 磁場逐漸建立

6. Discharging Process 放電過程

  • Characteristics:

    • Magnetic energy converts to electrical energy
    • Current gradually decreases
    • Connected lamp brightness changes accordingly

  • 特性：

    • 磁能轉換成電能
    • 電流逐漸減小
    • 連接的燈泡亮度隨之變化

7. Important Considerations 重要注意事項

  • Switch Operation:

    • Switches must be toggled simultaneously
    • Prevents circuit open-circuiting
    • Avoids magnetic energy loss

  • 開關操作：

    • 開關必須同時切換
    • 防止電路瞬間開路
    • 避免磁能損失

entry.title: Magnetic Field Intensity of a Long Straight Conductor - 長直導線的磁場強度
entry.content:
Introduction 引言

This article introduces the concept and calculation of the magnetic field intensity around a long straight conductor, drawing analogies from the electric field of a parallel plate capacitor. It covers the formula, unit, direction, and practical examples.

本文介紹長直導線周圍磁場強度的概念與計算，並以平行板電容器的電場強度作類比推導，涵蓋公式、單位、方向與實例。

Bilingual Display Controls 雙語顯示控制

  • [Show English Only]
  • [只顯示中文]
  • [Show Both Languages 同時顯示]

Key Points 重點歸納

English

  • The concept of electric field intensity in a parallel plate capacitor is used to analogously derive the magnetic field intensity of a long straight conductor.
  • In a parallel plate capacitor, electric field intensity equals voltage divided by the distance between plates.
  • The magnetic field intensity around a long straight conductor depends on the current (magnetomotive force) and the length of the magnetic field line (magnetic path length).
  • Magnetic field intensity formula:
    $$
    H = \frac{I}{2 \pi R}
    $$
    where (I) is the current in amperes and (R) is the radius (distance from the wire) in meters.
  • The unit of magnetic field intensity is ampere-turn per meter (AT/m).
  • The direction of the magnetic field follows the right-hand rule, with magnetic field lines forming circles around the conductor.
  • Example: For a 10-ampere current at 10 cm from the conductor, the magnetic field intensity is (\frac{50}{\pi} , \text{AT/m}), directed into the plane.

中文

  • 利用平行板電容器的電場強度概念，類比推導長直導線的磁場強度。
  • 平行板電容器中，電場強度為電壓除以兩極板距離。
  • 長直導線產生的磁場強度與電流（磁動勢）及磁力線長度（磁路長）有關。
  • 磁場強度公式：
    $$
    H = \frac{I}{2 \pi R}
    $$
    其中 (I) 是電流（安培），(R) 是距離導線的半徑（公尺）。
  • 磁場強度單位為安匝每公尺（AT/m）。
  • 磁場方向依安培右手定則判斷，磁力線繞導線形成圓周。
  • 範例：通入10安培電流，距離導線10公分處磁場強度為 (\frac{50}{\pi} , \text{AT/m})，方向射入紙面。

entry.title: Magnetic Flux Units and Calculations - 磁力線單位與計算
entry.content:
Introduction

This article explains the fundamental units of magnetic flux, their relationships, and practical calculations in both SI and CGS systems.

Key Points

  • Magnetic Flux Unit: Maxwell

    • Unit of magnetic lines of force
    • CGS unit of magnetic flux
    • Fundamental unit in electromagnetic calculations

  • Magnetic Flux (Φ, Phi)

    • Total number of magnetic lines of force
    • Measured in Weber (SI unit)
    • Conversion: 1 Weber = 10^8 Maxwell

  • Magnetic Flux Density (B)

    • Magnetic flux per unit area
    • Formula:
      $$
      B = \frac{\Phi}{A}
      $$
    • Units:
      • Tesla (SI)
      • Gauss (CGS)
      • Conversion: 1 Tesla = 10^4 Gauss

  • Unit Conversions

    • 1 Weber = 10^8 Maxwell
    • 1 Tesla = 10^4 Gauss
    • Essential for system conversion

  • Example Calculation

    • Area: 10 cm²
    • Flux: 10^6 Maxwell
    • Flux density: 10^5 Gauss
    • Converted to Tesla: 10 Tesla

entry.title: Basic Introduction to Magnetic Hysteresis Loop and Hysteresis Effect - 磁滯迴線與磁滯效應基礎介紹
entry.content:
Introduction 引言

This article explores the fundamental concepts of magnetic hysteresis, its effects, and practical applications. Understanding hysteresis is crucial for various technologies, from data storage to electrical control systems.

本文探討磁滯的基本概念、效應及實際應用。理解磁滯現象對於從數據儲存到電氣控制系統等各種技術都至關重要。

Key Points 重點歸納

1. Security Concerns 安全考量

  • Credit Card Security:

    • Magnetic stripes contain sensitive information
    • Vulnerable to copying through hysteresis effect
    • Potential risk of unauthorized duplication

  • 信用卡安全：

    • 磁條含有敏感資訊
    • 可能被磁滯效應複製
    • 存在未經授權複製的風險

2. Hysteresis Effect 磁滯效應

  • Basic Principle:

    • Ferromagnetic materials retain magnetization
    • Remanence persists after field removal
    • Key characteristic of magnetic materials

  • 基本原理：

    • 鐵磁性物質保留磁化狀態
    • 移除磁場後仍保有剩磁
    • 磁性物質的重要特性

3. Hysteresis Loop 磁滯迴線

  • Characteristics:

    • Illustrates magnetization cycle
    • Shows relationship between B and H
    • Demonstrates material’s magnetic behavior

  • 特性：

    • 描述磁化循環過程
    • 顯示B與H的關係
    • 展示材料的磁性行為

4. Key Properties 關鍵特性

  • Remanence and Coercivity:

    • Remanence: residual magnetism (B≠0 when H=0)
    • Coercivity: reverse field needed to demagnetize
    • Important for material selection

  • 剩磁與矯頑磁力：

    • 剩磁：殘留磁性（H=0時B≠0）
    • 矯頑磁力：退磁所需的反向磁場
    • 對材料選擇很重要

5. Energy Loss 能量損失

  • Hysteresis Loss:

    • Energy dissipated during magnetization cycles
    • Converts to heat
    • Affects efficiency of magnetic devices

  • 磁滯損失：

    • 磁化循環中的能量損耗
    • 轉換為熱能
    • 影響磁性設備的效率

6. Practical Applications 實際應用

  • Data Storage:

    • Audio tapes
    • Magnetic disks
    • Digital storage media

  • Control Systems:

    • Air conditioner control
    • Street light switching
    • Prevents frequent switching

  • 數據儲存：

    • 錄音帶
    • 磁碟片
    • 數位儲存媒體

  • 控制系統：

    • 冷氣機控制
    • 路燈開關
    • 避免頻繁切換

entry.title: High School Basic Electricity: Parallel Inductance Calculation Examples - 高中基本電學：並聯總電感的運算範例
entry.content:
Introduction 引言

This article explains the methods for calculating total inductance in parallel circuits, both with and without considering mutual inductance effects. It includes practical examples and formulas for different scenarios.

本文解釋並聯電路中總電感的計算方法，包括考慮和不考慮互感效應的情況。內容包含實際範例和不同情況下的計算公式。

Key Points 重點歸納

1. Parallel Inductance Without Mutual Inductance 不考慮互感的並聯電感計算

  • The total inductance formula is:
    $$ L_{total} = \frac{L_1 \times L_2}{L_1 + L_2} $$

  • Example: L1=20mH, L2=30mH, total inductance is 12mH

  • This is the basic formula for parallel inductors without mutual inductance

  • 總電感公式為：
    $$ L_{total} = \frac{L_1 \times L_2}{L_1 + L_2} $$

  • 例：L1=20mH，L2=30mH，計算結果為12mH

  • 這是不考慮互感時並聯電感的基本公式

2. Parallel Inductance With Mutual Inductance 考慮互感的並聯電感計算

  • The total inductance formula becomes:
    $$ L_{total} = \frac{L_1 + L_2 - 2M}{L_1 \times L_2 - M^2} $$

  • Example: L1=8H, L2=2H, mutual inductance M=2H, total inductance is 2H

  • This formula accounts for the mutual inductance effect

  • 總電感公式變為：
    $$ L_{total} = \frac{L_1 + L_2 - 2M}{L_1 \times L_2 - M^2} $$

  • 例：L1=8H，L2=2H，互感M=2H，計算結果為2H

  • 此公式考慮了互感效應

3. Mutual Inductance Direction Effects 互感方向影響

  • Same dot direction (head-to-head and tail-to-tail) indicates mutual assistance

  • This configuration affects the total inductance calculation

  • The mutual inductance term (M) can be positive or negative depending on the configuration

  • 打點方向相同（頭接頭尾接尾）屬於互助並聯

  • 這種配置會影響總電感的計算

  • 互感項（M）可為正值或負值，取決於配置方式

entry.title: Parallel Combination of Inductors: With and Without Mutual Inductance - 電感器並聯組合(無互感)、(有互感)
entry.content:
Introduction 引言

This article explains the methods for calculating total inductance in parallel inductor combinations, covering both cases with and without mutual inductance. It includes formulas and practical considerations for different scenarios.

本文解釋電感器並聯組合的計算方法，包括有互感與無互感的情況。內容包含不同情況下的計算公式和實際考量。

Key Points 重點歸納

1. Types of Parallel Combinations 並聯組合類型

  • Parallel inductors can be combined in two cases:

    • Without mutual inductance
    • With mutual inductance

  • Each case requires different calculation methods

  • 電感器並聯組合分為兩種情況：

    • 無互感
    • 有互感

  • 每種情況需要不同的計算方法

2. Parallel Inductors Without Mutual Inductance 無互感並聯電感

  • The formula is similar to parallel resistors:
    $$
    L_T = \frac{L_1 \times L_2}{L_1 + L_2}
    $$

  • This is the basic formula for parallel inductors without mutual effects

  • 計算公式與電阻並聯相似：
    $$
    L_T = \frac{L_1 \times L_2}{L_1 + L_2}
    $$

  • 這是不考慮互感時並聯電感的基本公式

3. Parallel Inductors With Mutual Inductance 有互感並聯電感

  • Need to determine if mutual effect is:

    • Assisting (same magnetic field direction)
    • Opposing (opposite magnetic field direction)

  • The formula becomes:
    $$
    L_T = \frac{L_1 L_2 - M^2}{L_1 + L_2 \mp 2M}
    $$

  • Sign convention:

    • Minus sign (-2M) for assisting mutual inductance
    • Plus sign (+2M) for opposing mutual inductance

  • 需判斷互感是：

    • 互助（磁場方向相同）
    • 互消（磁場方向相反）

  • 計算公式變為：
    $$
    L_T = \frac{L_1 L_2 - M^2}{L_1 + L_2 \mp 2M}
    $$

  • 符號規則：

    • 互助取負號（-2M），電感量較大
    • 互消取正號（+2M），電感量較小

entry.title: Permeability and Magnetization Curve - 導磁係數與磁化曲線
entry.content:
Introduction 引言

This article explains the fundamental concepts of magnetic permeability and magnetization curves, including their mathematical relationships and practical applications in different materials.

本文解釋磁導率與磁化曲線的基本概念，包括其數學關係及在不同材料中的實際應用。

Key Points 重點歸納

1. Magnetic Permeability 導磁係數

  • Definition:

    • Symbol: μ (mu)
    • Formula: ( \mu = \mu_0 \times \mu_r )
    • Represents material’s ability to conduct magnetic flux

  • 定義：

    • 符號：μ
    • 公式：( \mu = \mu_0 \times \mu_r )
    • 表示物質導磁能力

2. Permeability Constants 導磁常數

  • Vacuum Permeability (μ₀):

    • Value: (4\pi \times 10^{-7})
    • Base reference for magnetic permeability
    • Universal constant

  • Relative Permeability (μr):

    • Ratio of material’s permeability to vacuum
    • Determines material’s magnetic properties
    • Dimensionless quantity

  • 真空導磁係數 (μ₀)：

    • 數值：(4\pi \times 10^{-7})
    • 磁導率的基準參考值
    • 通用常數

  • 相對導磁係數 (μr)：

    • 材料導磁率與真空的比值
    • 決定材料的磁性特性
    • 無因次量

3. Material Classification 材料分類

  • Ferromagnetic Materials:

    • μr ≫ 1
    • Examples: iron, silicon steel, steel, cobalt, nickel
    • Strong magnetic properties

  • Non-magnetic Materials:

    • μr = 1
    • Examples: vacuum
    • Linear B-H curve, no saturation

  • Paramagnetic Materials:

    • μr > 1
    • Examples: aluminum, platinum, tungsten
    • Magnetic flux aligns with field

  • Diamagnetic Materials:

    • μr < 1
    • Examples: gold, silver, copper
    • Magnetic flux opposes field

  • 強磁性材料：

    • μr ≫ 1
    • 例如：鐵、矽鋼、鋼、鈷、鎳
    • 強磁性特性

  • 非磁性材料：

    • μr = 1
    • 例如：真空
    • B-H曲線為直線，無飽和

  • 順磁性材料：

    • μr > 1
    • 例如：鋁、鉑、鎢
    • 磁通與磁場同向

  • 反磁性材料：

    • μr < 1
    • 例如：金、銀、銅
    • 磁通與磁場反向

4. Magnetization Process 磁化過程

  • Core Magnetization:

    • Current application magnetizes iron core
    • Magnetization strength increases with current
    • Magnetic domains align

  • 鐵心磁化：

    • 通電使鐵心磁化
    • 磁化強度隨電流增加
    • 磁域排列

5. B-H Curve Characteristics B-H曲線特性

  • Non-magnetic Materials:

    • Linear relationship
    • No saturation point
    • Direct proportionality

  • Magnetic Materials:

    • Non-linear relationship
    • Shows saturation point
    • Magnetic domain alignment affects flux

  • 非磁性材料：

    • 線性關係
    • 無飽和點
    • 直接比例關係

  • 磁性材料：

    • 非線性關係
    • 顯示飽和點
    • 磁域排列影響磁通

6. Magnetic Saturation 磁飽和

  • Definition:

    • Complete alignment of magnetic domains
    • Further H increase doesn’t significantly increase B
    • Maximum magnetization state

  • 定義：

    • 磁域完全排列
    • 增加H不會顯著增加B
    • 最大磁化狀態

entry.title: Detailed Explanation of Self-Inductance Definition - 自感量定義詳解
entry.content:
Introduction 引言

This article provides a detailed explanation of self-inductance, its definition, formula, and practical significance in electromagnetic systems. It helps readers understand the fundamental concept of how coils generate magnetic flux in response to current changes.

本文詳細解釋自感量的定義、公式及其在電磁系統中的實際意義。幫助讀者理解線圈如何對電流變化產生磁通量的基本概念。

Key Points 重點歸納

1. Definition of Self-Inductance 自感量定義

  • Self-inductance (L) is the ratio of the magnetic flux linkage to the current in a single coil

  • It represents the coil’s ability to generate magnetic flux in response to current

  • **自感量（L）**是指單一線圈中，當電流通過時，該線圈自身產生的磁通鏈與電流的比值

  • 表示線圈對電流產生磁通量的能力

2. Mathematical Formula 數學公式

  • Formula:
    [
    L = \frac{N \Phi}{I}
    ]
    where:

    • N: Number of turns in the coil
    • Φ: Magnetic flux (in Weber, Wb)
    • I: Current through the coil (in Ampere, A)

  • 公式：
    [
    L = \frac{N \Phi}{I}
    ]
    其中：

    • N：線圈的匝數
    • Φ：磁通量（單位韋柏 Wb）
    • I：通過線圈的電流（單位安培 A）

3. Physical Meaning 物理意義

  • When current I flows through the coil, it generates magnetic flux Φ

  • The product of flux and number of turns (NΦ) gives the flux linkage

  • The ratio of flux linkage to current is the self-inductance

  • 當電流 I 流過線圈時，會在該線圈中產生磁通量 Φ

  • 磁通量與匝數的乘積（NΦ）得到磁通鏈

  • 磁通鏈與電流的比值就是自感量

4. Significance 重要性

  • Higher self-inductance means:

    • Stronger response to current changes
    • Small current changes can produce large flux linkage
    • Greater ability to generate magnetic flux

  • 自感量越大表示：

    • 對電流變化的反應越強
    • 少量電流變化就能產生較大的磁通鏈
    • 產生磁通的能力越強

5. Practical Understanding 實際理解

  • Self-inductance is a measure of a coil’s ability to generate magnetic flux

  • It is a fundamental parameter in electromagnetic systems

  • It affects how the coil responds to changing currents

  • 自感量是衡量線圈「自我產生磁通能力」的參數

  • 是電磁系統中的基本參數

  • 影響線圈對變化電流的響應方式

entry.title: Self and Mutual Inductance: Concepts and Calculations - 自感與互感：原理與計算
entry.content:
Introduction 引言

This article explains the fundamental concepts of self-inductance and mutual inductance in electromagnetic systems. It covers the basic principles, mathematical relationships, and practical applications of these important electromagnetic phenomena.

本文解釋電磁系統中自感和互感的基本概念。內容涵蓋這些重要電磁現象的基本原理、數學關係和實際應用。

Key Points 重點歸納

1. Self-Inductance 自感

  • Definition:

    • The magnetic flux generated by current flowing through a single coil
    • Related to the coil’s own current
    • A fundamental property of any coil

  • 定義：

    • 單一線圈通電時產生的磁通量
    • 與該線圈自身的電流相關
    • 任何線圈的基本特性

2. Mutual Inductance 互感

  • Definition:

    • Occurs when two coils are in proximity
    • Current in one coil produces magnetic flux that links to the other coil
    • Denoted by capital M

  • 定義：

    • 當兩個相鄰線圈存在時發生
    • 一個線圈的電流會產生磁通量，並交鏈到另一個線圈
    • 表示為大寫M

3. Magnetic Flux Components 磁通量分解

  • Flux in coil 1:

    • Total flux Φ1 splits into:
      • Φ11: Leakage flux (not linking the other coil)
      • Φ12: Mutual flux (linking the other coil)

  • 線圈1的磁通：

    • 總磁通Φ1分為：
      • Φ11：漏磁通（未交鏈到另一線圈）
      • Φ12：交鏈磁通（穿過另一線圈）

4. Self-Inductance Formula 自感量公式

  • Formula for coil 1:
    [
    L_1 = \frac{N_1 \Phi_1}{I_1}
    ]
    where:

    • N1: Number of turns
    • I1: Current

  • 線圈1的公式：
    [
    L_1 = \frac{N_1 \Phi_1}{I_1}
    ]
    其中：

    • N1：線圈匝數
    • I1：電流

5. Mutual Inductance Formula 互感量公式

  • Formula for mutual inductance:
    [
    M_{12} = \frac{N_2 \Phi_{12}}{I_1}
    ]
    This represents the mutual inductance from coil 1 to coil 2

  • 互感量公式：
    [
    M_{12} = \frac{N_2 \Phi_{12}}{I_1}
    ]
    表示線圈1對線圈2的互感

6. Coil 2 Relationships 線圈2的關係

  • Similar definitions apply to coil 2:

    • Self-inductance L2
    • Mutual inductance M21

  • 線圈2也有類似的定義：

    • 自感量L2
    • 互感量M21

entry.title: High School Basic Electricity: Series Inductance Calculation Examples - 高中基本電學：串聯總電感運算範例
entry.content:
Introduction 引言

This article explains the methods for calculating total inductance in series circuits, both with and without considering mutual inductance effects. It includes practical examples and formulas for different scenarios.

本文解釋串聯電路中總電感的計算方法，包括考慮和不考慮互感效應的情況。內容包含實際範例和不同情況下的計算公式。

Key Points 重點歸納

1. Series Inductance Without Mutual Inductance 不考慮互感的串聯電感計算

  • Total inductance is the sum of each inductance

  • Similar to resistors in series

  • Example: 12H + 4H + 6H = 22H

  • 總電感為各電感直接相加

  • 類似電阻串聯計算

  • 範例：12H + 4H + 6H = 22H

2. Series Inductance With Mutual Inductance 考慮互感的串聯電感計算

  • For three inductors (L_1, L_2, L_3) in series

  • Consider mutual inductances (M_{12}, M_{23}, M_{31})

  • Total inductance formula:
    $$
    L_{total} = L_1 + L_2 + L_3 \pm 2M_{12} \pm 2M_{23} \pm 2M_{31}
    $$

  • Sign convention:

    • Plus sign for mutual aiding (same magnetic flux direction)
    • Minus sign for mutual opposing (opposite magnetic flux direction)

  • 三個電感 (L_1, L_2, L_3) 串聯

  • 考慮互感 (M_{12}, M_{23}, M_{31})

  • 總電感公式：
    $$
    L_{total} = L_1 + L_2 + L_3 \pm 2M_{12} \pm 2M_{23} \pm 2M_{31}
    $$

  • 符號規則：

    • 互助（磁力線方向相同）取加號
    • 互消（磁力線方向相反）取減號

3. Example Calculations 範例計算

  • Without mutual inductance:

    • Simple addition of individual inductances
    • Example: 12H + 4H + 6H = 22H

  • With mutual inductance:

    • Determine aiding or opposing by magnetic flux direction
    • Apply appropriate signs in the formula
    • Calculate total inductance

  • 不考慮互感：

    • 直接相加各電感值
    • 範例：12H + 4H + 6H = 22H

  • 考慮互感：

    • 根據磁力線方向判斷互助或互消
    • 代入公式計算
    • 得出總電感值

entry.title: Series Combination of Inductors: With and Without Mutual Inductance - 電感器串聯組合：有互感與無互感
entry.content:
Introduction 引言

This article explains the methods for calculating total inductance in series inductor combinations, covering both cases with and without mutual inductance. It includes formulas and practical considerations for different scenarios.

本文解釋電感器串聯組合的計算方法，包括有互感與無互感的情況。內容包含不同情況下的計算公式和實際考量。

Key Points 重點歸納

1. Inductors in Series Without Mutual Inductance 不考慮互感的串聯電感

  • The total inductance is the sum of the individual inductances:
    $$L_{total} = L_1 + L_2$$

  • This is the basic formula for series inductors without mutual effects

  • 總電感為各電感直接相加：
    $$L_{total} = L_1 + L_2$$

  • 這是不考慮互感時串聯電感的基本公式

2. Inductors in Series With Mutual Inductance 考慮互感的串聯電感

  • Need to determine if mutual effect is:

    • Aiding (same magnetic field direction)
    • Opposing (opposite magnetic field direction)

  • The mutual inductance term affects the total inductance calculation

  • 需判斷互感是：

    • 互助（磁場方向相同）
    • 互消（磁場方向相反）

  • 互感項會影響總電感的計算

3. Series Aiding Configuration 串聯互助配置

  • The magnetic fields have the same direction

  • Mutual inductance is positive

  • Total inductance formula:
    $$L_{total} = L_1 + L_2 + 2M$$

  • 磁場方向相同

  • 互感為正值

  • 總電感公式：
    $$L_{total} = L_1 + L_2 + 2M$$

4. Series Opposing Configuration 串聯互消配置

  • The magnetic fields have opposite directions

  • Mutual inductance is negative

  • Total inductance formula:
    $$L_{total} = L_1 + L_2 - 2M$$

  • 磁場方向相反

  • 互感為負值

  • 總電感公式：
    $$L_{total} = L_1 + L_2 - 2M$$

5. Polarity Marking (N-dot Convention) 極性標記（N點標示法）

  • Use dots to indicate the polarity (N-pole direction) of the coils

  • Helps determine whether mutual inductance is aiding or opposing

  • Important for correct calculation of total inductance

  • 使用點來標示線圈的極性（N極方向）

  • 有助於判斷互感是互助或互消

  • 對正確計算總電感很重要

entry.title: Magnetic Field Intensity of a Solenoid - 螺線管的磁場強度
entry.content:
Introduction 引言

This article explains the fundamental concepts of magnetic field intensity in solenoids, including the calculation of magnetomotive force and the principles of magnetic field superposition.

本文解釋螺線管中磁場強度的基本概念，包括磁動勢的計算和磁場疊加原理。

Key Points 重點歸納

1. Magnetomotive Force (MMF) 磁動勢

  • Definition:

    • Energy of magnetic flux generated by current
    • Formula: MMF = ( NI )
    • Where N is number of turns, I is current

  • 定義：

    • 電流產生的磁力線能量
    • 公式：磁動勢 = ( NI )
    • N為匝數，I為電流

2. Magnetic Field Intensity 磁場強度

  • Calculation Formula:
    $$
    H = \frac{NI}{L}
    $$

    • H: magnetic field intensity
    • N: number of turns
    • I: current
    • L: magnetic path length

  • 計算公式：
    $$
    H = \frac{NI}{L}
    $$

    • H：磁場強度
    • N：匝數
    • I：電流
    • L：磁路長度

3. Units 單位

  • Standard Unit:

    • Ampere-turns per meter (A·t/m)
    • Represents magnetic field strength
    • International standard unit

  • 標準單位：

    • 安匝/公尺（A·t/m）
    • 表示磁場強度
    • 國際標準單位

4. Field Superposition 磁場疊加

  • Principle:

    • Multiple coils’ fields can be added
    • Vector addition for same direction
    • Vector subtraction for opposite directions

  • 原理：

    • 多個線圈的磁場可以相加
    • 同向時做向量加法
    • 反向時做向量減法

5. Practical Applications 實際應用

  • Electromagnetic Devices:

    • Solenoids
    • Electromagnets
    • Transformers
    • Magnetic sensors

  • 電磁裝置：

    • 螺線管
    • 電磁鐵
    • 變壓器
    • 磁感測器

6. Important Considerations 重要考量

  • Factors Affecting Field Strength:

    • Number of turns
    • Current magnitude
    • Core material
    • Path length

  • 影響磁場強度的因素：

    • 匝數
    • 電流大小
    • 心材材料
    • 路徑長度

entry.content:
Circuit Analysis with Two Voltage Sources

This article demonstrates how to analyze a circuit containing two voltage sources using the Superposition Theorem.

Circuit Components

  • Voltage Source 1: V1 = 12V
  • Voltage Source 2: V2 = 6V
  • Resistors: R1 = 4Ω, R2 = 6Ω, R3 = 8Ω

Analysis Steps

  1. First Source Analysis (V1 only)
    • Short circuit V2
    • Calculate equivalent resistance
    • Find current through each resistor
    • I1 = 1.2A, I2 = 0.8A, I3 = 0.4A
  2. Second Source Analysis (V2 only)
    • Short circuit V1
    • Calculate equivalent resistance
    • Find current through each resistor
    • I1 = 0.3A, I2 = 0.2A, I3 = 0.1A
  3. Final Results
    • Total current through R1: 1.5A
    • Total current through R2: 1.0A
    • Total current through R3: 0.5A

Key Points

  • Consider one source at a time
  • Use proper sign conventions
  • Verify results with Kirchhoff's laws
  • Check power calculations

    • 將V2短路
    • 計算等效電阻
    • 求各電阻電流

    • 將V1短路
    • 計算等效電阻

    • R1總電流：1.5A
    • R2總電流：1.0A

entry.title: Superposition Theorem: Practical Examples - 重疊定理：實際例題
entry.content:
Example 1: Two Voltage Sources

Let's analyze a circuit with two voltage sources using the Superposition Theorem.

Circuit Description

  • Two voltage sources: V1 = 10V, V2 = 5V
  • Three resistors: R1 = 2Ω, R2 = 3Ω, R3 = 4Ω
  • Find current through R2

Solution Steps

  1. Consider V1 only (V2 = 0)
    • Calculate equivalent resistance
    • Find current through R2
    • I1 = 1.5A
  2. Consider V2 only (V1 = 0)
    • Calculate equivalent resistance
    • Find current through R2
    • I2 = 0.5A
  3. Total current through R2
    • I = I1 + I2 = 2A

Example 2: Mixed Sources

Analyze a circuit with both voltage and current sources.

Circuit Description

  • Voltage source: V = 12V
  • Current source: I = 2A
  • Resistors: R1 = 4Ω, R2 = 6Ω
  • Find voltage across R2

Solution Steps

  1. Consider voltage source only
    • Current source becomes open circuit
    • Calculate voltage across R2
    • V1 = 7.2V
  2. Consider current source only
    • Voltage source becomes short circuit
    • Calculate voltage across R2
    • V2 = 4.8V
  3. Total voltage across R2
    • V = V1 + V2 = 12V

例題一：兩個電壓源

讓我們使用重疊定理分析一個包含兩個電壓源的電路。

電路描述

  • 兩個電壓源：V1 = 10V，V2 = 5V
  • 三個電阻：R1 = 2Ω，R2 = 3Ω，R3 = 4Ω
  • 求R2的電流

解題步驟

  1. 只考慮V1（V2 = 0）
    • 計算等效電阻
    • 求R2的電流
    • I1 = 1.5A
  2. 只考慮V2（V1 = 0）
    • 計算等效電阻
    • 求R2的電流
    • I2 = 0.5A
  3. R2的總電流
    • I = I1 + I2 = 2A

例題二：混合電源

分析一個同時包含電壓源和電流源的電路。

電路描述

  • 電壓源：V = 12V
  • 電流源：I = 2A
  • 電阻：R1 = 4Ω，R2 = 6Ω
  • 求R2的電壓

解題步驟

  1. 只考慮電壓源
    • 電流源變為斷路
    • 計算R2的電壓
    • V1 = 7.2V
  2. 只考慮電流源
    • 電壓源變為短路
    • 計算R2的電壓
    • V2 = 4.8V
  3. R2的總電壓
    • V = V1 + V2 = 12V

entry.title: Conversion Between Thevenin and Norton Equivalent Circuits - 戴維寧等效電路與諾頓等效電路的互換
entry.content:
Introduction

This article explains the conversion between Thevenin and Norton equivalent circuits, including the mathematical formulas and practical applications in circuit analysis.

Key Points

  • Basic Concepts

    • Complex linear circuits can be simplified
    • Two equivalent circuit forms:
      • Thevenin equivalent
      • Norton equivalent
    • Both represent same circuit behavior

  • Thevenin to Norton Conversion

    • Norton current formula:
      $$
      I_N = \frac{E_{th}}{R_{th}}
      $$
    • Norton resistance:
      $$
      R_N = R_{th}
      $$
    • Maintains circuit equivalence

  • Norton to Thevenin Conversion

    • Thevenin voltage formula:
      $$
      E_{th} = I_N \times R_N
      $$
    • Thevenin resistance:
      $$
      R_{th} = R_N
      $$
    • Preserves circuit characteristics

  • Important Considerations

    • Voltage polarity must match current direction
    • Current flows from positive voltage terminal
    • Equivalent resistance remains unchanged
    • Power calculations give same results

  • Analysis Steps

    • For equivalent voltage:
      • Calculate open-circuit voltage
      • Remove load for measurement
    • For equivalent resistance:
      • Short voltage sources
      • Remove current sources
      • Calculate total resistance

重點歸納

  • 基本概念

    • 複雜線性電路可以簡化
    • 兩種等效電路形式：
      • 戴維寧等效
      • 諾頓等效
    • 兩者表示相同電路行為

  • 戴維寧轉諾頓

    • 諾頓電流公式：
      $$
      I_N = \frac{E_{th}}{R_{th}}
      $$
    • 諾頓電阻：
      $$
      R_N = R_{th}
      $$
    • 保持電路等效性

  • 諾頓轉戴維寧

    • 戴維寧電壓公式：
      $$
      E_{th} = I_N \times R_N
      $$
    • 戴維寧電阻：
      $$
      R_{th} = R_N
      $$
    • 保持電路特性

  • 重要注意事項

    • 電壓極性需對應電流方向
    • 電流從電壓正端流出
    • 等效電阻保持不變
    • 功率計算結果相同

  • 分析步驟

    • 求等效電壓：
      • 計算開路電壓
      • 移除負載測量
    • 求等效電阻：
      • 將電壓源短路
      • 移除電流源
      • 計算總電阻

entry.title: Thevenin's Theorem: Advanced Comparison - 戴維寧定理：進階比較
entry.content:
Advanced Comparison of Circuit Analysis Methods

This article provides a detailed comparison of Thevenin’s Theorem with other advanced circuit analysis methods.

Comparison with Norton’s Theorem

  • Equivalent Circuits
    • Thevenin: Voltage source with series resistance
    • Norton: Current source with parallel resistance
  • Applications
    • Thevenin: Better for voltage analysis
    • Norton: Better for current analysis
  • Conversion
    • Vth = In * Rn
    • Rth = Rn

Comparison with Other Methods

  1. Mesh Analysis
    • Advantages
      • Systematic approach
      • Good for multiple loops
      • Direct current solutions
    • Disadvantages
      • More complex for large circuits
      • Requires more equations
  2. Node Analysis
    • Advantages
      • Systematic approach
      • Good for multiple nodes
      • Direct voltage solutions
    • Disadvantages
      • More complex for large circuits
      • Requires more equations
  3. Superposition Theorem
    • Advantages
      • Simple for multiple sources
      • Good for understanding effects
    • Disadvantages
      • Time-consuming
      • Not efficient for large circuits

When to Use Each Method

  • Thevenin’s Theorem
    • Load analysis
    • Power transfer
    • Circuit simplification
  • Norton’s Theorem
    • Current analysis
    • Parallel circuits
    • Current source modeling
  • Mesh Analysis
    • Multiple loop circuits
    • Current-based analysis
    • Systematic solutions
  • Node Analysis
    • Multiple node circuits
    • Voltage-based analysis
    • Systematic solutions
  • Superposition Theorem

    • Simple circuits

entry.title: Thevenin's Theorem: Advanced Solutions - 戴維寧定理：進階解答
entry.content:
Solutions to Advanced Practice Problems

This article provides detailed solutions to the advanced practice problems for Thevenin’s Theorem.

Problem 1: Bridge Circuit with Dependent Source

Solution:

  1. Find Vth:
    • Remove the load between A and B
    • Calculate Vx across R1
    • Vth = Vx + I1*R3
    • Vth = 8V + 2Vx*8Ω = 8V + 16V = 24V
  2. Find Rth:
    • Replace voltage source with short circuit
    • Replace current source with open circuit
    • Rth = (R1||R2) + (R3||R4)
    • Rth = 2.4Ω + 4.44Ω = 6.84Ω

Problem 2: Delta-Wye Transformation

Solution:

  1. Convert delta to wye:
    • Ra = (R1*R2)/(R1 + R2 + R3)
    • Rb = (R2*R3)/(R1 + R2 + R3)
    • Rc = (R1*R3)/(R1 + R2 + R3)
  2. Find Vth:
    • Vth = V1*(Rb + R4)/(Ra + Rb + R4)
    • Vth = 15.2V
  3. Find Rth:
    • Rth = (Ra + Rc)||(Rb + R4)
    • Rth = 7.8Ω

Problem 3: Complex Network with Multiple Sources

Solution:

  1. Find Vth:
    • Use superposition theorem
    • Vth1 = 18V (from V1)
    • Vth2 = 6V (from V2)
    • Vth3 = 8V (from I1)
    • Vth = Vth1 + Vth2 + Vth3 = 32V
  2. Find Rth:
    • Replace all sources with their internal resistances
    • Rth = (R1 + R2)||(R3 + R4)
    • Rth = 8.4Ω

Problem 4: Circuit with Capacitors and Inductors

Solution:

  1. Find Vth:
    • Calculate impedance of L1 and C1 at 60Hz
    • ZL = jωL = j37.7Ω
    • ZC = 1/(jωC) = -j26.5Ω
    • Vth = V1*(R2 + ZL)/(R1 + R2 + ZL + ZC)
    • Vth = 12.3∠45°V
  2. Find Zth:
    • Zth = (R1 + ZC)||(R2 + ZL)
    • Zth = 8.2 + j12.3Ω

Problem 5: Non-linear Circuit Approximation

Solution:

  1. Find Vth:
    • Consider diode as voltage source
    • Vth = V1 - Vf = 15V - 0.7V = 14.3V
  2. Find Rth:
    • Rth = R1 + R2
    • Rth = 13Ω

進階練習題解答

本文提供戴維寧定理進階練習題的詳細解答。

問題1：含相依電源的橋式電路

解答：

  1. 求Vth：
    • 移除A、B間的負載
    • 計算R1兩端的Vx
    • Vth = Vx + I1*R3
    • Vth = 8V + 2Vx*8Ω = 8V + 16V = 24V
  2. 求Rth：
    • 將電壓源替換為短路
    • 將電流源替換為開路
    • Rth = (R1||R2) + (R3||R4)
    • Rth = 2.4Ω + 4.44Ω = 6.84Ω

問題2：三角-星形轉換

解答：

  1. 三角轉星形：
    • Ra = (R1*R2)/(R1 + R2 + R3)
    • Rb = (R2*R3)/(R1 + R2 + R3)
    • Rc = (R1*R3)/(R1 + R2 + R3)
  2. 求Vth：
    • Vth = V1*(Rb + R4)/(Ra + Rb + R4)
    • Vth = 15.2V
  3. 求Rth：
    • Rth = (Ra + Rc)||(Rb + R4)
    • Rth = 7.8Ω

問題3：多電源複雜網路

解答：

  1. 求Vth：
    • 使用重疊定理
    • Vth1 = 18V（來自V1）
    • Vth2 = 6V（來自V2）
    • Vth3 = 8V（來自I1）
    • Vth = Vth1 + Vth2 + Vth3 = 32V
  2. 求Rth：
    • 將所有電源替換為其內阻
    • Rth = (R1 + R2)||(R3 + R4)
    • Rth = 8.4Ω

問題4：含電容和電感的電路

解答：

  1. 求Vth：
    • 計算L1和C1在60Hz下的阻抗
    • ZL = jωL = j37.7Ω
    • ZC = 1/(jωC) = -j26.5Ω
    • Vth = V1*(R2 + ZL)/(R1 + R2 + ZL + ZC)
    • Vth = 12.3∠45°V
  2. 求Zth：
    • Zth = (R1 + ZC)||(R2 + ZL)
    • Zth = 8.2 + j12.3Ω

問題5：非線性電路近似

解答：

  1. 求Vth：
    • 將二極體視為電壓源
    • Vth = V1 - Vf = 15V - 0.7V = 14.3V
  2. 求Rth：
    • Rth = R1 + R2
    • Rth = 13Ω

entry.title: Thevenin's Theorem: Comparison with Other Methods - 戴維寧定理：與其他方法比較
entry.content:
Comparison of Circuit Analysis Methods

This article compares Thevenin’s Theorem with other common circuit analysis methods.

Thevenin vs. Norton

  • Similarities
    • Both simplify complex circuits
    • Both use equivalent circuits
    • Both maintain terminal behavior
  • Differences
    • Thevenin: voltage source + series resistance
    • Norton: current source + parallel resistance
    • Different calculation methods

Comparison with Other Methods

  1. Mesh Analysis
    • More systematic approach
    • Better for multiple loops
    • More equations to solve
  2. Node Analysis
    • Good for parallel circuits
    • Easier for current sources
    • More nodes to consider
  3. Superposition
    • Good for multiple sources
    • Can be time-consuming
    • Limited to linear circuits

When to Use Each Method

  • Thevenin: Load analysis
  • Norton: Current analysis
  • Mesh: Complex networks
  • Node: Parallel circuits
  • Superposition: Multiple sources

電路分析方法比較

本文比較戴維寧定理與其他常見的電路分析方法。

戴維寧與諾頓比較

  • 相似點
    • 都能簡化複雜電路
    • 都使用等效電路
    • 都保持端點行為
  • 差異點
    • 戴維寧：電壓源+串聯電阻
    • 諾頓：電流源+並聯電阻
    • 計算方法不同

與其他方法比較

  1. 網目分析法
    • 更系統化的方法
    • 適合多迴路
    • 需要解更多方程式
  2. 節點分析法
    • 適合並聯電路
    • 電流源較簡單
    • 需要考慮更多節點
  3. 重疊定理
    • 適合多電源
    • 可能較耗時
    • 僅適用線性電路

各方法適用情況

  • 戴維寧：負載分析
  • 諾頓：電流分析
  • 網目：複雜網路
  • 節點：並聯電路
  • 重疊：多電源

entry.content:
Example 1: Simple Circuit

Let’s analyze a simple circuit using Thevenin’s Theorem.

Circuit Description

  • Voltage source: V = 10V
  • Resistors: R1 = 2Ω, R2 = 3Ω, R3 = 4Ω
  • Load resistor: RL = 5Ω

Solution Steps

  1. Find Thevenin Voltage (Vth)
    • Remove RL
    • Calculate open circuit voltage
    • Vth = 6V
  2. Find Thevenin Resistance (Rth)
    • Turn off voltage source
    • Calculate equivalent resistance
    • Rth = 2.4Ω
  3. Final Equivalent Circuit
    • Vth = 6V
    • Rth = 2.4Ω
    • RL = 5Ω

Example 2: Complex Circuit

Analyze a more complex circuit with multiple sources.

Circuit Description

  • Voltage sources: V1 = 12V, V2 = 6V
  • Current source: I = 2A
  • Resistors: R1 = 4Ω, R2 = 6Ω, R3 = 8Ω
  • Load resistor: RL = 10Ω

Solution Steps

  1. Find Thevenin Voltage (Vth)
    • Use superposition theorem
    • Calculate contributions from each source
    • Vth = 8V
  2. Find Thevenin Resistance (Rth)
    • Turn off all sources
    • Calculate equivalent resistance
    • Rth = 3.2Ω
  3. Final Equivalent Circuit
    • Vth = 8V
    • Rth = 3.2Ω
    • RL = 10Ω

讓我們使用戴維寧定理分析一個簡單電路。

  1. 求戴維寧電壓（Vth）
    • 移除RL
    • 計算開路電壓
    • Vth = 6V
  2. 求戴維寧電阻（Rth）
    • 關閉電壓源

    • Rth = 2.4Ω

    • Vth = 6V

entry.title: Thevenin's Theorem: Introduction and Basic Concepts - 戴維寧定理：介紹與基本概念
entry.content:
Introduction to Thevenin’s Theorem

Thevenin’s Theorem is a fundamental concept in circuit analysis that allows us to simplify complex circuits into a single voltage source and resistor combination.

Basic Principles

  • Any linear circuit can be replaced by an equivalent circuit
  • Equivalent circuit consists of:
    • A single voltage source (Vth)
    • A single resistor (Rth)
  • Equivalent circuit maintains same voltage-current relationship at terminals

Key Components

  1. Thevenin Voltage (Vth)
    • Open circuit voltage at terminals
    • Remove load resistor
    • Calculate voltage across open terminals
  2. Thevenin Resistance (Rth)
    • Equivalent resistance seen from terminals
    • Turn off all independent sources
    • Calculate resistance between terminals

Applications

  • Circuit simplification
  • Load analysis
  • Power transfer calculations
  • Circuit design optimization

戴維寧定理介紹

戴維寧定理是電路分析中的基本概念，它允許我們將複雜電路簡化為單一電壓源和電阻的組合。

基本原理

  • 任何線性電路都可以被等效電路取代
  • 等效電路由以下組成：
    • 單一電壓源（Vth）
    • 單一電阻（Rth）
  • 等效電路在端點保持相同的電壓-電流關係

關鍵元件

  1. 戴維寧電壓（Vth）
    • 端點開路電壓
    • 移除負載電阻
    • 計算開路端點間的電壓
  2. 戴維寧電阻（Rth）
    • 從端點看入的等效電阻
    • 關閉所有獨立電源
    • 計算端點間的電阻

應用

  • 電路簡化
  • 負載分析
  • 功率傳輸計算
  • 電路設計優化

文章日期：2025-05-14

entry.title: Thevenin's Theorem: Power Analysis - 戴維寧定理：功率分析
entry.content:
Power Analysis Using Thevenin’s Theorem

This article explains how to analyze power transfer in circuits using Thevenin’s Theorem.

Maximum Power Transfer

  • Conditions for maximum power
    • Load resistance equals Thevenin resistance
    • RL = Rth
    • Maximum power = Vth²/(4Rth)
  • Power transfer efficiency
    • Efficiency = 50% at maximum power
    • Higher efficiency at lower power
    • Trade-off between power and efficiency

Power Calculations

  1. Find Thevenin Equivalent
    • Calculate Vth
    • Calculate Rth
    • Draw equivalent circuit
  2. Calculate Power
    • P = I²R for current
    • P = V²/R for voltage
    • P = VI for both
  3. Optimize Load
    • Match load to Rth
    • Calculate maximum power
    • Consider efficiency

Practical Considerations

  • Source limitations
  • Temperature effects
  • Component ratings
  • System stability

使用戴維寧定理進行功率分析

本文解釋如何使用戴維寧定理分析電路中的功率傳輸。

最大功率傳輸

  • 最大功率條件
    • 負載電阻等於戴維寧電阻
    • RL = Rth
    • 最大功率 = Vth²/(4Rth)
  • 功率傳輸效率
    • 最大功率時效率為50%
    • 較低功率時效率較高
    • 功率和效率的取捨

功率計算

  1. 求戴維寧等效
    • 計算Vth
    • 計算Rth
    • 畫出等效電路
  2. 計算功率
    • 電流功率 P = I²R
    • 電壓功率 P = V²/R
    • 總功率 P = VI
  3. 優化負載
    • 負載匹配Rth
    • 計算最大功率
    • 考慮效率

實際考慮因素

  • 電源限制
  • 溫度效應
  • 元件額定值
  • 系統穩定性

entry.title: Thevenin's Theorem: Solutions to Practice Problems - 戴維寧定理：練習題解答
entry.content:
Solutions to Practice Problems

This article provides detailed solutions to the practice problems.

Problem 1: Simple Circuit

Solution:

  1. Calculate Vth:
    • Remove load between A and B
    • Vth = V1 * (R2 + R3)/(R1 + R2 + R3) + V2 * R3/(R1 + R2 + R3)
    • Vth = 10 * (3 + 4)/(2 + 3 + 4) + 5 * 4/(2 + 3 + 4)
    • Vth = 7.78V
  2. Calculate Rth:
    • Turn off all voltage sources
    • Rth = (R1 * (R2 + R3))/(R1 + R2 + R3)
    • Rth = (2 * (3 + 4))/(2 + 3 + 4)
    • Rth = 1.56Ω

Problem 2: Complex Circuit

Solution:

  1. Calculate Vth:
    • Remove load between A and B
    • Vth = V1 * R2/(R1 + R2) + I1 * R3
    • Vth = 12 * 4/(3 + 4) + 2 * 6
    • Vth = 18.86V
  2. Calculate Rth:
    • Turn off voltage source and current source
    • Rth = (R1 * R2)/(R1 + R2) + R3
    • Rth = (3 * 4)/(3 + 4) + 6
    • Rth = 7.71Ω

Problem 3: Mixed Sources

Solution:

  1. Calculate Vth:
    • Remove load between A and B
    • Vth = V1 * R2/(R1 + R2) + I1 * R3
    • Vth = 15 * 7/(5 + 7) + 3 * 9
    • Vth = 37.75V
  2. Calculate Rth:
    • Turn off voltage source and current source
    • Rth = (R1 * R2)/(R1 + R2) + R3
    • Rth = (5 * 7)/(5 + 7) + 9
    • Rth = 11.92Ω

entry.title: Thevenin's Theorem: Summary and Key Points - 戴維寧定理：總結與重點
entry.content:
Summary of Thevenin’s Theorem

This article provides a comprehensive summary of Thevenin’s Theorem and its key concepts.

Core Concepts

  • Any linear circuit can be replaced by an equivalent circuit
    • Single voltage source (Vth)
    • Single series resistance (Rth)
  • Equivalent circuit maintains same voltage-current relationship at terminals

Key Steps in Analysis

  1. Identify terminals of interest
  2. Calculate Thevenin voltage (Vth)
    • Open circuit voltage at terminals
    • Remove load if present
  3. Calculate Thevenin resistance (Rth)
    • Turn off all independent sources
    • Replace voltage sources with short circuits
    • Replace current sources with open circuits
  4. Draw equivalent circuit

Applications

  • Circuit simplification
  • Load analysis
  • Power transfer optimization
  • System design

Limitations

  • Only applies to linear circuits
  • Single frequency analysis
  • May not preserve internal power relationships

戴維寧定理總結

本文提供戴維寧定理及其關鍵概念的全面總結。

核心概念

  • 任何線性電路都可以被等效電路取代
    • 單一電壓源（Vth）
    • 單一串聯電阻（Rth）
  • 等效電路在端點保持相同的電壓-電流關係

分析關鍵步驟

  1. 識別感興趣的端點
  2. 計算戴維寧電壓（Vth）
    • 端點開路電壓
    • 移除負載（如果存在）
  3. 計算戴維寧電阻（Rth）
    • 關閉所有獨立電源
    • 將電壓源替換為短路
    • 將電流源替換為開路
  4. 繪製等效電路

應用

  • 電路簡化
  • 負載分析
  • 功率傳輸優化
  • 系統設計

限制

  • 僅適用於線性電路
  • 單一頻率分析
  • 可能不保留內部功率關係

entry.title: DC Network Analysis: Basics and Problem-Solving Steps of Node Voltage Method (Part A) - 直流網路分析：節點電壓法基礎與解題步驟（Part A）
entry.content:
Title

DC Network Analysis: Basics and Problem-Solving Steps of Node Voltage Method (Part A)

Key Points Summary:

  • Node Definition: A point where two or more components connect.
  • Reference Node: Set as zero potential (ground).
  • Kirchhoff’s Current Law (KCL): The sum of currents entering a node equals the sum leaving it.
  • Ohm’s Law: Voltage across a resistor equals current times resistance.
  • Node Voltage Method Steps:
    1. Set reference node (0V).
    2. Label unknown node voltages.
    3. Assume current directions and label them.
    4. Write KCL equations.
    5. Use Ohm’s law to express currents.
    6. Substitute into KCL equations.
    7. Solve for unknown node voltages.
    8. Substitute back to find branch currents.
  • Negative Current: Indicates opposite direction to assumed.
  • Verification: Check current conservation.

標題

直流網路分析：節點電壓法基礎與解題步驟（Part A）

重點歸納

  • 節點定義：兩個或以上元件連接的點。
  • 參考節點：設為零電位（接地點）。
  • 克希荷夫電流定律 (KCL)：任一節點流入電流總和等於流出電流總和。
  • 歐姆定律：電阻兩端電壓差等於電流乘以電阻。
  • 節點電壓法步驟：
    1. 設定參考節點（0V）。
    2. 標示未知節點電壓。
    3. 假設電流方向並標示。
    4. 寫出KCL方程式。
    5. 利用歐姆定律寫出電流算式。
    6. 代入KCL方程式。
    7. 解方程式求未知節點電壓。
    8. 代回求各支路電流。
  • 電流負號意義：方向與假設相反。
  • 驗算：確認電流守恆。
