entry.title: Analysis and Application of Delta (Δ) to Y-Shape Circuit Conversion - 三角形(Δ)轉換為Y形電路解析與應用
entry.content:
Title

Analysis and Application of Delta (Δ) to Y-Shape Circuit Conversion

Key Points:

  • The formula for converting delta resistors to Y resistors is:
    $$
    R_a = \frac{R_{12} \times R_{13}}{R_{12} + R_{23} + R_{13}}, \quad
    R_b = \frac{R_{12} \times R_{23}}{R_{12} + R_{23} + R_{13}}, \quad
    R_c = \frac{R_{23} \times R_{13}}{R_{12} + R_{23} + R_{13}}
    $$
  • Overlaying circuit diagrams helps in calculation and understanding.
  • Conversion simplifies complex circuits for easier total resistance and current calculation.
  • When the Wheatstone bridge is unbalanced, delta-Y conversion is necessary.
  • Example results: Ra=1Ω, Rb=2Ω, Rc=2Ω, with total resistance and current calculated.
  • Advanced problems use delta-to-Y conversion and comparison to solve unknown resistors.

標題

三角形(Δ)轉換為Y形電路解析與應用

重點歸納

  • 三角形電阻轉換為Y形電阻，計算公式為：
    $$
    R_a = \frac{R_{12} \times R_{13}}{R_{12} + R_{23} + R_{13}}, \quad
    R_b = \frac{R_{12} \times R_{23}}{R_{12} + R_{23} + R_{13}}, \quad
    R_c = \frac{R_{23} \times R_{13}}{R_{12} + R_{23} + R_{13}}
    $$
  • 透過重疊電路圖，方便計算與理解轉換關係。
  • 轉換後可簡化複雜電路，方便計算總電阻與總電流。
  • 惠斯登電橋不平衡時，必須使用三角形與Y形互換法。
  • 實例中計算出Ra=1Ω，Rb=2Ω，Rc=2Ω，並求出總電阻與總電流。
  • 進階題型中，利用三角形轉Y形後，透過比對求解未知電阻。

entry.title: Y-Δ Transformation Method (Y to Delta Conversion) - Y形變三角形互換法（Y-Δ變換法）
entry.content:
Title

Y-Δ Transformation Method (Y to Delta Conversion)

Key Points Summary:

  • Y and Delta resistor networks can be converted into each other; this section focuses on converting Y to Delta.
  • Y resistors are labeled Ra, Rb, Rc; Delta resistors are R1, R2, R3.
  • Y to Delta formula:
    $$ R_{ riangle} = \frac{\text{Sum of products of pairs of Y resistors}}{\text{Opposite Y resistor}} $$
  • The sum of products of pairs is: (Ra \times Rb + Rb \times Rc + Rc \times Ra).
  • Each Delta resistor is calculated by dividing this sum by the Y resistor opposite to it.
  • In practice, calculate the sum once and apply it to all three Delta resistors.
  • This method simplifies complex circuits for easier total resistance calculation.

標題

Y形變三角形互換法（Y-Δ變換法）

重點歸納

  • Y形與三角形電阻可以互換，本單元重點是Y形轉三角形的計算方法。
  • Y形電阻標為Ra, Rb, Rc，三角形電阻標為R1, R2, R3。
  • Y轉三角形公式：
    $$ R_{ riangle} = \frac{\text{Y形電阻兩兩相乘之和}}{\text{對邊的Y形電阻}} $$
  • 兩兩相乘之和為：(Ra \times Rb + Rb \times Rc + Rc \times Ra)。
  • R1、R2、R3分別除以離它最遠的Y形電阻。
  • 實務計算中，兩兩相乘之和只需算一次，後續套用即可。
  • 透過此法則可將複雜電路化簡，方便計算總電阻。

entry.title: Understanding Prefixes for Powers of Ten
entry.content:
Understanding Prefixes for Powers of Ten

Definition

Power of Ten: Represented as \(10^n\), used to simplify numerical representation.

定義

十的冪次方：表示為 \(10^n\)，用於簡化數字表示。

Prefixes and Their Meanings

Prefix Symbol Power Example
Tera T \(10^{12}\) 1 TΩ = \(1 \times 10^{12}\) Ω
Giga G \(10^{9}\) 1 GΩ = \(1 \times 10^{9}\) Ω
Mega M \(10^{6}\) 1 MΩ = \(1 \times 10^{6}\) Ω
Kilo k \(10^{3}\) 1 kΩ = \(1 \times 10^{3}\) Ω
Milli m \(10^{-3}\) 1 mA = \(1 \times 10^{-3}\) A
Micro μ \(10^{-6}\) 1 μF = \(1 \times 10^{-6}\) F
Nano n \(10^{-9}\) 1 nF = \(1 \times 10^{-9}\) F
Pico p \(10^{-12}\) 1 pF = \(1 \times 10^{-12}\) F

字首及其含義

字首 符號 冪次方 例子
兆 T \(10^{12}\) 1 TΩ = \(1 \times 10^{12}\) Ω
十億 G \(10^{9}\) 1 GΩ = \(1 \times 10^{9}\) Ω
百萬 M \(10^{6}\) 1 MΩ = \(1 \times 10^{6}\) Ω
千 k \(10^{3}\) 1 kΩ = \(1 \times 10^{3}\) Ω
毫 m \(10^{-3}\) 1 mA = \(1 \times 10^{-3}\) A
微 μ \(10^{-6}\) 1 μF = \(1 \times 10^{-6}\) F
奈 n \(10^{-9}\) 1 nF = \(1 \times 10^{-9}\) F
皮 p \(10^{-12}\) 1 pF = \(1 \times 10^{-12}\) F

*注意: 台灣對 p ($10^{-12}$) 的翻譯通常為「皮」，而非「漠」

Application

  • Simplifies numerical writing, avoiding errors.
  • Commonly used by engineers and scientists for calculations and communication.

應用

  • 簡化數字書寫，避免錯誤。
  • 工程師和科學家常用於計算和溝通。

Computer Terminology

In computing, the definitions of prefixes differ (based on powers of 2):

  • K (Kilo) = \(2^{10}\) = 1024
  • M (Mega) = \(2^{20}\) = 1,048,576
  • G (Giga) = \(2^{30}\) = 1,073,741,824

電腦術語

在電腦中，字首的定義不同 (基於2的冪次方)：

  • K（千） = \(2^{10}\) = 1024
  • M（百萬） = \(2^{20}\) = 1,048,576
  • G（十億） = \(2^{30}\) = 1,073,741,824

Examples

  • Resistor: 47 kΩ = \(47 \times 10^{3}\) Ω
  • Current: 0.005 A = 5 mA = \(5 \times 10^{-3}\) A

例子

  • 電阻：47 kΩ = \(47 \times 10^{3}\) Ω
  • 電流：0.005 A = 5 mA = \(5 \times 10^{-3}\) A

entry.title: High School Basic Electricity_AC Power_Apparent Power_PART A Apparent Power_Prof. Chen Cheng-Hsu
entry.content:
High School Basic Electricity_AC Power_Apparent Power_PART A Apparent Power_Prof. Chen Cheng-Hsu

This article explains the concepts of apparent power, average power, and reactive power in AC circuits, including their formulas, physical meanings, and real-life analogies.

Key Points (English)

  • Apparent Power (S): The product of voltage (V) and current (I), representing the total power in the circuit. Unit: volt-ampere (VA).
  • Average Power (P): The real power consumed by a pure resistive load, analogous to rent—actual energy spent.
  • Reactive Power (Q): The power stored and released by inductive and capacitive loads, analogous to a deposit—eventually returned.
  • Meaning of Apparent Power:
    • At the source: Total power delivered to the load.
    • At the load: Rated capacity and rated current of electrical equipment.
  • Apparent Power Formula:
    $$
    S = VI = I^2 Z = \frac{V^2}{Z}
    $$
    Unit: volt-ampere (VA).
  • English Terms:
    • Apparent Power: 視在功率
    • Average Power (or Real Power): 平均功率
    • Reactive Power: 虛功率
  • Real-life Analogy:
    • Rent (Average Power): Actual expense.
    • Deposit (Reactive Power): Temporarily paid, eventually returned.
    • Apparent Power: The sum of rent and deposit, representing the total amount you need to prepare.

高中基本電學_交流電功率_視在功率_PART A 視在功率_陳政旭

本文說明交流電路中視在功率、平均功率與虛功率的定義、公式、物理意義與生活化比喻。

重點歸納（中文）

  • 視在功率 (Apparent Power)：電壓 (V) 與電流 (I) 的乘積，表示電路中電壓與電流的總功率，單位為伏安 (VA)。
  • 平均功率 (Average Power)：純電阻負載消耗的實際功率，類比為租房的租金，是實際花費的能量。
  • 虛功率 (Reactive Power)：電感與電容負載儲存並釋放能量的功率，類比為押金，最後會退還。
  • 視在功率的意義：
    • 電源端：表示電源輸送給負載的總功率。
    • 負載端：表示電力設備的額定容量與額定電流。
  • 視在功率的計算公式：
    $$
    S = VI = I^2 Z = \frac{V^2}{Z}
    $$
    單位為伏安 (VA)。
  • 英文翻譯：
    • 視在功率：Apparent Power
    • 平均功率：Average Power (或 Real Power)
    • 虛功率：Reactive Power
  • 生活化比喻：
    • 租金（平均功率）是實際花費。
    • 押金（虛功率）是暫時繳納，最後會退還。
    • 視在功率是租金加押金的總和，代表你必須準備的總金額。

High School Basic Electricity_AC Power_Apparent Power_PART A Apparent Power_Prof. Chen Cheng-Hsu

This article explains the concepts of apparent power, average power, and reactive power in AC circuits, including their formulas, physical meanings, and real-life analogies.

Key Points (English)

  • Apparent Power (S): The product of voltage (V) and current (I), representing the total power in the circuit. Unit: volt-ampere (VA).
  • Average Power (P): The real power consumed by a pure resistive load, analogous to rent—actual energy spent.
  • Reactive Power (Q): The power stored and released by inductive and capacitive loads, analogous to a deposit—eventually returned.
  • Meaning of Apparent Power:
    • At the source: Total power delivered to the load.
    • At the load: Rated capacity and rated current of electrical equipment.
  • Apparent Power Formula:
    $$
    S = VI = I^2 Z = \frac{V^2}{Z}
    $$
    Unit: volt-ampere (VA).
  • English Terms:
    • Apparent Power: 視在功率
    • Average Power (or Real Power): 平均功率
    • Reactive Power: 虛功率
  • Real-life Analogy:
    • Rent (Average Power): Actual expense.
    • Deposit (Reactive Power): Temporarily paid, eventually returned.
    • Apparent Power: The sum of rent and deposit, representing the total amount you need to prepare.

  • 平均功率 (Average Power)：純電阻負載消耗的實際功率，類比為租房的租金，是實際花費的能量。
  • 虛功率 (Reactive Power)：電感與電容負載儲存並釋放能量的功率，類比為押金，最後會退還。
  • 視在功率的意義：
    • 電源端：表示電源輸送給負載的總功率。
    • 負載端：表示電力設備的額定容量與額定電流。
  • 視在功率的計算公式：
    $$
    S = VI = I^2 Z = \frac{V^2}{Z}
    $$
    單位為伏安 (VA)。
  • 英文翻譯：
    • 視在功率：Apparent Power
    • 平均功率：Average Power (或 Real Power)

entry.title: High School Basic Electricity_AC Power_Average Power_PART A Definition and Example of Average Power Calculation_Prof. Chen Cheng-Hsu
entry.content:
High School Basic Electricity_AC Power_Average Power_PART A Definition and Example of Average Power Calculation_Prof. Chen Cheng-Hsu

This article explains the definition of average power in AC circuits, the calculation formula, the effect of phase difference, and provides a detailed example.

Key Points

  • Definition of Average Power: The average power is the mean value of the instantaneous power ( p(t) ) over a complete cycle.
  • Voltage and Current Waveforms:
    • Voltage ( v(t) = V_m \sin(\omega t) ) with phase angle set to 0° for simplicity.
    • Current ( i(t) = I_m \sin(\omega t - \theta) ).
  • Instantaneous Power Formula:
    $$
    p(t) = v(t) \times i(t) = VI \cos \theta - VI \cos(2\omega t - \theta)
    $$
  • Average Power Calculation:
    • ( VI \cos \theta ) is a constant, product of RMS values and cosine of phase angle.
    • ( VI \cos(2\omega t - \theta) ) is a symmetric sinusoid with zero average.
    • Therefore, average power ( P = VI \cos \theta ).
  • Effect of Phase Difference: If voltage and current have phase angles ( \theta_v ) and ( \theta_i ), then
    $$
    P = VI \cos(\theta_v - \theta_i)
    $$
  • Example Calculation:
    • Voltage: ( v(t) = 50\sqrt{2} \sin(377t + 30^\circ) ), RMS ( V = 50 ), phase angle ( \theta_v = 30^\circ ).
    • Current: ( i(t) = 5\sqrt{2} \sin(377t - 30^\circ) ), RMS ( I = 5 ), phase angle ( \theta_i = -30^\circ ).
    • Average power:
      $$
      P = 50 \times 5 \times \cos(30^\circ - (-30^\circ)) = 250 \times \cos 60^\circ = 125 \text{W}
      $$

高中基本電學_交流電功率_平均功率_PART A 平均功率定義、範例：平均功率計算_陳政旭

本文說明交流電平均功率的定義、計算公式、相位差影響，並提供詳細範例。

重點歸納

  • 平均功率定義：平均功率是完整週期內瞬間功率 ( p(t) ) 的平均值。
  • 電壓與電流波形：
    • 電壓 ( v(t) = V_m \sin(\omega t) )，相位角設為0度方便說明。
    • 電流 ( i(t) = I_m \sin(\omega t - \theta) )。
  • 瞬間功率公式：
    $$
    p(t) = v(t) \times i(t) = VI \cos \theta - VI \cos(2\omega t - \theta)
    $$
  • 平均功率計算：
    • ( VI \cos \theta ) 是常數，為有效值乘上相位角的餘弦。
    • ( VI \cos(2\omega t - \theta) ) 是正負對稱的正弦波，平均值為0。
    • 因此平均功率 ( P = VI \cos \theta )。
  • 相位差影響：若電壓與電流相位角分別為 ( \theta_v ) 與 ( \theta_i )，則
    $$
    P = VI \cos(\theta_v - \theta_i)
    $$
  • 範例計算：
    • 電壓：( v(t) = 50\sqrt{2} \sin(377t + 30^\circ) )，有效值 ( V = 50 )，相位角 ( \theta_v = 30^\circ )。
    • 電流：( i(t) = 5\sqrt{2} \sin(377t - 30^\circ) )，有效值 ( I = 5 )，相位角 ( \theta_i = -30^\circ )。
    • 平均功率：
      $$
      P = 50 \times 5 \times \cos(30^\circ - (-30^\circ)) = 250 \times \cos 60^\circ = 125 \text{瓦}
      $$

entry.title: 交流電路功率綜合練習（Part E 範例） / Comprehensive Practice of AC Circuit Power (Part E Example)
entry.content:
English Version

Title

Comprehensive Practice of AC Circuit Power (Part E Example)

Introduction

  • Scope: Use given time-domain waveforms to construct phasors and compute PF, S, P, and Q.
  • Why it matters: Connect time-domain signals to phasor-domain analysis for power calculations.
  • What you’ll learn: Convert cos to sin with a phase shift, identify load type, and compute power quantities.

Key Points

  • Given:
    • ( v(t) = 200\sqrt{2} \cos(500t) )
    • ( i(t) = 20\sqrt{2} \sin(500t) )
  • Phase relation:
    • ( v(t) = 200\sqrt{2} \sin(500t + 90^\circ) )
    • Voltage phasor: ( 200 \angle 90^\circ )
    • Current phasor: ( 20 \angle 0^\circ )
    • ( \Delta\theta = 90^\circ ) → current lags 90° → pure inductive load.
  • Load type and value:
    • Pure inductive
    • ( X_L = V/I = 10,\Omega )
    • ( L = X_L/\omega = 10/500 = 20,\text{mH} )
  • PF: ( \cos 90^\circ = 0 ) → PF = 0 (lagging)
  • Apparent power: ( S = V I = 200 \times 20 = 4000 ) VA
  • Active power: ( P = VI\cos\theta = 0 )
  • Reactive power: ( Q = VI\sin\theta = 4000 ) var

Reference

  • YouTube: AC Power Comprehensive Practice – Part E

中文版

標題

交流電路功率綜合練習（Part E 範例）

前言

  • 主題範圍：由時域波形建立相量，並計算 PF、S、P、Q。
  • 為何重要：將時域訊號與相量分析連結，完成功率計算。
  • 你將學到：將 cos 轉為 sin 並加入相位、判定負載型態、計算各功率量。

重點統整

  • 已知：
    • ( v(t) = 200\sqrt{2} \cos(500t) )
    • ( i(t) = 20\sqrt{2} \sin(500t) )
  • 相位關係：
    • ( v(t) = 200\sqrt{2} \sin(500t + 90^\circ) )
    • 電壓相量：( 200 \angle 90^\circ )
    • 電流相量：( 20 \angle 0^\circ )
    • 相位差 (90^\circ)：電流滯後 90° → 純電感負載
  • 負載種類與數值：
    • 純電感
    • ( X_L = V/I = 10,\Omega )
    • ( L = X_L/\omega = 10/500 = 20,\text{mH} )
  • 功率因數：( \cos 90^\circ = 0 ) → PF = 0（滯後）
  • 視在功率：( S = V I = 200 \times 20 = 4000 ) VA
  • 平均功率：( P = VI\cos\theta = 0 )
  • 無功功率：( Q = VI\sin\theta = 4000 ) var

entry.title: AC Power:Instantaneous Power Equation Analysis
entry.content:
AC Power: Instantaneous Power Equation Analysis

Key Points

  • Introduction to basic concepts and analysis techniques of AC power
  • Definition and formula of instantaneous power: ( p(t) = v(t) \times i(t) )
  • Sinusoidal expressions for voltage and current:
    • Voltage: ( v(t) = V_m \sin(\omega t + \theta_v) )
    • Current: ( i(t) = I_m \sin(\omega t + \theta_i) )
  • Mathematical method for calculating instantaneous power using cosine difference and sum formulas
  • Definition of RMS value: peak value divided by (\sqrt{2})
  • Mnemonic for instantaneous power formula:
    ( p(t) = VI \cos(\theta_v - \theta_i) - VI \cos(2\omega t + \theta_v + \theta_i) )

交流電功率：瞬間功率方程式解析

  • 瞬間功率計算的數學技巧：利用餘弦差角與和角公式

entry.title: Instantaneous Power and Waveform Analysis of AC Power (Part B)
entry.content:
Instantaneous Power and Waveform Analysis of AC Power (Part B)

Key Points

  • AC voltage waveform can be represented as a combination of a DC value and a sinusoidal wave, e.g., ( v(t) = 5 + 12 \sin \omega t )
  • The DC part is a constant voltage (5V), unchanged over time
  • The AC part is a sinusoidal wave with amplitude 12V, oscillating around the DC level
  • Instantaneous power formula is ( p(t) = VI \cos \theta - VI \cos (2 \omega t - \theta) )
  • Instantaneous power waveform consists of a constant DC component and an AC sinusoidal component
  • Current waveform lags voltage by a phase angle (\theta)

交流電功率的瞬間功率與波形解析（Part B）

重點歸納

  • 交流電壓波形可由直流值與正弦波組合而成，例：( v(t) = 5 + 12 \sin \omega t )
  • 直流部分為常數電壓（5V），不隨時間變化
  • 交流部分為正弦波，振幅為12V，上下震盪於直流準位上下
  • 瞬間功率公式為 ( p(t) = VI \cos \theta - VI \cos (2 \omega t - \theta) )
  • 瞬間功率波形由一個常數直流值與一個交流正弦波組成
  • 電流波形滯後電壓一個相位角 (\theta)

entry.title: 高中基本電學_交流電功率_PART B 範例：PT/QT/ST 與 PF（電路圖題型一）
entry.content:
English Version

Title

Basic Electrical Engineering – AC Power – PART B Example: PT, QT, ST, and PF (Circuit Diagram Type 1)

Introduction

  • Scope: Compute total active, reactive, and apparent power plus PF from a multi-branch circuit.
  • Why it matters: Aggregating branch P and Q correctly is essential to get the overall PF right.
  • What you’ll learn: Branch RMS currents, branch P/Q, totals PT/QT, and ST, PF derivation.

Key Points Summary

  • Problem type: Circuit diagram Type 1 → find PT, QT, ST, PF.
  • Currents:
    • Source RMS voltage = 200 V.
    • Each branch impedance = 20 Ω → ( I_1 = I_2 = I_3 = 10 ) A (RMS).
  • Total Active Power (P_T):
    • ( P_1 = I_1^2 \times 20 = 10^2 \times 20 = 2000 ) W
    • ( P_2 = I_2^2 \times 16 = 10^2 \times 16 = 1600 ) W
    • ( P_3 = I_3^2 \times 16 = 10^2 \times 16 = 1600 ) W
    • ( P_T = 2000 + 1600 + 1600 = 5200 ) W
  • Total Reactive Power (Q_T):
    • Inductive: ( Q_L = I_2^2 \times 12 = 10^2 \times 12 = 1200 ) var
    • Capacitive: ( Q_C = I_3^2 \times 12 = 10^2 \times 12 = 1200 ) var
    • ( Q_T = |Q_L - Q_C| = 0 ) var
  • Total Apparent Power (S_T):
    • ( S_T = \sqrt{P_T^2 + Q_T^2} = \sqrt{5200^2 + 0} = 5200 ) VA
  • Power Factor (PF):
    • ( PF = P_T / S_T = 5200/5200 = 1 )

Reference

  • YouTube: PART B – Type 1 Example: PT/QT/ST/PF

中文版

標題

高中基本電學_交流電功率_PART B 範例：PT/QT/ST 與 PF（電路圖題型一）

前言

  • 主題範圍：由多支路電路計算總平均功率、總虛功率、總視在功率與功率因數。
  • 為何重要：正確彙總各支路的 P 與 Q 才能得到正確的整體 PF。
  • 你將學到：求支路電流、支路 P/Q，加總得到 PT/QT，再求 ST 與 PF。

重點統整

  • 題型：電路圖題型一，求 PT、QT、ST、PF。
  • 電流計算：
    • 電源電壓有效值 200 V。
    • 各支路阻抗皆 20 Ω → ( I_1 = I_2 = I_3 = 10 ) A（有效值）。
  • 總平均功率 (P_T)：
    • ( P_1 = I_1^2 \times 20 = 10^2 \times 20 = 2000 ) W
    • ( P_2 = I_2^2 \times 16 = 10^2 \times 16 = 1600 ) W
    • ( P_3 = I_3^2 \times 16 = 10^2 \times 16 = 1600 ) W
    • ( P_T = 2000 + 1600 + 1600 = 5200 ) W
  • 總虛功率 (Q_T)：
    • 電感：( Q_L = I_2^2 \times 12 = 10^2 \times 12 = 1200 ) var
    • 電容：( Q_C = I_3^2 \times 12 = 10^2 \times 12 = 1200 ) var
    • ( Q_T = |Q_L - Q_C| = 0 ) var
  • 總視在功率 (S_T)：
    • ( S_T = \sqrt{P_T^2 + Q_T^2} = \sqrt{5200^2 + 0} = 5200 ) VA
  • 功率因數 (PF)：
    • ( PF = P_T / S_T = 5200/5200 = 1 )

entry.title: 高中基本電學_交流電功率_功率因數之改善_PART A 為何要改善功率因數？
entry.content:
English Version

Title

High School Basic Electricity – AC Power – Power Factor Improvement – PART A: Why Improve Power Factor?

Introduction

  • Scope: Explain the meaning of power factor (PF), the downsides of low PF, and benefits of improvement.
  • Why it matters: PF impacts losses, voltage regulation, and equipment sizing; utilities also price by PF.
  • What you’ll learn: Practical reasons and typical outcomes of PF correction in distribution systems.

Key Points Summary

  • Meaning of PF: PF = active power / apparent power; PF 71% → only 71% useful, 29% reactive.
  • Effects of low PF:
    • Higher input current → more copper, higher line losses ((I^2R)).
    • Larger voltage drop → degraded power quality.
    • Bigger capacity required for transformers/generators.
  • Benefits of improving PF:
    • Save electricity bills (penalized < 80%, discounts > 80% vary by utility).
    • Reduce input current, increasing line/transformer capacity.
    • Improve power quality; stabilize voltage.
    • Extend equipment lifespan.

Reference

  • YouTube: Power Factor Improvement – PART A

中文版

標題

高中基本電學_交流電功率_功率因數之改善_PART A 為何要改善功率因數？

前言

  • 主題範圍：說明功率因數（PF）的意義、低 PF 的不利影響，以及改善之效益。
  • 為何重要：PF 影響線路損失、電壓調節與設備容量，亦與電費計價相關。
  • 你將學到：配電系統進行 PF 改善的實務原因與常見成效。

重點統整

  • 功率因數意義：PF = 有效功率 / 視在功率；PF 71% → 有效利用 71%，29% 為虛功。
  • PF 低的影響：
    • 輸入電流提高 → 導線銅量增加、線路損失（(I^2R)）變大。
    • 線路壓降上升 → 供電品質變差。
    • 變壓器、發電設備所需容量提高。
  • 改善 PF 的好處：
    • 節省電費（多數電力公司 PF < 80% 加收費用；> 80% 依規有折扣）。
    • 降低輸入電流，提升線路與變壓器供電能力。
    • 改善供電品質、穩定電壓。
    • 延長電力設備壽命。

參考

entry.title: 高中基本電學_交流電功率_PART D 範例：PT、QT、ST 及 PF 方塊圖題型（二範例）
entry.content:
English Version

Title

High School Basic Electricity – AC Power – PART D Examples: PT, QT, ST and PF Block Diagram Problems (Two Examples)

Introduction

  • Scope: Use block diagrams to represent load powers, then compute total PT, QT, ST, and PF.
  • Why it matters: Block diagrams help visualize contributions of different loads and avoid sign mistakes in Q.
  • What you’ll learn: Summation strategies for PT/QT, relation to ST, and PF interpretation (leading vs. lagging).

Key Points Summary

  • Block Diagram Problem Type: Represent powers per load to streamline total calculations.
  • Total Active Power (PT): Sum of all loads’ active powers.
  • Total Reactive Power (QT): Absolute difference between inductive and capacitive reactive powers.
  • Total Apparent Power (ST): ( S_T = \sqrt{P_T^2 + Q_T^2} ).
  • Power Factor (PF): ( PF = \dfrac{P_T}{S_T} ), label as leading or lagging.
  • Example 1: Compute PT, QT, ST, PF directly from given blocks.
  • Example 2: Infer missing values via PF–S relation before summing totals.

Reference

  • YouTube: AC Power – PART D: Block Diagram Examples for PT/QT/ST/PF

中文版

標題

高中基本電學_交流電功率_PART D 範例：PT、QT、ST 及 PF 方塊圖題型（二範例）

前言

  • 主題範圍：用方塊圖呈現各負載功率，進而計算總 PT、QT、ST 與 PF。
  • 為何重要：方塊圖可清楚看出各負載的貢獻，避免 Q 正負號混淆。
  • 你將學到：PT/QT 加總策略、與 ST 之關係，以及 PF（超前/滯後）的判讀。

重點統整

  • 方塊圖題型介紹：以方塊圖表示負載功率，方便計算總功率。
  • 總平均功率 PT 計算：將各負載平均功率相加。
  • 總虛功率 QT 計算：電感虛功率減去電容虛功率的絕對值。
  • 總視在功率 ST 計算：( S_T = \sqrt{P_T^2 + Q_T^2} )。
  • 功率因數 PF 計算：( PF = \dfrac{P_T}{S_T} )，並判斷超前或滯後。
  • 範例一：依方塊圖數據直接計算 PT、QT、ST、PF。
  • 範例二：部分數據缺失，先用 PF 與視在功率關係間接求未知功率，再計算總功率與功率因數。

entry.content:
English Version

Title

Basic Electrical Engineering – AC Power – Problem Type 2: Steps for PT/QT/ST and PF (PART A, Extended)

Introduction

  • Scope: Solve a representative circuit (type 2) by computing branch currents, then PT, QT, ST, and PF.
  • Why it matters: A structured flow avoids mixing P and Q contributions and clarifies lagging vs. leading PF.
  • What you’ll learn: How to apply current division, sum active/reactive power, and derive overall apparent power and PF.

Key Points Summary

  1. Example Problem Introduction
    • Circuit type 2 for PT, QT, ST, and PF
    • Tasks: compute powers and power factor
  2. Calculation of Branch Currents
    • Use current division to obtain RMS currents ( I_1, I_2, I_3 )
    • ( I_1, I_2 ) via impedance division; ( I_3 ) equals total current
  3. Total Active Power (P_T)
    • Resistor power: ( P = I^2 R )
    • Sum power on 5 Ω and 1 Ω resistors
  4. Total Reactive Power (Q_T)
    • Reactors/capacitor: ( Q = I^2 X )
    • Sum inductive Q and subtract capacitive Q
  5. Total Apparent Power (S_T)
    • ( S_T = \sqrt{P_T^2 + Q_T^2} )
  6. Power Factor (PF)
    • ( PF = \dfrac{P_T}{S_T} ), indicate lagging (inductive) or leading (capacitive)

Reference

  • YouTube: AC Power – Problem Type 2: PT/QT/ST and PF

中文版

標題

高中基本電學_交流電功率_題型二：PT/QT/ST 與 PF 的計算步驟_PART A（延伸）

前言

  • 主題範圍：針對題型二，先由各支路電流著手，依序求 PT、QT、ST 與 PF。
  • 為何重要：流程化可避免 P、Q 來源混淆，並正確判定滯後/超前功率因數。
  • 你將學到：分流定則應用、P/Q 加總、視在功率與功率因數的整體推導。

重點統整

  1. 範例題目介紹
    • 介紹 PT、QT、ST 與 PF 的電路圖題型二
    • 求各項功率與功率因數
  2. 各支路電流計算
    • 使用分流定則計算 ( I_1, I_2, I_3 )（有效值）
    • ( I_1, I_2 ) 由阻抗分流；( I_3 ) 與總電流相同
  3. 總平均功率 (P_T) 計算
    • 電阻功率：( P = I^2 R )
    • 計算 5 Ω 與 1 Ω 電阻功率並相加
  4. 總虛功率 (Q_T) 計算
    • 電感/電容的虛功率：( Q = I^2 X )
    • 電感虛功率相加後減去電容虛功率
  5. 總視在功率 (S_T) 計算
    • ( S_T = \sqrt{P_T^2 + Q_T^2} )
  6. 功率因數 (PF) 計算
    • ( PF = \dfrac{P_T}{S_T} )，結果標註滯後（電感性）或超前（電容性）

entry.content:
English Version

Title

Basic Electrical Engineering – AC Power: Total Active Power (PT), Total Reactive Power (QT), Total Apparent Power (ST), and Power Factor (PF) Calculation Steps – PART A

Introduction

  • Scope: A structured procedure to compute PT, QT, ST, and PF, including multi-branch circuits.
  • Why it matters: Avoids phase mistakes by summing branch powers correctly before deriving system PF.
  • What you’ll learn: From branch RMS currents → branch P/Q → totals PT/QT → ST and PF.

Key Points Summary

  • ( S = V I )
  • ( P = S\cos\theta )
  • ( Q = S\sin\theta )
  • ( PF = \cos\theta )
  • Complex circuits: first find each branch RMS current, then compute each branch’s (P_i, Q_i)
  • ( P_T = \sum P_i )
  • ( Q_T = |Q_L - Q_C| )
  • ( S_T = \sqrt{P_T^2 + Q_T^2} )
  • ( PF = P_T/S_T )
  • Inductive loads → lagging PF; capacitive loads → leading PF

中文版

標題

高中基本電學_交流電功率_總平均功率PT、總虛功率QT、總視在功率ST及功率因數PF求解步驟_PART A

  • 主題範圍：以流程化方式求 PT、QT、ST 與 PF，並適用於多支路電路。

  • 你將學到：從各支路電流有效值 → 支路 (P_i/Q_i) → 總 (P_T/Q_T) → (S_T)、(PF)。

重點統整

  • 視在功率：( S = V I )
  • 平均功率：( P = S\cos\theta )
  • 虛功率：( Q = S\sin\theta )
  • 功率因數：( PF = \cos\theta )
  • 複雜電路：先求各支路電流有效值，再計算各支路 (P_i)、(Q_i)
  • 總平均功率：( P_T = \sum P_i )
  • 總虛功率：( Q_T = |Q_L - Q_C| )
  • 總視在功率：( S_T = \sqrt{P_T^2 + Q_T^2} )
  • 功率因數：( PF = P_T/S_T )
  • 負載性質：電感性→滯後、電容性→超前

entry.content:
English Version

Title

Basic Electrical Engineering - AC Power: Total Active Power (PT), Total Reactive Power (QT), Total Apparent Power (ST), and Power Factor (PF) Calculation Steps_PART A

Introduction

  • Scope: A step-by-step method to compute PT, QT, ST, and PF for AC circuits, including multi-branch cases.
  • Why it matters: Summarizing P and Q across branches avoids phase mistakes and leads to a reliable overall PF.
  • What you’ll learn: How to get branch RMS currents, compute branch P and Q, aggregate to PT/QT, then obtain ST and PF.

Key Points Summary

  • Apparent power: ( S = V \times I )
  • Active (average) power: ( P = S \times \cos\theta )
  • Reactive power: ( Q = S \times \sin\theta )
  • Power factor: ( PF = \cos\theta )
  • For complex circuits: first find RMS current of each branch, then compute each branch’s (P_i) and (Q_i)
  • Total active power: ( P_T = \sum P_i )
  • Total reactive power: ( Q_T = |Q_L - Q_C| ) (absolute difference between inductive and capacitive reactive power)
  • Total apparent power: ( S_T = \sqrt{P_T^2 + Q_T^2} )
  • Power factor: ( PF = \dfrac{P_T}{S_T} )
  • Inductive loads → lagging PF; capacitive loads → leading PF

Reference

  • YouTube: AC Power – PT/QT/ST and PF Calculation Steps (PART A)

中文版

標題

高中基本電學_交流電功率_總平均功率PT、總虛功率QT、總視在功率ST及功率因數PF求解步驟_PART A

前言

  • 主題範圍：以步驟化方式說明 AC 電路中 PT、QT、ST 與 PF 的求解流程，亦涵蓋多支路電路。
  • 為何重要：先分支後總結的方式可避免相位判斷錯誤，得到可靠的整體功率因數。
  • 你將學到：如何求各支路電流有效值、計算各支路 (P_i)、(Q_i)，再彙總得到 (P_T)、(Q_T)，進而求得 (S_T) 與 (PF)。

重點統整

  • 視在功率：( S = V \times I )
  • 平均功率：( P = S \times \cos\theta )
  • 虛功率：( Q = S \times \sin\theta )
  • 功率因數：( PF = \cos\theta )
  • 複雜電路：先求各支路電流有效值，再計算各支路的 (P_i)、(Q_i)
  • 總平均功率：( P_T = \sum P_i )

  • 功率因數：( PF = \dfrac{P_T}{S_T} )

entry.title: 視在功率範例解析（Part B）
entry.content:
English Version

Title

Apparent Power Examples (Part B)

Introduction

  • Scope: Walk through three typical scenarios of apparent power S in AC circuits: phasor product, complex impedance, and transformer ratings.
  • Why it matters: Apparent power bridges voltage and current magnitudes regardless of phase, underpinning sizing of equipment and conductors.
  • What you’ll learn: How to compute S, separate it into P and Q when impedance is known, and apply kVA ratings to estimate allowable currents.

Key Points

  1. Example 1: Apparent Power in Single-Phase AC Circuit

    • Voltage ( V = 10 \angle 60^\circ ) V
    • Current ( I = 10 \angle 15^\circ ) A
    • Apparent power ( S = V \times I = 100 ) VA

  2. Example 2: Power Calculation with Complex Impedance

    • Impedance ( Z = 8 + j6 ) Ω (8 Ω resistor in series with inductive reactance 6 Ω)
    • Current ( I = 10 ) A
    • Real power ( P = I^2 R = 800 ) W
    • Reactive power ( Q = I^2 X_L = 600 ) VAR
    • Apparent power ( S = I^2 |Z| = 1000 ) VA

  3. Example 3: Transformer Maximum Input and Output Current

    • Rated apparent power ( S = 10,\text{kVA} )
    • Input voltage ( V_{in} = 2000,\text{V} ), output voltage ( V_{out} = 200,\text{V} )
    • Maximum input current ( I_{in} = \dfrac{S}{V_{in}} = 5,\text{A} )
    • Maximum output current ( I_{out} = \dfrac{S}{V_{out}} = 50,\text{A} )

Reference

  • YouTube: High school basic electricity – AC power – Apparent Power PART B (Examples)

標題

視在功率範例解析（Part B）

前言

  • 主題範圍：透過三個常見情境認識視在功率 S 的計算：相量相乘、複數阻抗分解、變壓器容量應用。
  • 為何重要：視在功率連結電壓與電流的大小（不論相位），是設備與線路容量選用的依據。
  • 你將學到：如何計算 S、在已知阻抗時拆解為 P 與 Q，以及運用 kVA 額定值估算允許電流。

重點統整

  1. 範例一：單相交流電路視在功率

    • 電壓 ( V = 10 \angle 60^\circ ) 伏特
    • 電流 ( I = 10 \angle 15^\circ ) 安培
    • 視在功率 ( S = V \times I = 100 ) 伏安

  2. 範例二：複數阻抗的功率計算

entry.title: Basic Electricity Volume 1 Chapter 5 Section 5-2 Capacitance
entry.content:
Basic Electricity Volume 1 Chapter 5 Section 5-2 Capacitance

Key Points Summary

  • The capacitance of a capacitor depends on the dielectric constant, plate area, and plate distance.
  • Capacitance formula:
    $$
    C = \frac{\varepsilon A}{d}
    $$
    where
    • ( \varepsilon = \varepsilon_r \times \varepsilon_0 ) (dielectric constant)
    • ( A ) is the plate area (in square meters)
    • ( d ) is the distance between plates (in meters)
  • Capacitance is directly proportional to plate area and dielectric constant, and inversely proportional to plate distance.
  • Vacuum permittivity ( \varepsilon_0 \approx 8.85 \times 10^{-12} , F/m ).
  • Relative permittivity ( \varepsilon_r ) varies by material (vacuum=1, air ~1.0006, ceramic ~5, etc.).
  • Example problems demonstrate how to calculate capacitance by substituting values.
  • Capacitor series and parallel capacitance calculations will be introduced later.
  • Basic concept of energy storage in capacitors will also be covered later.

基本電學第一冊 第五章 5-2 電容量

重點歸納

  • 電容器的電容量與介電係數、極板面積及極板距離有關。
  • 電容量公式：
    $$
    C = \frac{\varepsilon A}{d}
    $$
    其中，
    • ( \varepsilon = \varepsilon_r \times \varepsilon_0 )（介電係數）
    • ( A ) 是極板面積（單位：平方米）
    • ( d ) 是極板間距離（單位：公尺）
  • 電容量與極板面積及介電係數成正比，與極板距離成反比。
  • 真空介電係數 ( \varepsilon_0 \approx 8.85 \times 10^{-12} , F/m )。
  • 相對介電係數 ( \varepsilon_r ) 依材料不同而異（真空=1，空氣約1.0006，陶瓷約5等）。
  • 例題演示如何代入數值計算電容量。
  • 電容器串聯與並聯的電容量計算（後續章節介紹）。
  • 電容器儲能的基本概念（後續章節介紹）。

Atomic Structure

An atom consists of a nucleus containing protons and neutrons, surrounded by electrons in specific orbital layers. The number of protons determines the element.

  • Protons: Positive charge (+)

  • Electrons: Negative charge (-)

原子結構

原子由含有質子和中子的原子核組成，周圍是特定軌道層中的電子。質子的數量決定了元素。

  • 質子：正電荷 (+)
  • 中子：無電荷（中性）
  • 電子：負電荷 (-)

Work and Energy

Work is defined as the energy transferred when a force moves an object through a distance. The formula for work is:

W = F × d × cos(θ)

Where:

  • W = Work (joules, J)
  • F = Force (newtons, N)
  • d = Distance (meters, m)
  • θ = Angle between the force and displacement vectors

功和能量

功被定義為當力使物體移動一段距離時所傳遞的能量。功的公式為：

W = F × d × cos(θ)

其中：

  • W = 功（焦耳，J）
  • F = 力（牛頓，N）
  • d = 距離（米，m）
  • θ = 力和位移向量之間的角度

entry.title: Basic Electricity for High School_DC Transient_RC Circuit DC Transient_7-1.1 Capacitor DC Characteristics
entry.content:
Basic Electricity for High School_DC Transient_RC Circuit DC Transient_7-1.1 Capacitor DC Characteristics

Overview

This article explores the fundamental concepts of DC transient phenomena in electrical circuits, focusing on capacitor characteristics and their behavior during charging and discharging processes in RC circuits.

DC Transient Fundamentals

Definition of DC Transient

DC transient refers to the temporary changes in voltage and current distribution within DC circuits. These changes occur when energy storage components (capacitors and inductors) are subjected to sudden changes in circuit conditions.

Energy Storage Components

In electrical circuits, capacitors and inductors are the primary energy storage components that exhibit transient behavior:

  • Capacitors: Store energy in electric fields
  • Inductors: Store energy in magnetic fields

Transient Phenomenon

During charging and discharging processes, the voltage and current distributions in circuits change over time until they reach a stable state. This time-dependent behavior is the essence of transient analysis.

Chapter Structure and Learning Objectives

Chapter 7: DC Transient Analysis

This chapter focuses on mastering 12 essential formulas that describe the transient behavior of capacitors and inductors in DC networks.

7-1 RC Circuit DC Transient

  • Capacitor charging and discharging phenomena
  • Time constant analysis
  • Voltage and current relationships

7-2 RL Circuit DC Transient

  • Inductor charging and discharging phenomena
  • Time constant analysis
  • Voltage and current relationships

7-3 Mixed RC and RL Circuit DC Transient

  • Complex circuit analysis
  • Combined transient effects
  • Practical applications

Capacitor DC Characteristics

Fundamental Behavior

Capacitors exhibit unique characteristics in DC circuits that differ significantly from their AC behavior:

1. Initial State (t = 0)

  • Voltage: ( v_C(0) = 0 ) (capacitor voltage is zero)
  • Behavior: Acts as a short circuit
  • Current: Maximum current flows through the capacitor
  • Equivalent Circuit: Capacitor appears as a wire

2. Charging Process (0 < t < ∞)

  • Voltage: Gradually increases from 0 to source voltage
  • Current: Gradually decreases from maximum to zero
  • Behavior: Transient state with time-dependent values
  • Equivalent Circuit: Capacitor with time-varying impedance

3. Final State (t = ∞)

  • Voltage: ( v_C(∞) = V_S ) (equals source voltage)
  • Behavior: Acts as an open circuit
  • Current: ( i_C(∞) = 0 ) (no current flows)
  • Equivalent Circuit: Capacitor appears as an open circuit

Three Stages of Capacitor Charging

Stage 1: Instant Power-On (t = 0+)

Characteristics:

  • Capacitor voltage: ( v_C(0^+) = 0 )
  • Capacitor current: ( i_C(0^+) = \frac{V_S}{R} ) (maximum)
  • Circuit behavior: Short circuit
  • Energy state: No stored energy

Physical Explanation:

  • At the instant of power application, the capacitor has no stored charge
  • The capacitor acts as a short circuit, allowing maximum current flow
  • All voltage appears across the series resistance

Stage 2: Charging Process (0 < t < ∞)

Characteristics:

  • Capacitor voltage: ( v_C(t) = V_S(1 - e^{-t/RC}) )
  • Capacitor current: ( i_C(t) = \frac{V_S}{R}e^{-t/RC} )
  • Circuit behavior: Transient state
  • Energy state: Gradually storing energy

Physical Explanation:

  • Charge accumulates on capacitor plates
  • Voltage across capacitor increases exponentially
  • Current decreases exponentially as capacitor charges
  • Time constant ( \tau = RC ) determines charging rate

Stage 3: Charging Complete (t = ∞)

Characteristics:

  • Capacitor voltage: ( v_C(∞) = V_S )
  • Capacitor current: ( i_C(∞) = 0 )
  • Circuit behavior: Open circuit
  • Energy state: Fully charged

Physical Explanation:

  • Capacitor is fully charged to source voltage
  • No more current flows through the capacitor
  • Capacitor acts as an open circuit
  • Maximum energy stored: ( E = \frac{1}{2}CV_S^2 )

Mathematical Analysis

Time Constant

The time constant ( \tau ) is a crucial parameter in transient analysis:

$$ \tau = RC $$

Where:

  • ( R ): Series resistance (ohms)
  • ( C ): Capacitance (farads)
  • ( \tau ): Time constant (seconds)

Charging Equations

Voltage across capacitor:
$$ v_C(t) = V_S(1 - e^{-t/RC}) $$

Current through capacitor:
$$ i_C(t) = \frac{V_S}{R}e^{-t/RC} $$

Charge on capacitor:
$$ q(t) = CV_S(1 - e^{-t/RC}) $$

Discharging Equations

Voltage across capacitor:
$$ v_C(t) = V_0e^{-t/RC} $$

Current through capacitor:
$$ i_C(t) = -\frac{V_0}{R}e^{-t/RC} $$

Practical Applications

1. Power Supply Design

  • Smoothing circuits
  • Filter design
  • Voltage regulation

2. Timing Circuits

  • RC oscillators
  • Delay circuits
  • Pulse generation

3. Energy Storage

  • Backup power systems
  • Energy harvesting
  • Power factor correction

Common Misconceptions

1. Instant Voltage Change

  • Misconception: Capacitor voltage changes instantly
  • Reality: Capacitor voltage changes gradually over time

2. Current Flow After Charging

  • Misconception: Current continues to flow after charging
  • Reality: Current becomes zero when charging is complete

3. Energy Loss

  • Misconception: Energy is lost during charging
  • Reality: Energy is stored in the electric field

Reference Video

Title: 高中基本電學_直流暫態_RC電路的直流暫態_7-1.1 電容器直流特性 - DeltaMOOCx
Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pAi6Hs_dWkc

高中基本電學_直流暫態_RC電路的直流暫態_7-1.1 電容器直流特性

概述

本文探討電路中直流暫態現象的基本概念，重點關注電容器特性及其在 RC 電路充放電過程中的行為。

直流暫態基礎

直流暫態定義

直流暫態是指直流電路中電壓與電流分佈的暫時變化狀態。當儲能元件（電容器和電感器）受到電路條件突然變化時，會發生這些變化。

儲能元件

在電路中，電容器和電感器是表現暫態行為的主要儲能元件：

  • 電容器：在電場中儲存能量
  • 電感器：在磁場中儲存能量

暫態現象

在充放電過程中，電路中的電壓和電流分佈隨時間變化，直到達到穩定狀態。這種時間相關的行為是暫態分析的本質。

章節結構與學習目標

第七章：直流暫態分析

本章重點掌握描述電容器和電感器在直流網路中暫態行為的 12 個重要公式。

7-1 RC電路直流暫態

  • 電容器充放電現象
  • 時間常數分析
  • 電壓與電流關係

7-2 RL電路直流暫態

  • 電感器充放電現象
  • 時間常數分析
  • 電壓與電流關係

7-3 RC與RL混合電路直流暫態

  • 複雜電路分析
  • 組合暫態效應
  • 實際應用

電容器直流特性

基本行為

電容器在直流電路中表現出與交流電路顯著不同的特性：

1. 初始狀態（t = 0）

  • 電壓：( v_C(0) = 0 )（電容器電壓為零）
  • 行為：呈短路狀態
  • 電流：最大電流流過電容器
  • 等效電路：電容器表現為導線

2. 充電過程（0 < t < ∞）

  • 電壓：從 0 逐漸增加到電源電壓
  • 電流：從最大值逐漸減少到零
  • 行為：暫態狀態，具有時間相關值
  • 等效電路：具有時變阻抗的電容器

3. 最終狀態（t = ∞）

  • 電壓：( v_C(∞) = V_S )（等於電源電壓）
  • 行為：呈斷路狀態
  • 電流：( i_C(∞) = 0 )（無電流流動）
  • 等效電路：電容器表現為斷路

電容器充電三階段

第一階段：通電瞬間（t = 0+）

特性：

  • 電容器電壓：( v_C(0^+) = 0 )
  • 電容器電流：( i_C(0^+) = \frac{V_S}{R} )（最大值）
  • 電路行為：短路
  • 能量狀態：無儲存能量

物理解釋：

  • 在通電瞬間，電容器沒有儲存電荷
  • 電容器呈短路狀態，允許最大電流流動
  • 所有電壓出現在串聯電阻上

第二階段：充電過程（0 < t < ∞）

特性：

  • 電容器電壓：( v_C(t) = V_S(1 - e^{-t/RC}) )
  • 電容器電流：( i_C(t) = \frac{V_S}{R}e^{-t/RC} )
  • 電路行為：暫態狀態
  • 能量狀態：逐漸儲存能量

物理解釋：

  • 電荷在電容器極板上累積
  • 電容器兩端電壓呈指數增加
  • 電流隨電容器充電呈指數減少
  • 時間常數 ( \tau = RC ) 決定充電速率

第三階段：充電完成（t = ∞）

特性：

  • 電容器電壓：( v_C(∞) = V_S )
  • 電容器電流：( i_C(∞) = 0 )
  • 電路行為：斷路
  • 能量狀態：完全充電

物理解釋：

  • 電容器完全充電到電源電壓
  • 不再有電流流過電容器
  • 電容器呈斷路狀態
  • 最大儲存能量：( E = \frac{1}{2}CV_S^2 )

數學分析

時間常數

時間常數 ( \tau ) 是暫態分析中的關鍵參數：

$$ \tau = RC $$

其中：

  • ( R )：串聯電阻（歐姆）
  • ( C )：電容（法拉）
  • ( \tau )：時間常數（秒）

充電方程式

電容器兩端電壓：
$$ v_C(t) = V_S(1 - e^{-t/RC}) $$

流過電容器的電流：
$$ i_C(t) = \frac{V_S}{R}e^{-t/RC} $$

電容器上的電荷：
$$ q(t) = CV_S(1 - e^{-t/RC}) $$

放電方程式

電容器兩端電壓：
$$ v_C(t) = V_0e^{-t/RC} $$

流過電容器的電流：
$$ i_C(t) = -\frac{V_0}{R}e^{-t/RC} $$

實際應用

1. 電源設計

  • 平滑電路
  • 濾波器設計
  • 電壓調節

2. 計時電路

  • RC振盪器
  • 延遲電路
  • 脈衝產生

3. 能量儲存

  • 備用電源系統
  • 能量收集
  • 功率因數校正

常見誤解

1. 瞬間電壓變化

  • 誤解：電容器電壓瞬間變化
  • 事實：電容器電壓隨時間逐漸變化

2. 充電後電流流動

  • 誤解：充電後電流繼續流動
  • 事實：充電完成時電流變為零

3. 能量損失

  • 誤解：充電過程中能量損失
  • 事實：能量儲存在電場中

參考影片

標題： 高中基本電學_直流暫態_RC電路的直流暫態_7-1.1 電容器直流特性 - DeltaMOOCx
連結： https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pAi6Hs_dWkc

本文發布日期：2025-08-02

entry.title: Electrical Units and International System
entry.content:
Importance of Numbers and Units

English:

  • A number combined with a unit is the universal language in science, providing objective meaning.
  • For example, height and weight need units for expression.
  • Without units, numbers lose their context and significance.

繁體中文:

  • 數字加上單位是科學界的共通語言，能提供客觀的意義。
  • 例如：身高、體重等都需要單位來表達。
  • 沒有單位，數字就失去了上下文和意義。

International System of Units (SI)

English:

Base Units:

  • Length: Meter (m)
  • Mass: Kilogram (kg)
  • Time: Second (s)
  • Electric current: Ampere (A)
  • Thermodynamic temperature: Kelvin (K)
  • Amount of substance: Mole (mol)
  • Luminous intensity: Candela (cd)

Derived Units:

  • Speed: Meters per second (m/s)
  • Density: Kilograms per cubic meter (kg/m³)
  • Force: Newton (N) = kg·m/s²
  • Energy: Joule (J) = N·m = kg·m²/s²

繁體中文:

基本單位：

  • 長度：公尺 (m)
  • 質量：公斤 (kg)
  • 時間：秒 (s)
  • 電流：安培 (A)
  • 熱力學溫度：克耳文 (K)
  • 物質的量：莫耳 (mol)
  • 發光強度：燭光 (cd)

導出單位：

  • 速度：米每秒 (m/s)
  • 密度：公斤每立方公尺 (kg/m³)
  • 力：牛頓 (N) = kg·m/s²
  • 能量：焦耳 (J) = N·m = kg·m²/s²

Common Electrical Units

English:

Quantity Symbol Unit Symbol Definition
Charge Q Coulomb C A·s
Current I Ampere A C/s
Voltage V Volt V J/C = W/A
Resistance R Ohm Ω V/A
Power P Watt W J/s = V·A
Energy E Joule J W·s = N·m
Capacitance C Farad F C/V
Inductance L Henry H V·s/A

繁體中文:

物理量 符號 單位 符號 定義
電荷 Q 庫倫 C A·s
電流 I 安培 A C/s
電壓 V 伏特 V J/C = W/A
電阻 R 歐姆 Ω V/A
電功率 P 瓦特 W J/s = V·A
電能 E 焦耳 J W·s = N·m
電容 C 法拉 F C/V
電感 L 亨利 H V·s/A

Writing Conventions

English:

  • Use italics for symbols and upright font for units.
  • Example: “The current I = 5 A flows through a resistor of resistance R = 10 Ω.”
  • Leave a space between the number and the unit.
  • Units derived from proper names are capitalized (e.g., Ampere → A), but written in lowercase when spelled out (e.g., ampere).

繁體中文:

  • 符號使用斜體，單位使用正體。
  • 例如：「電流 I = 5 A 流過電阻為 R = 10 Ω 的電阻器。」
  • 數字和單位之間要留有空格。
  • 由人名衍生的單位符號要大寫（例如：安培 → A），但拼寫出來時用小寫（例如：ampere）。

Importance in Electrical Engineering

English:

  • Standardized units allow engineers worldwide to communicate effectively.
  • Prevents costly errors in design and implementation.
  • Enables accurate measurements and comparisons in experiments.
  • Forms the foundation for all electrical calculations and formulas.

繁體中文:

  • 標準化的單位使全球工程師能有效溝通。
  • 防止設計和實施過程中的昂貴錯誤。
  • 使實驗中的測量和比較更加準確。
  • 為所有電學計算和公式奠定基礎。

Reference

For more details, watch the video here.

entry.title: Electronic Components Identification and SMD Soldering Guide
entry.content:
Electronic Components Identification

Resistors

  • Flat components ranging from 603 to 25 sizes
  • Have numbered markings on the surface
  • Used for current limiting and voltage division

Capacitors

  • Two-container appearance for power storage
  • Available in sizes like 603, 0806, 10
  • Gray appearance with no polarity
  • Used for filtering and energy storage

Inductors

  • Large brown square blocks
  • Easy to identify
  • No polarity
  • Used for filtering and energy storage

Diodes

  • Triangular marking on the component
  • Polarity sensitive
  • Used for rectification and protection

Transistors

  • Shiny pins
  • Common types include M-type transistors
  • Three pins marked as SPS
  • First pin connects to voltage and ground
  • Available in both small and large module sizes
  • M-type transistors have paired pins at the bottom

Inductors (Large Type)

  • Very large components
  • Easy to identify by size
  • Smaller inductors available upon request

PCB Software Operation Guide

File Types and Setup

  • Two main file formats: AD and K
  • AD files a、e primarily used for circuit diagrams
  • For AD files, create new white data
  • Navigate through component interface options
  • K files are typically in “New Carving Path”
  • AD files are in “AD Carving Path” or “AD Carving Method”

Operation Steps

  1. File Selection

    • Find file by number (e.g., 119296921)
    • Always select the second option
    • Files are provided and placed in the system

  2. Path Selection

    • Select second option for all paths
    • One for J, one for viewing
    • Terminal also uses second option
    • New items also use second option

  3. Data Selection

    • Click “Select Data” and “Select Forming Data”
    • Mouse cursor changes to four arrows
    • Click HG up to zoom
    • Select blue line around PCB
    • Select inner blue line for holes

  4. Processing

    • Click outside first (no holes)
    • Select fifth option for data offset
    • Outer frame becomes white
    • Click fifth option for fixed posts
    • Becomes two circles
    • Outer frame stores outermost
    • Changes to green
    • Right-click after green
    • Click 1-2-3-4-5, sixth is “Calculate Path”
    • Click after calculation

Panel Types

  • Single-sided panel: larger size
  • Double-sided panel: smaller size
  • Can be distinguished by appearance
  • Single panel has one side
  • Double panel has small features on top

Positioning and Calibration

  1. Use “Add Area” for positioning

    • Click four corners
    • Check upper and lower positions
    • Adjust if board is too large
    • Confirm processing mode

  2. Positioning Process

    • Wait for CDC
    • Auto-move to hole alignment
    • P indicates success
    • NG requires manual adjustment
    • Press C for next step
    • Auto tool change processing mode

  3. Surface Detection

    • Perform surface detection
    • Check carving depth
    • Proceed to line carving
    • Check for obvious lines indicating problems
    • Process takes about 10:30 to complete
    • Larger boards take longer

SMD Soldering Guide (1206 Resistor Example)

Temperature Settings

  • Exhaust fan used above 350-360°C
  • Temperature varies by component
  • Higher temperature (400°C+) for faster soldering
  • Lower temperature for slower, more controlled soldering

Basic Steps

  1. Start with 1206 size (about R6R7 edge size)
  2. Solder melts at high temperature
  3. Use dog bone-shaped soldering tip
  4. Always tin the pad first
  5. Use tweezers to hold component
  6. Align and solder one side first
  7. Solder the other side
  8. Initial solder amount may be more
  9. Ensure component is flat on pad
  10. Remove excess solder if needed

Advanced Techniques

  • Place iron close to pad
  • Hold position when heating
  • Use tweezers to hold component
  • Rotate 90 degrees if needed
  • Add flux if soldering is difficult
  • Flip board if needed
  • Heat and add solder simultaneously
  • Clean iron tip with wet sponge
  • Use small paper cup with water
  • Scrape old solder before adding new

Common Issues and Solutions

  • Excess solder: scrape or add new solder
  • Dull iron tip: replace tip
  • Connected solder: heat and press down
  • Dropped components: use tweezers on both sides
  • Keep sponge moist
  • Clean pad before soldering
  • Check for green frame on PCB
  • Ground connection for 0603 resistors without green frame

Safety and Maintenance

  • Place iron on stand when not in use
  • Don’t place directly on table
  • Clean excess solder gradually
  • Add new solder if needed
  • Replace tip when it loses shine
  • Keep sponge wet
  • Take breaks as needed

電子元件辨識指南

電阻

  • 從 603 到最大的 25 尺寸都很平
  • 零件上面會有編號
  • 用於限流和分壓

電容

  • 外觀像是兩個容器，用於儲存電力
  • 規格有 0603、0806、1206、1210 等
  • 外觀是兩個灰色的樣子
  • 沒有正負極之分
  • 用於濾波和能量儲存

電感

  • 看起來就是一個很大顆的茶色方塊
  • 容易辨識
  • 沒有正負極之分
  • 用於濾波和能量儲存

二極體

  • 在零件上會有三角形的標識
  • 有極性之分
  • 用於整流和保護

電晶體

  • 腳位通常是閃亮的
  • 最常用的是 M 型電晶體
  • 有三個腳位，標示為 SPS
  • 第一個腳位連接電壓和接地
  • 有大尺寸和小尺寸模組
  • M 型電晶體的配對腳位在底部

電感（大尺寸）

  • 超大尺寸元件
  • 容易從大小辨識
  • 小尺寸電感可向工作人員詢問

SMD 焊接指南（以 1206 電阻為例）

溫度設定

  • 抽風機在 350-360°C 以上使用
  • 溫度依零件而定
  • 較高溫度（400°C+）用於快速焊接
  • 較低溫度用於較慢、較控制的焊接

基本步驟

  1. 從 1206 尺寸開始（約 R6R7 邊緣大小）
  2. 焊錫在高溫下融化
  3. 使用狗骨頭狀烙鐵頭
  4. 先在焊盤上上錫
  5. 用鑷子夾住零件
  6. 對準並先焊一邊
  7. 再焊另一邊
  8. 初始焊錫量可能較多
  9. 確保零件平貼在焊盤上
  10. 如有需要去除多餘焊錫

進階技巧

  • 將烙鐵靠近焊盤
  • 加熱時保持位置
  • 用鑷子夾住零件
  • 需要時可旋轉 90 度
  • 焊接困難時可加助焊劑
  • 需要時可翻轉板子
  • 同時加熱和加焊錫
  • 用濕海綿清潔烙鐵頭
  • 使用裝水的小紙杯
  • 加新焊錫前刮除舊焊錫

常見問題和解決方案

  • 焊錫過多：刮除或加新焊錫
  • 烙鐵頭無光澤：更換烙鐵頭
  • 焊錫相連：加熱並下壓
  • 零件掉落：用鑷子從兩側夾住
  • 保持海綿濕潤
  • 焊接前清潔焊盤
  • 檢查 PCB 上的綠色框
  • 沒有綠色框的 0603 電阻可能需要接地

安全和維護

  • 不使用時將烙鐵放在架上
  • 不要直接放在桌上
  • 逐漸清理多餘焊錫
  • 需要時加新焊錫
  • 烙鐵頭失去光澤時更換
  • 保持海綿濕潤
  • 適時休息

entry.title: Examples of Fleming's Right-Hand Rule Practice (Part H) — Electromagnetic Induction and Voltage Calculation
entry.content:
Examples of Fleming’s Right-Hand Rule Practice (Part H) — Electromagnetic Induction and Voltage Calculation

Overview

This article provides detailed examples of applying Fleming’s right-hand rule to solve electromagnetic induction problems, focusing on voltage calculation and polarity determination in various scenarios.

Problem Setup

Given Parameters

  • Magnetic Field Strength: ( B = 0.5 , \text{Tesla} )
  • Conductor Length: ( l = 0.2 , \text{m} )
  • Conductor Velocity: ( v = 100 , \text{m/s} )
  • Objective: Calculate induced voltage magnitude and polarity

Fundamental Formula

The induced electromotive force (emf) is calculated using:

$$ e = B \times l \times v \times \sin \theta $$

Where:

  • ( B ): Magnetic flux density (Tesla)
  • ( l ): Effective conductor length (meters)
  • ( v ): Conductor velocity (m/s)
  • ( \theta ): Angle between conductor motion and magnetic field direction

Example 1: Perpendicular Motion

Scenario

  • Conductor moves perpendicular to magnetic field
  • Angle: ( \theta = 90° )
  • ( \sin 90° = 1 )

Calculation

$$ e = 0.5 \times 0.2 \times 100 \times 1 = 10 , \text{V} $$

Polarity Determination

Using Fleming’s right-hand rule:

  1. Thumb: Direction of conductor motion
  2. Index Finger: Magnetic field direction (North to South)
  3. Middle Finger: Induced current direction

Result: Current flows from ( b ) to ( a ), making ( a ) positive and ( b ) negative.

Example 2: Modified Parameters

Scenario

  • Magnetic field direction: Right to left
  • Conductor velocity: ( v = 200 , \text{m/s} )
  • Conductor moves outward
  • Still perpendicular to magnetic field

Calculation

$$ e = 0.5 \times 0.2 \times 200 \times 1 = 20 , \text{V} $$

Polarity Determination

Result: ( b ) is positive, ( a ) is negative.

Special Case: Parallel Motion

Scenario

  • Conductor moves parallel to magnetic field
  • Angle: ( \theta = 0° )
  • ( \sin 0° = 0 )

Calculation

$$ e = 0.5 \times 0.2 \times 100 \times 0 = 0 , \text{V} $$

Result

  • No induced voltage
  • No polarity exists
  • No current flow

Step-by-Step Problem-Solving Method

1. Identify Given Parameters

  • Extract all numerical values
  • Note units and convert if necessary
  • Identify the angle between motion and field

2. Apply the Formula

  • Substitute values into ( e = B \times l \times v \times \sin \theta )
  • Calculate the sine of the angle
  • Perform the multiplication

3. Determine Polarity

  • Use Fleming’s right-hand rule
  • Point thumb in motion direction
  • Point index finger in magnetic field direction
  • Middle finger shows current direction

4. Verify Results

  • Check units (should be Volts)
  • Ensure polarity makes physical sense
  • Consider the direction of energy flow

Common Calculation Errors

1. Angle Confusion

  • Error: Using wrong angle
  • Solution: Always measure angle between conductor motion and magnetic field

2. Unit Mismatch

  • Error: Mixing different unit systems
  • Solution: Convert all units to SI system before calculation

3. Sign Errors

  • Error: Incorrect polarity determination
  • Solution: Follow Fleming’s right-hand rule systematically

Practical Applications

1. Generator Design

  • Calculate output voltage for given parameters
  • Optimize conductor length and speed
  • Determine magnetic field requirements

2. Electromagnetic Braking

  • Calculate induced voltage in braking systems
  • Determine braking force magnitude
  • Optimize system efficiency

3. Sensor Applications

  • Velocity measurement using electromagnetic induction
  • Position sensing in industrial systems
  • Flow rate measurement in conductive fluids

Reference Video

Title: 佛萊明右手定則範例練習 - 陳政旭老師
Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jREL8L9fqDU

佛萊明右手定則範例練習（Part H）— 電磁感應與電壓計算

概述

本文提供詳細的佛萊明右手定則應用範例，解決電磁感應問題，重點關注各種情況下的電壓計算和極性判斷。

題目設定

已知參數

  • 磁場強度：( B = 0.5 , \text{特斯拉} )
  • 導體長度：( l = 0.2 , \text{公尺} )
  • 導體速度：( v = 100 , \text{公尺/秒} )
  • 目標：計算感應電壓大小與極性

基本公式

感應電動勢（emf）使用以下公式計算：

$$ e = B \times l \times v \times \sin \theta $$

其中：

  • ( B )：磁通密度（特斯拉）
  • ( l )：導體有效長度（公尺）
  • ( v )：導體速度（公尺/秒）
  • ( \theta )：導體運動方向與磁場方向的夾角

範例一：垂直運動

情況

  • 導體垂直切割磁場
  • 夾角：( \theta = 90° )
  • ( \sin 90° = 1 )

計算

$$ e = 0.5 \times 0.2 \times 100 \times 1 = 10 , \text{伏特} $$

極性判斷

使用佛萊明右手定則：

  1. 拇指：導體運動方向
  2. 食指：磁場方向（北極到南極）
  3. 中指：感應電流方向

結果：電流從 ( b ) 流向 ( a )，使 ( a ) 端為正，( b ) 端為負。

範例二：修改參數

情況

  • 磁場方向：從右到左
  • 導體速度：( v = 200 , \text{公尺/秒} )
  • 導體向外移動
  • 仍垂直切割磁場

計算

$$ e = 0.5 \times 0.2 \times 200 \times 1 = 20 , \text{伏特} $$

極性判斷

結果：( b ) 端為正，( a ) 端為負。

特殊情況：平行運動

情況

  • 導體與磁場平行運動
  • 夾角：( \theta = 0° )
  • ( \sin 0° = 0 )

計算

$$ e = 0.5 \times 0.2 \times 100 \times 0 = 0 , \text{伏特} $$

結果

  • 無感應電壓
  • 無極性存在
  • 無電流流動

逐步解題方法

1. 識別已知參數

  • 提取所有數值
  • 注意單位並在必要時轉換
  • 識別運動與磁場的夾角

2. 應用公式

  • 將數值代入 ( e = B \times l \times v \times \sin \theta )
  • 計算角度的正弦值
  • 執行乘法運算

3. 判斷極性

  • 使用佛萊明右手定則
  • 拇指指向運動方向
  • 食指指向磁場方向
  • 中指顯示電流方向

4. 驗證結果

  • 檢查單位（應為伏特）
  • 確保極性符合物理意義
  • 考慮能量流動方向

常見計算錯誤

1. 角度混淆

  • 錯誤：使用錯誤的角度
  • 解決：始終測量導體運動與磁場的夾角

2. 單位不匹配

  • 錯誤：混合不同單位系統
  • 解決：計算前將所有單位轉換為國際單位制

3. 符號錯誤

  • 錯誤：極性判斷錯誤
  • 解決：系統性地遵循佛萊明右手定則

實際應用

1. 發電機設計

  • 計算給定參數的輸出電壓
  • 優化導體長度和速度
  • 確定磁場要求

2. 電磁制動

  • 計算制動系統中的感應電壓
  • 確定制動力大小
  • 優化系統效率

3. 感測器應用

  • 使用電磁感應測量速度
  • 工業系統中的位置感測
  • 導電流體中的流量測量

entry.title: Principle of Induced Electromotive Force in Generators and Fleming's Right-Hand Rule
entry.content:
Principle of Induced Electromotive Force in Generators and Fleming’s Right-Hand Rule

Overview

This article explores the fundamental principles of how generators produce induced electromotive force (emf) and the application of Fleming’s right-hand rule in determining the direction of induced current.

Key Concepts

1. Faraday’s Law of Electromagnetic Induction

Faraday’s law states that a changing magnetic field induces an electromotive force (emf) in a coil. This is the fundamental principle behind electrical generators.

2. Induced EMF by Moving Conductor

When a conductor moves through a fixed magnetic field, it induces an electromotive force given by:

$$ e = B \times l \times v \times \sin \theta $$

Where:

  • (B): Magnetic flux density (Tesla)
  • (l): Effective length of the conductor (meters)
  • (v): Velocity of the conductor (m/s)
  • (\theta): Angle between conductor and magnetic field direction

3. Fleming’s Right-Hand Rule

Fleming’s right-hand rule is used to determine the direction of induced current in generators:

  • Thumb: Direction of conductor motion
  • Index Finger: Direction of magnetic field (North to South)
  • Middle Finger: Direction of induced current

4. Generator vs Motor Rules

It’s crucial to distinguish between the two Fleming’s rules:

  • Right-Hand Rule: Used for generators (mechanical energy → electrical energy)
  • Left-Hand Rule: Used for motors (electrical energy → mechanical energy)

5. Memory Technique

A helpful mnemonic: “Right-Generator” - the Euphrates River sounds like “Right-Generator” to remember that the right-hand rule applies to generators.

Mathematical Analysis

Induced EMF Formula Derivation

The induced emf can be derived from the rate of change of magnetic flux:

$$ e = -\frac{d\Phi}{dt} $$

For a moving conductor:
$$ \Phi = B \times A = B \times l \times x $$
$$ e = -\frac{d(B \times l \times x)}{dt} = -B \times l \times \frac{dx}{dt} = -B \times l \times v $$

Maximum EMF Condition

The maximum induced emf occurs when the conductor moves perpendicular to the magnetic field ((\theta = 90°)):
$$ e_{max} = B \times l \times v $$

Practical Applications

1. AC Generators

  • Rotating coil in magnetic field
  • Sinusoidal voltage output
  • Frequency depends on rotation speed

2. DC Generators

  • Commutator converts AC to DC
  • Used in automotive alternators
  • Industrial power generation

3. Linear Generators

  • Linear motion generates electricity
  • Used in some renewable energy systems
  • Electromagnetic braking systems

Problem-Solving Steps

  1. Identify the System

    • Determine if it’s a generator or motor
    • Choose appropriate hand rule

  2. Apply Fleming’s Right-Hand Rule

    • Point thumb in direction of motion
    • Point index finger in magnetic field direction
    • Middle finger shows current direction

  3. Calculate Induced EMF

    • Use the formula (e = B \times l \times v \times \sin \theta)
    • Consider the angle between motion and field

  4. Analyze the Circuit

    • Determine load resistance
    • Calculate current flow
    • Consider power output

Common Mistakes to Avoid

  1. Confusing Hand Rules

    • Remember: Right for generators, Left for motors
    • Use the mnemonic “Right-Generator”

  2. Incorrect Angle Calculation

    • Ensure (\theta) is the angle between conductor and magnetic field
    • Maximum emf occurs at (\theta = 90°)

  3. Direction Confusion

    • Always use the specified hand rule consistently
    • Double-check finger orientations

Reference Video

Title: 發電機產生應電勢原理、佛萊明右手定則 - 陳政旭老師
Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=example

發電機產生應電勢原理與佛萊明右手定則

概述

本文探討發電機如何產生感應電動勢的基本原理，以及佛萊明右手定則在判斷感應電流方向中的應用。

核心概念

1. 法拉第電磁感應定律

法拉第定律指出，變化的磁場會在線圈中產生感應電動勢（emf）。這是電氣發電機的基本原理。

2. 導體運動產生感應電動勢

當導體在固定磁場中運動時，會產生感應電動勢，公式為：

$$ e = B \times l \times v \times \sin \theta $$

其中：

  • (B)：磁通密度（特斯拉）
  • (l)：導體有效長度（公尺）
  • (v)：導體速度（公尺/秒）
  • (\theta)：導體與磁場方向的夾角

3. 佛萊明右手定則

佛萊明右手定則用於判斷發電機中感應電流的方向：

  • 拇指：導體運動方向
  • 食指：磁場方向（北極到南極）
  • 中指：感應電流方向

4. 發電機與電動機定則區分

區分兩種佛萊明定則非常重要：

  • 右手定則：用於發電機（機械能 → 電能）
  • 左手定則：用於電動機（電能 → 機械能）

5. 記憶技巧

有用的記憶法：「右發」- 幼發拉底河諧音「右發」代表右手定則是發電機定則。

數學分析

感應電動勢公式推導

感應電動勢可以從磁通變化率推導：

$$ e = -\frac{d\Phi}{dt} $$

對於運動導體：
$$ \Phi = B \times A = B \times l \times x $$
$$ e = -\frac{d(B \times l \times x)}{dt} = -B \times l \times \frac{dx}{dt} = -B \times l \times v $$

最大電動勢條件

當導體垂直於磁場運動時（(\theta = 90°)），產生最大感應電動勢：
$$ e_{max} = B \times l \times v $$

實際應用

1. 交流發電機

  • 磁場中旋轉的線圈
  • 正弦波電壓輸出
  • 頻率取決於轉速

2. 直流發電機

  • 換向器將交流轉換為直流
  • 用於汽車發電機
  • 工業發電

3. 線性發電機

  • 線性運動產生電力
  • 用於某些可再生能源系統
  • 電磁制動系統

解題步驟

  1. 識別系統

    • 判斷是發電機還是電動機
    • 選擇適當的手定則

  2. 應用佛萊明右手定則

    • 拇指指向運動方向
    • 食指指向磁場方向
    • 中指顯示電流方向

  3. 計算感應電動勢

    • 使用公式 (e = B \times l \times v \times \sin \theta)
    • 考慮運動與磁場的夾角

  4. 分析電路

    • 確定負載電阻
    • 計算電流流動
    • 考慮功率輸出

常見錯誤避免

  1. 混淆手定則

    • 記住：右手用於發電機，左手用於電動機
    • 使用記憶法「右發」

  2. 角度計算錯誤

    • 確保 (\theta) 是導體與磁場的夾角
    • 最大電動勢出現在 (\theta = 90°)

  3. 方向混淆

    • 始終一致地使用指定的手定則
    • 仔細檢查手指方向

參考影片

標題： 發電機產生應電勢原理、佛萊明右手定則 - 陳政旭老師
連結： https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=example

entry.title: 並聯電容器大小計算與功率因數改善 / Calculation of Parallel Capacitor Size and PF Improvement
entry.content:
English Version

Title

Calculation of Parallel Capacitor Size and Power Factor Improvement

Introduction

  • Scope: Derive required capacitor reactive power for PF correction and convert it to capacitance.
  • Why it matters: Proper capacitor sizing reduces current, losses, and penalties while improving voltage regulation.
  • What you’ll learn: Use PF angles to compute (Q_C) and convert to (C) via frequency and voltage.

Key Points

  • PF improvement by adding a shunt capacitor across an inductive load.
  • Reactive power:
    • Before: ( Q_L = P\tan\theta_1 )
    • After: ( Q_T = P\tan\theta_2 )
    • Capacitor: ( Q_C = Q_L - Q_T = P(\tan\theta_1 - \tan\theta_2) )
  • Capacitance sizing:
    [
    C = \frac{Q_C}{2\pi f V^2}
    ]
    where (f) is frequency, (V) is voltage (RMS), (Q_C) is capacitor reactive power.

Reference

  • YouTube: Auto-translated video

中文版

標題

並聯電容器大小計算與功率因數改善

前言

  • 主題範圍：由功率因數角推得所需電容虛功並換算電容量。
  • 為何重要：適當的電容補償可降低電流與線損、改善電壓調節並避免低 PF 罰款。
  • 你將學到：利用 PF 角計算 (Q_C)，並以頻率與電壓換算為 (C)。

重點統整

  • 改善 PF 方法：在電感性負載兩端並聯電容器。
  • 虛功計算：
    • 改善前 ( Q_L = P\tan\theta_1 )
    • 改善後 ( Q_T = P\tan\theta_2 )
    • 電容 ( Q_C = Q_L - Q_T = P(\tan\theta_1 - \tan\theta_2) )
  • 電容量公式：
    [
    C = \frac{Q_C}{2\pi f V^2}
    ]
    其中 (f) 為頻率、(V) 為電壓（有效值）、(Q_C) 為電容虛功。

參考

entry.title: 交流電功率_功率因數對交流電路的影響範例 / Effect of Power Factor on AC Circuit Power
entry.content:
English Version

Title

Example: Effect of Power Factor on AC Circuit Power

Introduction

  • Scope: Compare apparent power and current under different PF while keeping the same active power.
  • Why it matters: Lower PF increases current and losses; improving PF reduces capacity needs and cost.
  • What you’ll learn: Quick PF-to-current impact using ( S = P/PF ) and ( I = S/V ).

Key Points

  • Source voltage ( V = 100\angle 0^\circ ) V, active power ( P = 1200 ) W.
  • If ( PF = 0.5 ):
    • ( S = 1200/0.5 = 2400 ) VA
    • ( I = 2400/100 = 24 ) A
  • If ( PF = 1 ):
    • ( S = 1200/1 = 1200 ) VA
    • ( I = 1200/100 = 12 ) A
  • Low PF → higher current → more losses and capacity burden.
  • Improving PF → lower (S) and (I) → reduced losses and cost.

Reference

  • YouTube: Effect of Power Factor on AC Circuit

中文版

標題

交流電功率功率因數對交流電路的影響範例

前言

  • 主題範圍：在相同平均功率下，比較不同 PF 對視在功率與電流的影響。
  • 為何重要：PF 低會使電流與損耗增加；改善 PF 可降低容量需求與成本。
  • 你將學到：運用 ( S = P/PF )、( I = S/V ) 快速評估 PF 對電流的影響。

重點統整

  • 電源電壓 ( V = 100\angle 0^\circ ) 伏特，平均功率 ( P = 1200 ) 瓦。
  • 若 ( PF = 0.5 )：
    • ( S = 1200/0.5 = 2400 ) 伏安
    • ( I = 2400/100 = 24 ) 安培
  • 若 ( PF = 1 )：
    • ( S = 1200/1 = 1200 ) 伏安
    • ( I = 1200/100 = 12 ) 安培
  • PF 低 → 電流增大 → 供電負擔與成本上升。
  • 提高 PF → 降低 (S)、(I) → 減少損耗與成本。

entry.title: 串聯電路功率因數 (PF) 與並聯電路功率因數的關係 / Relationship Between PF of Series and Parallel Circuits
entry.content:
English Version

Title

Relationship Between Power Factor (PF) of Series and Parallel Circuits

Introduction

  • Scope: Show closed-form PF formulas for RL series and parallel and their relation.
  • Why it matters: Lets you translate PF between topologies instantly when (R) and (X_L) match.
  • What you’ll learn: Series PF, parallel PF, and identity (PFS^2 + PFP^2 = 1).

Key Points

  • Series PF (PFS):
    [
    PFS = \frac{R}{\sqrt{R^2 + X_L^2}}
    ]
  • Parallel PF (PFP):
    [
    PFP = \frac{X_L}{\sqrt{R^2 + X_L^2}}
    ]
  • If (R) and (X_L) are identical in both circuits:
    [
    PFS^2 + PFP^2 = 1
    ]
  • Example: (R=4,\Omega, X_L=3,\Omega) → (PFS=0.8), (PFP=0.6)

Reference

  • YouTube: PF – Series vs Parallel Relationship

中文版

標題

串聯電路功率因數 (PF) 與並聯電路功率因數的關係

前言

  • 主題範圍：列出 RL 串聯與並聯電路的 PF 閉式公式，並說明相互關係。
  • 為何重要：當 (R)、(X_L) 相同時，可在兩拓撲間快速換算 PF。
  • 你將學到：串聯 PF、並聯 PF 與恆等式 (PFS^2 + PFP^2 = 1)。

重點統整

  • 串聯功率因數：
    [
    PFS = \frac{R}{\sqrt{R^2 + X_L^2}}
    ]
  • 並聯功率因數：
    [
    PFP = \frac{X_L}{\sqrt{R^2 + X_L^2}}
    ]
  • 當兩電路 (R)、(X_L) 相同：
    [
    PFS^2 + PFP^2 = 1
    ]
  • 範例：(R=4,\Omega, X_L=3,\Omega) → (PFS=0.8)、(PFP=0.6)

參考

  • YouTube：@串並聯功率因數關係

entry.title: PCB Manufacturing Process Guide - Detailed Steps
entry.content:
PCB Manufacturing Process Guide

Key Points (English)

  1. Initial Setup

    • Power on the engraving machine (located at the back)
    • Open PCB Prototype software
    • Check file format (AD or PRO)
    • Create new file
    • Select AD engraving area
    • Choose project item from engineering

  2. File Management

    • Two main formats: AD and K
    • AD files for circuit diagrams
    • K files for carving paths
    • File selection by number (e.g., 120220)
    • Path selection (second option)
    • File format: xxx.Protel -GTL

  3. Operation Process

    • Select forming data (4th option from left in top toolbar)
    • Use Page Up (+) to zoom in
    • Use Page End (-) to zoom out
    • Right-click to cancel forming data function
    • Right-click to frame select
    • Left-click to move view
    • Select outer frame (blue line) and inner circles (holes)
    • All selected items turn white

  4. Processing Steps

    • Select forming (5th option from left in top toolbar)
    • Outer frame and inner holes turn into blue circles
    • Outer frame turns green when outermost layer selected
    • Inner holes turn green when innermost layer selected
    • Right-click after green selection
    • Click “Calculate Engraving Logic” (6th option from left)
    • Click “Flip” (7th option from left)
    • Note: Large copper board for single-sided printing
    • Note: Small copper board for double-sided printing

  5. Alignment Process

    • Click “H” (1st option in 2nd row from right)
    • Adjust board position within copper board
    • Right-click for rotation
    • Frame selection turns blue
    • Right-click to rotate
    • Must align within white lines on sides and orange frame at bottom
    • Click “H” again
    • Board alignment: 12.15 on both sides
    • Must have sticker attached

  6. Processing Area Setup

    • Select auto correction engraving area
    • Select processing area (3rd to 6th options in 2nd row from right)
    • Note: Report if area exceeds limits
    • Select auto tool change mode (2nd to last option in 2nd row from right)
    • Set positioning hole drilling
    • Forming tool: 1.4mm
    • Wait for 1 hour

PCB Board Flipping Process

Key Points (English)

  1. Initial Setup

    • Select the 8th option from left in function bar for board flipping
    • Board needs to be flipped accordingly
    • Reapply adhesive tape

  2. CCD Alignment Process

    • Click CCD (last option in first row from right in side toolbar)
    • Use auto-alignment until CCD shows “PASS”
    • Click auto tool change processing mode
    • Select surface detection and carving path
    • Wait for 30 minutes

  3. Drilling Process

    • Use auto tool change mode (second to last option in second row from right)
    • Select “PCB Internal Drilling”
    • Size settings:
      • T1: Depth 2.8mm (standard size)
      • Second drill: 0.4mm (manual change)
      • Place in NO1 = T1
      • Occasionally switches to T2/T3
    • Note: Use simulation tool for holes over 1.5mm
    • Wait for 1 hour

  4. Final Processing

    • Use auto tool change processing mode
    • Select outer frame forming
    • Only change drill bits
    • Auto tool change setting OK
    • Recommended forming tool: 1.4mm

Important Notes

Key Points (English)

  1. Tool Selection

    • Standard depth: 2.8mm
    • Secondary drill: 0.4mm
    • Forming tool: 1.4mm recommended
    • Simulation tool for holes > 1.5mm

  2. Processing Times

    • Surface detection: ~30 minutes
    • Drilling process: ~1 hour
    • Total process time varies by board size

  3. Quality Control

    • Ensure CCD shows “PASS”
    • Check surface detection results
    • Verify drilling depths
    • Monitor outer frame formation

過程一

先開啟雕刻機電源 （在雕刻機後方）

entry.title: 串聯電路功率因數 (PF) 與並聯電路功率因數的關係
entry.content:
English Version

Title

Relationship Between Power Factor (PF) of Series and Parallel Circuits

Introduction

  • Scope: Derive and compare power factor definitions for series RL and parallel RL circuits with the same R and XL.
  • Why it matters: Understanding PF relationships helps convert results between topologies and quickly estimate PF without re-deriving.
  • What you’ll learn: Closed-form PF formulas, the identity (PFS^2 + PFP^2 = 1), and a numerical example.

Key Points

  • Power Factor of Series Circuit (PFS):
    [
    PFS = \frac{R}{\sqrt{R^2 + X_L^2}}
    ]
  • Power Factor of Parallel Circuit (PFP):
    [
    PFP = \frac{X_L}{\sqrt{R^2 + X_L^2}}
    ]
  • If (R) and (X_L) are the same in both circuits:
    [
    PFS^2 + PFP^2 = 1
    ]
  • Example:
    • (R = 4,\Omega, ; X_L = 3,\Omega)
    • Series PF (PFS = 0.8)
    • Parallel PF (PFP = 0.6)

Reference

  • YouTube: High school basic electricity – AC power – Power Factor PART G: Relationship of Series PF and Parallel PF

中文版

標題

串聯電路功率因數 (PF) 與並聯電路功率因數的關係

前言

  • 主題範圍：推導並比較在相同 (R) 與 (X_L) 下，串聯 RL 與並聯 RL 電路的功率因數。
  • 為何重要：理解兩種拓撲之 PF 關係，可在兩者之間快速換算並估算 PF，無需每次重推。
  • 你將學到：PF 的閉式公式、恆等式 (PFS^2 + PFP^2 = 1) 與數值範例。

重點統整

  • 串聯電路功率因數 (PFS)：
    [
    PFS = \frac{R}{\sqrt{R^2 + X_L^2}}
    ]
  • 並聯電路功率因數 (PFP)：
    [
    PFP = \frac{X_L}{\sqrt{R^2 + X_L^2}}
    ]
  • 若兩電路的 (R) 與 (X_L) 相同，則：
    [
    PFS^2 + PFP^2 = 1
    ]
  • 範例：
    • (R = 4,\Omega, ; X_L = 3,\Omega)
    • 串聯功率因數 (PFS = 0.8)
    • 並聯功率因數 (PFP = 0.6)

entry.title: 使用阻抗觀念求功率因數（PF）— R-L 串聯與並聯電路 / Calculating PF Using Impedance — R-L Series & Parallel
entry.content:
English Version

Title

Calculating Power Factor (PF) Using Impedance Concept — R-L Series and Parallel Circuits

Introduction

  • Scope: Derive PF from impedance when phasors are not available, for RL series and parallel.
  • Why it matters: PF can be inferred from circuit parameters for quick estimation and design checks.
  • What you’ll learn: PF via (Z): series PF = (R/|Z|); parallel PF via (|Z|) relation.

Key Points Summary

  • Methods to compute PF:
    • From phase angle (\theta): ( PF = \cos\theta )
    • From powers: ( PF = P/S )
  • Using impedance when (\bar{V}), (\bar{I}) are unavailable.
  • RL series circuit:
    • ( |Z| = \sqrt{R^2 + X_L^2} )
    • ( PF = \dfrac{R}{\sqrt{R^2 + X_L^2}} )
  • RL parallel circuit:
    • From equivalent (|Z|): ( PF = \dfrac{|Z|}{R} )
    • Using the provided relation: ( PF = \dfrac{\sqrt{R^2 + X_L^2}}{X_L} )
  • Series vs. parallel PF differ; see Part G for details.

Reference

  • YouTube: PF via Impedance – RL Series/Parallel

中文版

標題

使用阻抗觀念求功率因數（PF）— R-L 串聯與並聯電路

前言

  • 主題範圍：在無法直接取得相量時，利用阻抗推導 RL 串聯與並聯電路的 PF。
  • 為何重要：可由電路參數快速估算 PF，利於設計與評估。
  • 你將學到：由 (Z) 出發的 PF 公式：串聯 (PF = R/|Z|)，並聯由 (|Z|) 推得。

重點統整

  • PF 計算方式：
    • 由相位角 (\theta)：( PF = \cos\theta )
    • 由功率比：( PF = P/S )
  • 相量不可得時，改用阻抗求 PF。
  • R-L 串聯電路：
    • ( |Z| = \sqrt{R^2 + X_L^2} )
    • ( PF = \dfrac{R}{\sqrt{R^2 + X_L^2}} )
  • R-L 並聯電路：
    • 先求等效 (|Z|)，再得 ( PF = \dfrac{|Z|}{R} )
    • 依提供關係：( PF = \dfrac{\sqrt{R^2 + X_L^2}}{X_L} )
  • 串聯與並聯之 PF 表達不同，詳見 Part G。

參考

  • YouTube：@使用阻抗觀念求 PF（RL 串/並）

日期：2025年08月21日

entry.title: 功率因數改善方法及原理 / Methods and Principles for Power Factor Improvement
entry.content:
English Version

Title

Methods and Principles for Power Factor Improvement

Introduction

  • Scope: Explain why low PF occurs, how it impacts systems, and practical correction methods.
  • Why it matters: PF affects current, losses, voltage regulation, and equipment sizing; utilities may penalize low PF.
  • What you’ll learn: Power triangle concepts (P/Q/S), capacitor compensation, and modern automatic PF controllers.

Key Points

  • Low PF mainly comes from inductive loads (e.g., motors) producing reactive power (Q_L).
  • In the power triangle, active power (P) and reactive power (Q_L) form apparent power (S).
  • Power factor: ( PF = \cos\theta = P/S ). Larger (Q) → larger (\theta) → lower PF.
  • Improvement method: add a shunt capacitor near the inductive load to generate (Q_C) that offsets (Q_L).
  • After compensation: total reactive ( Q_T = Q_L - Q_C ) decreases, (\theta) shrinks, PF rises.
  • Modern solutions often use computerized PF controllers for automatic, stepwise capacitor switching.

Reference

  • YouTube: Power Factor Improvement – Principles and Methods
  • Auto captions: Open with captions

中文版

標題

功率因數改善方法及原理

前言

  • 主題範圍：說明 PF 偏低的原因、對系統的影響，以及常見的改善方法。
  • 為何重要：PF 影響電流大小、線損、電壓調節與設備容量；多數電力公司對低 PF 有費率機制。
  • 你將學到：功率三角形（P/Q/S）、電容補償的原理與實務、自動功率因數控制器的運作概念。

重點統整

  • PF 低多由電感性負載（如馬達）產生虛功率 (Q_L) 所致。
  • 在功率三角形中，平均功率 (P) 與虛功率 (Q_L) 共同構成視在功率 (S)。
  • 功率因數 ( PF = \cos\theta = P/S )；虛功越大，(\theta) 越大，PF 越低。
  • 改善方法：在電感性負載旁並聯電容器產生 (Q_C) 以抵消 (Q_L)。
  • 補償後：總虛功 ( Q_T = Q_L - Q_C ) 降低，功率因數角 (\theta) 變小，PF 提升。
  • 現代作法多採用電腦化功率因數調整器，自動分階投入電容進行補償。

參考

  • YouTube：@功率因數改善
  • 自動字幕：@開啟字幕版本

entry.title: 高中基本電學_交流電功率_功率因數_PART B 各種負載下 θ 與 PF 情形
entry.content:
English Version

Title

High School Basic Electricity – AC Power – Power Factor – PART B: θ and PF under Different Loads

Introduction

  • Scope: Summarize how phase angle θ and power factor PF behave across resistive, inductive, and capacitive loads.
  • Why it matters: Clarifies leading/lagging conventions and how PF relates to circuit topology.
  • What you’ll learn: Phase relations (V leads I or I leads V) and PF extremes in pure R/L/C and series RL/RC.

Key Points Summary

  1. PF angle ((\theta)) and PF definitions.
  2. Inductive circuits: Voltage leads current (mnemonic “VL” in VLSIC).
  3. Capacitive circuits: Current leads voltage (mnemonic “IC” in VLSIC).
  4. Pure resistive load: in-phase, (\theta = 0^\circ), PF = 1.
  5. Pure inductive load: current lags by 90°, (\theta = 90^\circ), PF = 0 (reactive only).
  6. Pure capacitive load: current leads by 90°, (\theta = 90^\circ), PF = 0 (reactive only).
  7. Inductive load (series RL): 0° < (\theta) < 90°, 0 < PF < 1 (lagging).
  8. Capacitive load (series RC): 0° < (\theta) < 90°, 0 < PF < 1 (leading).

Reference

  • YouTube: PF – PART B: θ and PF by Load
  • Auto-caption tip: Use the player’s Settings → Subtitles → Auto-translate to Chinese (Traditional) or English.

中文版

標題

高中基本電學_交流電功率_功率因數_PART B 各種負載下 θ 與 PF 情形

前言

  • 主題範圍：整理純 R/L/C 與 RL/RC 串聯電路中相位角 (\theta) 與功率因數 PF 的行為。
  • 為何重要：釐清超前/滯後的判定與 PF 與電路拓撲的關係。
  • 你將學到：電壓與電流誰超前、純量極限（PF=1、PF=0）、以及 RL/RC 的範圍。

重點統整

  1. 功率因數角（(\theta)）與功率因數（PF）定義。
  2. 電感性電路：電壓超前電流（VLSIC 的 VL 口訣）。
  3. 電容性電路：電流超前電壓（VLSIC 的 IC 口訣）。
  4. 純電阻負載：同相，(\theta = 0^\circ)，PF = 1。
  5. 純電感負載：電流滯後 90°，(\theta = 90^\circ)，PF = 0（僅虛功）。
  6. 純電容負載：電流超前 90°，(\theta = 90^\circ)，PF = 0（僅虛功）。
  7. 電感性負載（R 與 (jX_L) 串聯）：(0^\circ < \theta < 90^\circ)，(0 < PF < 1)，滯後功率因數。
  8. 電容性負載（R 與 (-jX_C) 串聯）：(0^\circ < \theta < 90^\circ)，(0 < PF < 1)，超前功率因數。

參考

  • YouTube：@功率因數_PART B 各種負載 θ 與 PF
  • 自動翻譯：播放器「設定 → 字幕 → 自動翻譯」選擇中文（繁體）或 English。

entry.title: 高中基本電學_交流電功率_功率三角形與複數功率_PART B 複數功率（摘要：0:12–8:14）
entry.content:
English Version

Title

High School Basic Electricity – AC Power – Power Triangle and Complex Power – PART B: Complex Power (Summary: 0:12–8:14)

Introduction

  • Scope: Summarize relationships among P, Q, and S; connect the power triangle to complex power.
  • Why it matters: Complex power clarifies sign conventions and the roles of inductive vs. capacitive loads.
  • What you’ll learn: P–Q–S identities, phase angle interpretation, and the definition ( \bar{S} = \bar{V},\bar{I}^* ).

Key Points Summary

  1. Meaning and Use of the Power Triangle
    • Understand relations between active power (P), reactive power (Q), apparent power (S).
    • Map triangle representation to complex power notation.
  2. P, Q, S Relationships
    • ( P = S\cos\theta )
    • ( Q = S\sin\theta )
    • ( S = \sqrt{P^2 + Q^2} )
  3. Phase Angle (\theta)
    • (\theta) is the voltage–current phase difference.
    • RL (inductive): ( \bar{S} = P + jQ )
    • RC (capacitive): ( \bar{S} = P - jQ )
  4. Definition of Complex Power
    • ( \bar{S} = \bar{V},\bar{I}^* )
    • Conjugation yields correct phase difference (\theta = \theta_V - \theta_I).

Reference

  • YouTube: Power Triangle & Complex Power – PART B

中文版

標題

高中基本電學_交流電功率_功率三角形與複數功率_PART B 複數功率（摘要：0:12–8:14）

前言

  • 主題範圍：整理 P、Q、S 的關係，並將功率三角形連結至複數功率表示。
  • 為何重要：複數功率有助於釐清正負號慣例與電感/電容負載的角色。
  • 你將學到：P–Q–S 恆等式、相位角詮釋，以及 ( \bar{S} = \bar{V},\bar{I}^* ) 的定義。

重點統整

  1. 功率三角形的意義與用途
    • 理解平均功率（P）、虛功率（Q）、視在功率（S）的關係。
    • 可將功率三角形轉為複數功率表示。
  2. P、Q、S 的關係式
    • ( P = S\cos\theta )
    • ( Q = S\sin\theta )
    • ( S = \sqrt{P^2 + Q^2} )
  3. 與電路相位角 (\theta) 的關聯
    • (\theta) 為電壓與電流之相位差。
    • RL 串聯（電感性）：( \bar{S} = P + jQ )
    • RC 串聯（電容性）：( \bar{S} = P - jQ )
  4. 複數功率定義
    • ( \bar{S} = \bar{V},\bar{I}^* )
    • 乘以共軛用以得到正確相位差 (\theta = \theta_V - \theta_I)。

參考

  • YouTube：@功率三角形與複數功率_PART B

日期：2025年08月03日

entry.content:
English Version

Title

High School Basic Electricity – AC Power – Power Triangle and Complex Power – PART C Examples: Complex Power (Three Examples)

Introduction

  • Scope: Demonstrate complex power calculations and forms using three examples.
  • Why it matters: Links power triangle geometry with complex notation and PF angle.
  • What you’ll learn: Rectangular/polar forms of (\bar{S}), extracting P and Q from given quantities.

Key Points Summary

  • Complex power intro: computation and representation in AC circuits.
  • Example 1: Given ( \bar{S} = 1000 \angle 60^\circ ) VA → find (P, Q) via triangle ratios.
  • Example 2: Given ( P = 3000 ) W, ( Q = 4000 ) var (capacitive) → rectangular and polar forms of (\bar{S}).
  • Example 3: Given ( V = 20 - j10 ) V, ( I = 10 + j5 ) A → ( \bar{S} = V I^* ), then extract (P, Q).
  • Power triangle: use similarity to split (S) into (P) and (Q).
  • Representation: rectangular ( P \pm jQ ); inductive ( P + jQ ), capacitive ( P - jQ ).
  • Polar conversion: magnitude = hypotenuse, angle = PF angle (sign per reactive type).

Reference

  • YouTube: PART C – Complex Power (3 Examples)

中文版

標題

高中基本電學_交流電功率_功率三角形與複數功率_PART C 範例：複數功率（三範例）

前言

  • 主題範圍：以三個範例示範複數功率的計算與表示。
  • 為何重要：把功率三角形幾何關係與複數表示及 PF 角連結起來。
  • 你將學到：(\bar{S}) 的直角/極座標形式，如何由既有量求出 (P)、(Q)。

重點統整

  • 複數功率介紹：透過三個範例說明交流電路中複數功率的計算與表示。
  • 範例一：已知 ( \bar{S} = 1000 \angle 60^\circ ) VA，利用功率三角形比例求 (P, Q)。
  • 範例二：已知 ( P = 3000 ) W，( Q = 4000 ) var（電容性），求 (\bar{S}) 的直角與極座標表示。
  • 範例三：給定 ( V = 20 - j10 ) V、( I = 10 + j5 ) A，計算 ( \bar{S} = V I^* )，再求 (P)、(Q)。
  • 功率三角形：用相似三角形比例將 (S) 分解為 (P)、(Q)。
  • 複數功率表示：直角形式 ( P \pm jQ )；電感性 ( P + jQ )，電容性 ( P - jQ )。
  • 極座標轉換：大小為斜邊，角度為功率因數角（正負由電感/電容性別決定）。

entry.title: Power Characteristics of Pure Capacitive AC Circuit
entry.content:
Power Characteristics of Pure Capacitive AC Circuit

This article summarizes the power characteristics of pure capacitive AC circuits, including phase difference, average power, reactive power, and waveform properties.

Key Points Summary (English)

  1. Voltage and current in a pure capacitive AC circuit have a phase difference of -90 degrees, with current leading voltage by 90 degrees.
  2. Average power is zero because positive and negative power waves cancel out; pure capacitors do not consume average power.
  3. Reactive power (Q_c) formulas:
    • (Q_c = VI = I^2 X_c = \frac{V^2}{X_c})
  4. Instantaneous maximum power (P_{max} = VI) and minimum power (P_{min} = -VI)**.
  5. Power frequency is twice the source frequency.
  6. Power waveforms of pure inductors and capacitors differ by 180 degrees, being opposite in phase.
  7. When inductors and capacitors coexist in a circuit, their reactive powers subtract.

純電容交流電路之功率特性

本文整理純電容交流電路的功率特性，包括相位差、平均功率、虛功率與波形特性。

重點歸納（中文）

  1. 純電容交流電路的電壓與電流相位差為 -90度，電流超前電壓90度。
  2. 平均功率為零，因為正負功率波形相互抵銷，純電容不消耗平均功率。
  3. 虛功率 (Q_c) 計算公式：
    • (Q_c = VI = I^2 X_c = \frac{V^2}{X_c})
  4. 瞬間最大功率 (P_{max} = VI)，瞬間最小功率 (P_{min} = -VI)。
  5. 功率頻率為電源頻率的兩倍。
  6. 純電感與純電容功率波形相差180度，互為反向。
  7. 電路中同時有電感與電容時，虛功率做相減運算。

entry.title: Pure Capacitive AC Circuit and Reactive Power
entry.content:
Pure Capacitive AC Circuit and Reactive Power

This article explains the characteristics of pure capacitive AC circuits, the concept of reactive power, and the meaning of the power waveform.

Key Points

  • In a pure capacitive AC circuit, voltage is ( v(t) = V_m \sin(\omega t) ), and current is ( i(t) = I_m \sin(\omega t + 90^\circ) ), with current leading voltage by 90 degrees.
  • Instantaneous power ( p(t) ) is expressed as:
    $$
    p(t) = V I \sin(2 \omega t + 0^\circ)
    $$
  • The power waveform is a symmetrical sine wave, indicating the capacitor charges during the positive half-cycle and releases energy back to the source during the negative half-cycle, resulting in no net power consumption.
  • The average power ( P ) in a pure capacitive circuit is zero; only reactive power ( Q_c ) exists, also called reactive power, measured in vars.
  • Reactive power formulas:
    $$
    Q_c = V_{\text{rms}} \times I_{\text{rms}} = I^2 X_c = \frac{V^2}{X_c}
    $$

純電容交流電路與虛功率

本文說明純電容交流電路的特性、虛功率的概念，以及功率波形的意義。

重點歸納

  • 純電容交流電路中，電壓為 ( v(t) = V_m \sin(\omega t) )，電流為 ( i(t) = I_m \sin(\omega t + 90^\circ) )，電流相位超前電壓90度。
  • 功率瞬時值 ( p(t) ) 可表示為：
    $$
    p(t) = V I \sin(2 \omega t + 0^\circ)
    $$
  • 功率波形為正負對稱的正弦波，表示電容在正半週充電，負半週釋放能量回電源，無實際功率消耗。
  • 純電容電路的平均功率 ( P ) 為零，只有虛功率 ( Q_c )，也稱為無效功率，單位為乏爾（var）。
  • 虛功率計算公式：
    $$
    Q_c = V_{\text{rms}} \times I_{\text{rms}} = I^2 X_c = \frac{V^2}{X_c}
    $$

entry.title: Power Characteristics of Pure Inductive AC Circuit
entry.content:
Power Characteristics of Pure Inductive AC Circuit

This article summarizes the power characteristics of pure inductive AC circuits, including phase difference, average power, reactive power, and waveform properties.

Key Points

  1. Voltage and current phase difference is 90 degrees
    Current lags voltage by 90 degrees.

  2. Average power P is zero
    Because ( \cos 90^\circ = 0 ), there is no average power in a pure inductive circuit.

  3. Reactive power ( Q_L ) formulas
    $$ Q_L = VI = I^2 X_L = \frac{V^2}{X_L} $$

  4. Maximum instantaneous power ( P_{max} )
    $$ P_{max} = VI $$

  5. Minimum instantaneous power ( P_{min} )
    $$ P_{min} = -VI $$

  6. Power frequency is twice the source frequency

純電感交流電路之功率特性

本文整理純電感交流電路的功率特性，包括相位差、平均功率、虛功率與波形特性。

重點歸納

  1. 電壓與電流相位差為90度
    電流落後電壓90度。

  2. 平均功率P為0
    因為功率公式中cos90°=0，純電感電路沒有平均功率。

  3. 虛功率QL計算公式
    $$ Q_L = VI = I^2 X_L = \frac{V^2}{X_L} $$

  4. 最大瞬間功率Pmax
    $$ P_{max} = VI $$

  5. 最小瞬間功率Pmin
    $$ P_{min} = -VI $$

  6. 功率頻率是電源頻率的兩倍

entry.title: Pure Inductive AC Circuit and Reactive Power (Part A)
entry.content:
Pure Inductive AC Circuit and Reactive Power (Part A)

This article explains the characteristics of pure inductive AC circuits, the concept of reactive power, and the meaning of the power waveform.

Key Points

  • Pure Inductive AC Circuit: Current lags voltage by 90 degrees.
  • Instantaneous Power ( p(t) ): Calculated as ( p(t) = VI \sin(2\omega t + 180^\circ) ), a sinusoidal wave symmetric about zero.
  • Power Waveform Meaning:
    • Positive waveform: Inductor stores energy.
    • Negative waveform: Inductor releases energy back to the source.
  • Average Power: No average power consumption in pure inductive circuit; power does not contribute to load.
  • Reactive Power (Q): Represents the inductor’s non-working power, unit is var.
  • Reactive Power Calculation:
    • ( Q_L = VI ) (RMS voltage times RMS current)
    • Or ( Q_L = I^2 X_L )
    • Or ( Q_L = \frac{V^2}{X_L} )

純電感交流電路與虛功率（Part A）

本文說明純電感交流電路的特性、虛功率的概念，以及功率波形的意義。

重點歸納

  • 純電感交流電路：電流滯後電壓90度。
  • 瞬間功率 p(t)：計算後為 ( p(t) = VI \sin(2\omega t + 180^\circ) )，為正負對稱的正弦波。
  • 功率波形意義：
    • 正波形：電感儲存能量。
    • 負波形：電感釋放能量回電源。
  • 平均功率：純電感電路無平均功率消耗，功率對負載無貢獻。
  • 虛功率（Q）：代表電感的無效功率，單位為乏爾（var）。
  • 虛功率計算：
    • ( Q_L = VI )（有效值電壓乘以有效值電流）
    • 或 ( Q_L = I^2 X_L )
    • 或 ( Q_L = \frac{V^2}{X_L} )
