在 NexT 主题中，侧边栏可以显示文章概要和目录，这对于阅读长文章特别有帮助。以下是具体的配置方法：

1. 配置文章概要（Post Outline）

在 _config.next.yml 中找到并修改以下配置：

2. 配置侧边栏位置和宽度

3. 在文章中启用目录

在文章的 Front-matter 中添加：

4. 配置目录样式

5. 配置文章信息显示

使用效果

配置完成后，你的文章页面将会：

  1. 在侧边栏显示文章目录
  2. 目录会自动根据文章标题生成
  3. 可以点击目录直接跳转到对应位置
  4. 当前阅读位置的目录项会高亮显示

注意事项

  1. 确保你的文章使用了正确的 Markdown 标题格式（# ## ###）
  2. 目录只会显示在文章页面
  3. 如果文章没有标题，则不会显示目录
  4. 建议保持标题层级的连续性，不要跳级使用

常见问题

目录不显示？

检查以下几点：

  1. 确认 _config.next.yml 中的 toc.enable 设置为 true
  2. 确认文章 Front-matter 中设置了 toc: true
  3. 确认文章中使用了正确的标题格式

目录显示不全？

  1. 检查 max_depth 设置是否合适
  2. 确认标题层级使用正确
  3. 检查标题格式是否规范

目录不能点击跳转？

  1. 确认主题版本是否最新
  2. 检查是否有 JavaScript 错误
  3. 尝试清除浏览器缓存

进阶配置

自定义目录样式

你可以在 source/_data/styles.styl 中添加自定义样式：

优化目录显示

总结

合理配置文章概要和目录可以大大提升博客的阅读体验。建议根据自己的需求和偏好调整这些设置，找到最适合的配置方案。

如果你在配置过程中遇到任何问题，欢迎在评论区留言交流。

功率三角形與複數功率 Part A：功率三角形

重點歸納

  • 本單元介紹功率三角形與複數功率的基本概念。
  • 以 R-L 串聯電路為例，說明電流 I 作為基準相量，電阻電壓 VR 與電流同相，電感電壓 VL 超前電流 90 度。
  • 電源電壓 V 為 VR 與 VL 的相量和，電流 I 滯後電壓 V 一個角度 θ（0°至90°間）。
  • 將電壓相量乘以電流 I，得到功率三角形，包含平均功率 P（I²R）、虛功率 QL（I²XL）與視在功率 S（VI）。
  • RL 串聯電路的功率三角形與 RC 串聯電路功率三角形的差異在於虛功率方向（正 j 與負 j）。
  • 功率三角形用於表示平均功率、虛功率與視在功率的相位與相量關係。

English Translation

Title: Power Triangle and Complex Power Part A: Power Triangle

Key Points Summary:

  • This unit introduces the basic concepts of the power triangle and complex power.
  • Using an R-L series circuit as an example, the current I is taken as the reference phasor; the resistor voltage VR is in phase with I, and the inductor voltage VL leads I by 90 degrees.
  • The supply voltage V is the phasor sum of VR and VL; the current I lags voltage V by an angle θ (between 0° and 90°).
  • Multiplying the voltage phasors by current I forms the power triangle, including average power P (I²R), reactive power QL (I²XL), and apparent power S (VI).
  • The power triangle of an RL series circuit differs from that of an RC series circuit in the direction of reactive power (positive j vs. negative j).
  • The power triangle represents the phase and phasor relationships among average power, reactive power, and apparent power.

entry.title: Analysis of Transient Current Formula in RL Discharge Circuit
entry.content:
Analysis of Transient Current Formula in RL Discharge Circuit

Overview

This comprehensive article provides a detailed analysis of the transient current formula in RL discharge circuits. We examine the fundamental principles of inductor discharge, the mathematical relationships governing current decay, and the physical interpretation of the time constant in RL circuits.

RL Discharge Circuit Fundamentals

Circuit Configuration

Basic RL Discharge Circuit:

  • Inductor: Stores magnetic energy during charging phase
  • Resistor: Provides discharge path for stored energy
  • Switch: Controls transition from charging to discharging state
  • Power Supply: Provides initial energy for charging (disconnected during discharge)

Switch Operation

Position 1 (Charging State):

  • Circuit State: Power supply connected to inductor
  • Inductor Behavior: Accumulates magnetic energy
  • Current: Builds up to steady-state value
  • Energy Storage: Maximum magnetic energy stored

Position 2 (Discharging State):

  • Circuit State: Power supply disconnected
  • Inductor Behavior: Releases stored magnetic energy
  • Current: Decays exponentially from initial value
  • Energy Transfer: From inductor to resistor

Transient Current Analysis

1. Initial Conditions

When Switch Moves from Position 1 to Position 2:

  • Power Supply: Removed from circuit
  • Inductor Current: Cannot change instantaneously (Lenz’s law)
  • Initial Current: ( i(0) = \frac{E}{R} )
  • Energy Conservation: Magnetic energy maintains current flow

2. Current Decay Characteristics

Exponential Decay Pattern:

  • Initial Value: ( i(0) = \frac{E}{R} ) (100% of steady-state current)
  • Decay Formula: ( i(t) = \frac{E}{R} e^{-\frac{t}{\tau}} )
  • Final Value: ( i(\infty) = 0 ) (complete discharge)
  • Decay Rate: Determined by time constant τ

3. Time Constant Analysis

Mathematical Definition:
$$ \tau = \frac{L}{R} $$

Physical Interpretation:

  • Units: Seconds (s)
  • Meaning: Time for current to decay to 36.8% of initial value
  • Circuit Response: Characterizes discharge rate
  • Energy Dissipation: Controls power transfer rate

Mathematical Derivation

1. Circuit Equation

Kirchhoff’s Voltage Law (KVL):
$$ V_R(t) + V_L(t) = 0 $$

Component Voltages:

  • Resistor Voltage: ( V_R(t) = i(t) \times R )
  • Inductor Voltage: ( V_L(t) = L \frac{di(t)}{dt} )

Differential Equation:
$$ i(t)R + L \frac{di(t)}{dt} = 0 $$

2. Solution Method

Rearranging the Equation:
$$ L \frac{di(t)}{dt} = -i(t)R $$

$$ \frac{di(t)}{i(t)} = -\frac{R}{L} dt $$

Integration:
$$ \int \frac{di(t)}{i(t)} = -\frac{R}{L} \int dt $$

$$ \ln i(t) = -\frac{R}{L} t + C $$

Exponential Form:
$$ i(t) = e^{-\frac{R}{L} t + C} = e^C \cdot e^{-\frac{t}{\tau}} $$

Initial Condition Application:
$$ i(0) = \frac{E}{R} = e^C $$

Final Formula:
$$ i(t) = \frac{E}{R} e^{-\frac{t}{\tau}} $$

Time-Dependent Behavior

Key Time Points

t = 0 (Discharge Start):

  • Current: ( i(0) = \frac{E}{R} ) (100% of initial current)
  • Energy: Maximum magnetic energy stored
  • Power: Maximum power dissipation in resistor

t = τ (One Time Constant):

  • Current: ( i(\tau) = 0.368 \frac{E}{R} ) (36.8% of initial current)
  • Energy: 63.2% of initial energy dissipated
  • Power: Reduced to 13.5% of initial power

t = 2τ (Two Time Constants):

  • Current: ( i(2\tau) = 0.135 \frac{E}{R} ) (13.5% of initial current)
  • Energy: 86.5% of initial energy dissipated
  • Power: Reduced to 1.8% of initial power

t = 3τ (Three Time Constants):

  • Current: ( i(3\tau) = 0.050 \frac{E}{R} ) (5.0% of initial current)
  • Energy: 95.0% of initial energy dissipated
  • Power: Reduced to 0.25% of initial power

t = 5τ (Five Time Constants):

  • Current: ( i(5\tau) \approx 0 ) (effectively zero)
  • Energy: 99.3% of initial energy dissipated
  • Power: Negligible power dissipation

Energy Considerations

1. Initial Magnetic Energy

Stored Energy:
$$ W_L = \frac{1}{2} L i^2(0) = \frac{1}{2} L \left(\frac{E}{R}\right)^2 $$

2. Power Dissipation

Instantaneous Power:
$$ P_R(t) = i^2(t) R = \left(\frac{E}{R}\right)^2 R e^{-\frac{2t}{\tau}} = \frac{E^2}{R} e^{-\frac{2t}{\tau}} $$

3. Total Energy Dissipated

Energy Conservation:
$$ W_{total} = \int_0^{\infty} P_R(t) dt = \frac{1}{2} L \left(\frac{E}{R}\right)^2 $$

Verification:
$$ W_{total} = \frac{E^2}{R} \int_0^{\infty} e^{-\frac{2t}{\tau}} dt = \frac{E^2}{R} \cdot \frac{\tau}{2} = \frac{1}{2} L \left(\frac{E}{R}\right)^2 $$

Circuit Analysis Examples

Example 1: Simple RL Circuit

Given:

  • Inductor: L = 50 mH
  • Resistor: R = 25 Ω
  • Supply Voltage: E = 10 V

Calculate:

  1. Time constant
  2. Initial current
  3. Current at t = 2τ
  4. Time for current to reach 10% of initial value

Solution:
1. Time Constant:
$$ \tau = \frac{L}{R} = \frac{50 \times 10^{-3}}{25} = 2ms $$

2. Initial Current:
$$ i(0) = \frac{E}{R} = \frac{10}{25} = 0.4A $$

3. Current at t = 2τ:
$$ i(2\tau) = 0.4 \cdot e^{-2} = 0.4 \cdot 0.135 = 0.054A $$

4. Time for 10% Current:
$$ 0.1 = e^{-\frac{t}{\tau}} $$
$$ \ln(0.1) = -\frac{t}{\tau} $$
$$ t = -\tau \ln(0.1) = 2 \times 2.303 = 4.61ms $$

Example 2: Complex RL Circuit

Given:

  • Inductor: L = 100 mH
  • R₁ = 20 Ω, R₂ = 30 Ω
  • Supply Voltage: E = 15 V

Calculate:

  1. Effective resistance during discharge
  2. Time constant
  3. Initial current
  4. Current after 5ms

Solution:
1. Effective Resistance:
$$ R_{eff} = R_1 + R_2 = 20 + 30 = 50 \Omega $$

2. Time Constant:
$$ \tau = \frac{L}{R_{eff}} = \frac{100 \times 10^{-3}}{50} = 2ms $$

3. Initial Current:
$$ i(0) = \frac{E}{R_{eff}} = \frac{15}{50} = 0.3A $$

4. Current after 5ms:
$$ t = 5ms = 2.5\tau $$
$$ i(5ms) = 0.3 \cdot e^{-2.5} = 0.3 \cdot 0.082 = 0.025A $$

Comparison with RC Discharge

Time Constant Differences

Aspect RC Circuit RL Circuit
Time Constant ( \tau = RC ) ( \tau = \frac{L}{R} )
Energy Storage Electric field Magnetic field
Discharge Pattern Exponential decay Exponential decay
Initial Condition Voltage across capacitor Current through inductor
Final State Zero voltage, zero current Zero current, zero voltage

Physical Differences

RC Circuit:

  • Energy Storage: Electric field in capacitor
  • Discharge: Current flows from capacitor
  • Voltage: Decays exponentially
  • Current: Decays exponentially

RL Circuit:

  • Energy Storage: Magnetic field in inductor
  • Discharge: Voltage generated by inductor
  • Current: Decays exponentially
  • Voltage: Decays exponentially

Practical Applications

1. Power Electronics

  • DC-DC Converters: Inductor discharge in switching circuits
  • Motor Drives: Field winding discharge
  • Inverters: Energy recovery systems
  • Switching Power Supplies: Energy transfer control

2. Protection Circuits

  • Surge Protection: Inductor energy dissipation
  • Circuit Breakers: Arc suppression
  • Snubber Circuits: Voltage spike protection
  • EMI Filters: Energy absorption

3. Energy Storage Systems

  • Battery Management: Inductor discharge control
  • Supercapacitor Systems: Energy transfer optimization
  • Flywheel Systems: Kinetic energy conversion
  • Magnetic Energy Storage: Discharge rate control

Advanced Analysis

Non-Ideal Components

Real-World Considerations:

  • Inductor Resistance: Internal resistance effects
  • Core Losses: Magnetic hysteresis losses
  • Temperature Effects: Component parameter variations
  • Parasitic Elements: Stray capacitance and resistance

Multiple Time Constants

Complex RL Networks:

  • Series RL: Multiple inductors in series
  • Parallel RL: Multiple inductors in parallel
  • Mixed Configurations: Combination networks
  • Coupled Inductors: Mutual inductance effects

Frequency Domain Analysis

Laplace Transform Method:

  • Transfer Functions: System response analysis
  • Pole-Zero Analysis: Stability considerations
  • Frequency Response: AC behavior analysis
  • Impedance Analysis: Complex frequency domain

Problem-Solving Strategy

1. Circuit Analysis

  • Identify: Circuit topology and components
  • Determine: Switch positions and states
  • Calculate: Time constant for discharge path
  • Apply: Appropriate discharge formulas

2. Formula Application

  • Current: ( i(t) = \frac{E}{R} e^{-\frac{t}{\tau}} )
  • Time Constant: ( \tau = \frac{L}{R} )
  • Time Points: Calculate at specific times
  • Energy: Verify energy conservation

3. Results Validation

  • Units Check: Ensure proper units
  • Physical Reasonableness: Verify results make sense
  • Law Verification: Confirm Kirchhoff’s laws
  • Energy Conservation: Check energy balance

Common Misconceptions

Misconception 1: Instantaneous Current Change

Error: Assuming current changes instantly when switch opens
Correction: Inductor current cannot change instantaneously (Lenz’s law)

Misconception 2: Energy Loss

Error: Thinking energy is lost during discharge
Correction: Energy is conserved, transferred from inductor to resistor

Misconception 3: Linear Decay

Error: Assuming current decays linearly
Correction: Current decays exponentially, not linearly

Misconception 4: Zero Current at t = τ

Error: Thinking current is zero after one time constant
Correction: Current is 36.8% of initial value after one time constant

Reference Video

Title: RL放電電路暫態電流公式解析 - 張偉勤老師
Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bYfIhkWAKfs

RL放電電路暫態電流公式解析

概述

本文提供 RL 放電電路暫態電流公式的詳細分析。我們檢視電感放電的基本原理、支配電流衰減的數學關係，以及 RL 電路中時間常數的物理解釋。

RL 放電電路基礎

電路配置

基本 RL 放電電路：

  • 電感器：充電階段儲存磁能
  • 電阻：為儲存能量提供放電路徑
  • 開關：控制從充電到放電狀態的轉換
  • 電源：為充電提供初始能量（放電期間斷開）

開關操作

位置 1（充電狀態）：

  • 電路狀態：電源連接到電感器
  • 電感行為：累積磁能
  • 電流：建立到穩態值
  • 能量儲存：最大磁能儲存

位置 2（放電狀態）：

  • 電路狀態：電源斷開
  • 電感行為：釋放儲存的磁能
  • 電流：從初始值指數衰減
  • 能量轉移：從電感器到電阻

暫態電流分析

1. 初始條件

當開關從位置 1 移至位置 2 時：

  • 電源：從電路中移除
  • 電感電流：不能瞬間變化（楞次定理）
  • 初始電流：( i(0) = \frac{E}{R} )
  • 能量守恆：磁能維持電流流動

2. 電流衰減特性

指數衰減模式：

  • 初始值：( i(0) = \frac{E}{R} )（穩態電流的 100%）
  • 衰減公式：( i(t) = \frac{E}{R} e^{-\frac{t}{\tau}} )
  • 最終值：( i(\infty) = 0 )（完全放電）
  • 衰減速率：由時間常數 τ 決定

3. 時間常數分析

數學定義：
$$ \tau = \frac{L}{R} $$

物理解釋：

  • 單位：秒（s）
  • 意義：電流衰減到初始值 36.8% 的時間
  • 電路響應：表徵放電速率
  • 能量消耗：控制功率轉移速率

數學推導

1. 電路方程式

基爾霍夫電壓定律（KVL）：
$$ V_R(t) + V_L(t) = 0 $$

元件電壓：

  • 電阻電壓：( V_R(t) = i(t) \times R )
  • 電感電壓：( V_L(t) = L \frac{di(t)}{dt} )

微分方程式：
$$ i(t)R + L \frac{di(t)}{dt} = 0 $$

2. 求解方法

重新排列方程式：
$$ L \frac{di(t)}{dt} = -i(t)R $$

$$ \frac{di(t)}{i(t)} = -\frac{R}{L} dt $$

積分：
$$ \int \frac{di(t)}{i(t)} = -\frac{R}{L} \int dt $$

$$ \ln i(t) = -\frac{R}{L} t + C $$

指數形式：
$$ i(t) = e^{-\frac{R}{L} t + C} = e^C \cdot e^{-\frac{t}{\tau}} $$

初始條件應用：
$$ i(0) = \frac{E}{R} = e^C $$

最終公式：
$$ i(t) = \frac{E}{R} e^{-\frac{t}{\tau}} $$

時間相關行為

關鍵時間點

t = 0（放電開始）：

  • 電流：( i(0) = \frac{E}{R} )（初始電流的 100%）
  • 能量：最大磁能儲存
  • 功率：電阻中最大功率消耗

t = τ（一個時間常數）：

  • 電流：( i(\tau) = 0.368 \frac{E}{R} )（初始電流的 36.8%）
  • 能量：63.2% 的初始能量消耗
  • 功率：減少到初始功率的 13.5%

t = 2τ（兩個時間常數）：

  • 電流：( i(2\tau) = 0.135 \frac{E}{R} )（初始電流的 13.5%）
  • 能量：86.5% 的初始能量消耗
  • 功率：減少到初始功率的 1.8%

t = 3τ（三個時間常數）：

  • 電流：( i(3\tau) = 0.050 \frac{E}{R} )（初始電流的 5.0%）
  • 能量：95.0% 的初始能量消耗
  • 功率：減少到初始功率的 0.25%

t = 5τ（五個時間常數）：

  • 電流：( i(5\tau) \approx 0 )（實質上為零）
  • 能量：99.3% 的初始能量消耗
  • 功率：可忽略的功率消耗

能量考量

1. 初始磁能

儲存能量：
$$ W_L = \frac{1}{2} L i^2(0) = \frac{1}{2} L \left(\frac{E}{R}\right)^2 $$

2. 功率消耗

瞬時功率：
$$ P_R(t) = i^2(t) R = \left(\frac{E}{R}\right)^2 R e^{-\frac{2t}{\tau}} = \frac{E^2}{R} e^{-\frac{2t}{\tau}} $$

3. 總能量消耗

能量守恆：
$$ W_{total} = \int_0^{\infty} P_R(t) dt = \frac{1}{2} L \left(\frac{E}{R}\right)^2 $$

驗證：
$$ W_{total} = \frac{E^2}{R} \int_0^{\infty} e^{-\frac{2t}{\tau}} dt = \frac{E^2}{R} \cdot \frac{\tau}{2} = \frac{1}{2} L \left(\frac{E}{R}\right)^2 $$

電路分析範例

範例一：簡單 RL 電路

給定：

  • 電感器：L = 50 mH
  • 電阻：R = 25 Ω
  • 電源電壓：E = 10 V

計算：

  1. 時間常數
  2. 初始電流
  3. t = 2τ 時的電流
  4. 電流達到初始值 10% 的時間

解答：
1. 時間常數：
$$ \tau = \frac{L}{R} = \frac{50 \times 10^{-3}}{25} = 2ms $$

2. 初始電流：
$$ i(0) = \frac{E}{R} = \frac{10}{25} = 0.4A $$

3. t = 2τ 時的電流：
$$ i(2\tau) = 0.4 \cdot e^{-2} = 0.4 \cdot 0.135 = 0.054A $$

4. 10% 電流的時間：
$$ 0.1 = e^{-\frac{t}{\tau}} $$
$$ \ln(0.1) = -\frac{t}{\tau} $$
$$ t = -\tau \ln(0.1) = 2 \times 2.303 = 4.61ms $$

範例二：複雜 RL 電路

給定：

  • 電感器：L = 100 mH
  • R₁ = 20 Ω, R₂ = 30 Ω
  • 電源電壓：E = 15 V

計算：

  1. 放電期間的有效電阻
  2. 時間常數
  3. 初始電流
  4. 5ms 後的電流

解答：
1. 有效電阻：
$$ R_{eff} = R_1 + R_2 = 20 + 30 = 50 \Omega $$

2. 時間常數：
$$ \tau = \frac{L}{R_{eff}} = \frac{100 \times 10^{-3}}{50} = 2ms $$

3. 初始電流：
$$ i(0) = \frac{E}{R_{eff}} = \frac{15}{50} = 0.3A $$

4. 5ms 後的電流：
$$ t = 5ms = 2.5\tau $$
$$ i(5ms) = 0.3 \cdot e^{-2.5} = 0.3 \cdot 0.082 = 0.025A $$

與 RC 放電比較

時間常數差異

方面 RC 電路 RL 電路
時間常數 ( \tau = RC ) ( \tau = \frac{L}{R} )
能量儲存 電場 磁場
放電模式 指數衰減 指數衰減
初始條件 電容器兩端電壓 電感器中的電流
最終狀態 零電壓，零電流 零電流，零電壓

物理差異

RC 電路：

  • 能量儲存：電容器中的電場
  • 放電：電流從電容器流出
  • 電壓：指數衰減
  • 電流：指數衰減

RL 電路：

  • 能量儲存：電感器中的磁場
  • 放電：電感器產生的電壓
  • 電流：指數衰減
  • 電壓：指數衰減

實際應用

1. 電力電子

  • DC-DC轉換器：開關電路中的電感放電
  • 電機驅動：磁場繞組放電
  • 逆變器：能量回收系統
  • 開關電源：能量轉移控制

2. 保護電路

  • 突波保護：電感能量消耗
  • 斷路器：電弧抑制
  • 緩衝電路：電壓尖峰保護
  • EMI濾波器：能量吸收

3. 能量儲存系統

  • 電池管理：電感放電控制
  • 超級電容器系統：能量轉移優化
  • 飛輪系統：動能轉換
  • 磁能儲存：放電速率控制

進階分析

非理想元件

實際考量：

  • 電感電阻：內部電阻效應
  • 鐵心損耗：磁滯損耗
  • 溫度效應：元件參數變化
  • 寄生元件：雜散電容和電阻

多重時間常數

複雜 RL 網路：

  • 串聯 RL：多個電感器串聯
  • 並聯 RL：多個電感器並聯
  • 混合配置：組合網路
  • 耦合電感：互感效應

頻域分析

拉普拉斯變換方法：

  • 轉移函數：系統響應分析
  • 極零點分析：穩定性考量
  • 頻率響應：交流行為分析
  • 阻抗分析：複數頻域

解題策略

1. 電路分析

  • 識別：電路拓撲和元件
  • 確定：開關位置和狀態
  • 計算：放電路徑的時間常數
  • 應用：適當的放電公式

2. 公式應用

  • 電流：( i(t) = \frac{E}{R} e^{-\frac{t}{\tau}} )
  • 時間常數：( \tau = \frac{L}{R} )
  • 時間點：在特定時間計算
  • 能量：驗證能量守恆

3. 結果驗證

  • 單位檢查：確保正確的單位
  • 物理合理性：驗證結果合理
  • 定律驗證：確認基爾霍夫定律
  • 能量守恆：檢查能量平衡

常見誤解

誤解一：瞬間電流變化

錯誤：假設開關打開時電流瞬間變化
修正：電感電流不能瞬間變化（楞次定理）

誤解二：能量損失

錯誤：認為放電期間能量損失
修正：能量守恆，從電感轉移到電阻

誤解三：線性衰減

錯誤：假設電流線性衰減
修正：電流指數衰減，非線性

誤解四：t = τ 時零電流

錯誤：認為一個時間常數後電流為零
修正：一個時間常數後電流為初始值的 36.8%

參考影片

標題： RL放電電路暫態電流公式解析 - 張偉勤老師
連結： https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bYfIhkWAKfs

entry.title: Example of Instantaneous Power in AC Circuits
entry.content:
Example of Instantaneous Power in AC Circuits

This article analyzes an example of instantaneous power calculation in AC circuits, including waveform equations, RMS values, frequency, and the physical meaning of negative instantaneous power.

Key Points

  • Instantaneous power (p(t)) is the product of voltage (v(t)) and current (i(t)).
  • Voltage and current waveforms:
    [
    v(t) = 10\sqrt{2} \sin(314t) , V
    ]
    [
    i(t) = 2\sqrt{2} \sin(314t - 60^\circ) , A
    ]
  • Instantaneous power formula uses trigonometric product identities:
    [
    p(t) = VI \cos(\theta_v - \theta_i) - VI \cos(\theta_v + \theta_i)
    ]
  • RMS values:
    • Voltage RMS (V = 10,V)
    • Current RMS (I = 2,A)
  • Frequency calculation:
    [
    \omega = 2\pi f_p = 628 \Rightarrow f_p = 100,Hz
    ]
  • Maximum and minimum instantaneous power:
    [
    P_{\max} = 30,W, \quad P_{\min} = -10,W
    ]
  • Negative instantaneous power means the load returns power to the source.

交流電功率瞬間功率範例解析

本文解析交流電路中瞬間功率的計算範例，包含波形方程式、有效值、頻率計算，以及負瞬間功率的物理意義。

重點歸納

  • 瞬間功率 (p(t)) 計算為電壓 (v(t)) 與電流 (i(t)) 的乘積。
  • 電壓與電流波形分別為：
    [
    v(t) = 10\sqrt{2} \sin(314t) \quad \text{伏特}
    ]
    [
    i(t) = 2\sqrt{2} \sin(314t - 60^\circ) \quad \text{安培}
    ]
  • 瞬間功率公式利用三角函數乘積轉換：
    [
    p(t) = VI \cos(\theta_v - \theta_i) - VI \cos(\theta_v + \theta_i)
    ]
  • 有效值計算：
    • 電壓有效值 (V = 10,V)
    • 電流有效值 (I = 2,A)
  • 頻率計算：
    [
    \omega = 2\pi f_p = 628 \Rightarrow f_p = \frac{628}{2\pi} = 100,Hz
    ]
  • 瞬間功率最大值與最小值：
    [
    P_{\max} = 10 + 20 = 30,W
    ]
    [
    P_{\min} = 10 - 20 = -10,W
    ]
  • 負瞬間功率代表負載將功率回饋給電源。

entry.title: Transient Characteristics of RL Circuits and Comparison with Capacitors
entry.content:
Transient Characteristics of RL Circuits and Comparison with Capacitors

This unit mainly explains the DC transient characteristics of RL circuits and compares the behaviors of inductors and capacitors in DC circuits.

Key Summary

Transient Characteristics of Inductors in RL Circuits

An inductor is a component capable of inducing electricity and storing magnetic energy.

  • At the Instant of Power-On: The inductor generates voltage to block current flow. At this moment, it behaves like an open circuit, with maximum voltage across it but no current.
  • During the Charging Process: The magnetic energy inside the inductor gradually accumulates. The induced voltage decreases over time, while the current flowing through it increases over time. The equivalent impedance of the inductor decreases with time.
  • Upon Completion of Charging: The voltage across the inductor drops to 0 volts, and the current flowing through it reaches its maximum value. Its state is similar to a short circuit.

Transient Characteristics of RL Charging Circuits

In an RL charging circuit, when switch S is closed:

  • At the Instant of Closure: The inductor induces a voltage E to oppose current flow, resulting in zero circuit current. The inductor behaves as an open circuit.
  • During the Charging Process: Both the voltage across the inductor VL(t) and the voltage across the resistor VR(t) change with time. The circuit current i(t) also changes with time.
  • Upon Completion of Charging: The inductor is equivalent to a short circuit, with 0 volts across it. The voltage across the resistor equals the DC source E, and the circuit current reaches its maximum value of E/R.

Comparison of DC Characteristics of Inductors and Capacitors

Inductors and capacitors are two components with completely opposite electrical properties.

Characteristic Inductor Capacitor
Instant of Charging Max voltage, no current, equivalent to open circuit 0V voltage, max current, equivalent to short circuit
During Charging Voltage decreases, current increases, equivalent impedance decreases Voltage increases, current decreases, equivalent impedance increases
After Charging 0V voltage, max current, equivalent to short circuit Max voltage, 0A current, equivalent to open circuit

RL電路的直流暫態特性與電感/電容比較

這個單元主要說明了RL電路的直流暫態特性，並比較了電感器與電容器在直流電路中的行為。

重點歸納

電感器在RL電路中的暫態特性

電感器是一種能感應起電並儲存磁能的元件。

  • 剛通電瞬間：電感器會感應生成電壓以阻絕電流流入，此時其狀態類似於斷路，兩端有最大電壓但無電流。
  • 充電過程中：電感器內部的磁能逐漸累積，感應電壓會隨時間減小，而流經的電流則會隨時間增大。此時電感器的等效阻抗會隨時間變小。
  • 充電完畢時：電感器兩端的電壓降至0伏特，流過的最大電流達到最大值，其狀態類似於短路。

RL充電電路暫態特性

在RL充電電路中，當開關S閉合時：

  • 閉合瞬間：電感器會感應電壓E來抑制電流流入，導致電路電流為0安培，電感器呈現斷路狀態。
  • 充電過程中：電感器兩端的電壓VL(t)和電阻器兩端的電壓VR(t)都會隨時間變化，迴路電流i(t)也隨時間變化。
  • 充電完畢時：電感器等效為短路，其兩端電壓為0伏特，電阻器兩端電壓等於直流電源E，迴路電流達到最大值E/R。

電感器與電容器直流特性比較

電感器和電容器在電氣性質上是兩種完全相反的元件。

特性 電感器 電容器
充電瞬間 最大電壓，無電流，等效斷路 0伏特電壓，最大電流，等效短路
充電過程中 電壓減小，電流增大，等效阻抗減小 電壓增大，電流減小，等效阻抗增大
充電完畢時 0伏特電壓，最大電流，等效短路 最大電壓，0安培電流，等效斷路

entry.title: AC Power Reactive Power Part F Examples
entry.content:
AC Power Reactive Power Part F Examples

This article provides comprehensive examples of average power and reactive power calculations in various AC circuits, including pure capacitive, RL series, and parallel RC circuits.

Key Points Summary (English)

  • Example 1: Pure Capacitive Circuit

    • Voltage ( v(t) = 100\sqrt{2} \sin(500t) )
    • Capacitive Reactance ( X_C = 50 \Omega )
    • Reactive Power ( Q_C = \frac{V^2}{X_C} = \frac{100^2}{50} = 200 ) VAR

  • Example 2: RL Series Circuit

    • Voltage ( v(t) = 200\sqrt{2} \sin(377t) )
    • Resistance ( R = 12 \Omega ), Inductive Reactance ( X_L = 16 \Omega )
    • Total Impedance ( Z = 12 + j16 = 20 \angle 53^\circ )
    • Current ( I = \frac{V}{Z} = 10 \angle -53^\circ ) A
    • Average Power ( P = I^2 R = 10^2 \times 12 = 1200 ) W
    • Reactive Power ( Q = I^2 X_L = 10^2 \times 16 = 1600 ) VAR

  • Example 3: Parallel Resistor and Capacitor Circuit

    • Voltage ( V = 40 \angle 0^\circ ) V
    • Resistance ( R = 20 \Omega ), Capacitive Reactance ( X_C = 80 \Omega )
    • Average Power ( P = \frac{V^2}{R} = \frac{40^2}{20} = 80 ) W
    • Reactive Power ( Q = \frac{V^2}{X_C} = \frac{40^2}{80} = 20 ) VAR

高中基本電學_交流電功率_虛功率_PART F 範例：平均功率、虛功率綜合計算

重點歸納（中文）

  • 範例一：純電容電路

    • 電壓 ( v(t) = 100\sqrt{2} \sin(500t) )
    • 電容抗 ( X_C = 50 \Omega )
    • 虛功率 ( Q_C = \frac{100^2}{50} = 200 ) 乏爾

  • 範例二：RL串聯電路

    • 電壓 ( v(t) = 200\sqrt{2} \sin(377t) )
    • 電阻 ( R = 12 \Omega )，電感抗 ( X_L = 16 \Omega )
    • 總阻抗 ( Z = 12 + j16 = 20 \angle 53^\circ )
    • 電流 ( I = \frac{V}{Z} = 10 \angle -53^\circ ) 安培
    • 平均功率 ( P = 10^2 \times 12 = 1200 ) 瓦特
    • 虛功率 ( Q = 10^2 \times 16 = 1600 ) 乏爾

  • 範例三：電阻與電容並聯電路

    • 電壓 ( V = 40 \angle 0^\circ ) 伏特
    • 電阻 ( R = 20 \Omega )，電容抗 ( X_C = 80 \Omega )
    • 平均功率 ( P = \frac{40^2}{20} = 80 ) 瓦特
    • 虛功率 ( Q = \frac{40^2}{80} = 20 ) 乏爾

entry.title: Example Power Factor 10-6 Part C
entry.content:
English Version

Title

Example: Power Factor (10-6 Part C)

Introduction

  • Scope: Solve a PF example given voltage and current phasors; compute θ, PF, S, and P.
  • Why it matters: Reinforces the relationship among phasors, power factor, apparent and active power.
  • What you’ll learn: How to extract the phase angle, determine PF type (lagging/leading), and compute S and P.

Key Points Summary

  1. Hello students, welcome to the Basic Electricity MOOC by Teacher Chen Zhengxu.
  2. In this unit we introduce 10-6 Part C: an example of power factor.
  3. Given phasors: voltage (100\angle 30^\circ), current (10\angle -30^\circ).
  4. Q1: Find the phase angle (\theta) between voltage and current.
  5. Q2: Find the power factor (PF).
  6. Q3: Find apparent power (S).
  7. Q4: Find active power (P).
  8. With 30° (V) and −30° (I), (\theta = 30^\circ - (−30^\circ) = 60^\circ).
  9. 60° indicates current lags voltage by 60° (inductive).
  10. PF = (\cos 60^\circ = 0.5), lagging.
  11. ( S = VI = 100 \times 10 = 1000 ) VA.
  12. ( P = S \times PF = 1000 \times 0.5 = 500 ) W.
  13. Alternatively, ( P = VI\cos\theta ) gives the same 500 W.
  14. Summary: How to obtain (\theta), PF, (S), and (P) from given phasors.

Reference

  • YouTube: Example: Power Factor (10-6 Part C)

中文版

標題

範例功率因數（10-6 Part C）

前言

  • 主題範圍：在已知電壓、電流相量下，依序求相位角 (\theta)、PF、視在功率 S 與有功功率 P。
  • 為何重要：鞏固相量、功率因數、視在功率與平均功率的關聯。
  • 你將學到：如何從相量求出相位角、判定滯後/超前型 PF，並計算 S 與 P。

重點統整

  1. 各位同學好，歡迎收看磨課師基本電學（陳政旭老師）。
  2. 本單元介紹 10-6 Part C：範例功率因數。
  3. 已知相量：電壓 (100\angle 30^\circ)、電流 (10\angle -30^\circ)。
  4. 問題一：求電壓與電流的相位角 (\theta)。
  5. 問題二：功率因數（PF）。
  6. 問題三：視在功率 (S)。
  7. 問題四：有功功率 (P)。
  8. 由 30°（V）與 −30°（I）得 (\theta = 30^\circ - (−30^\circ) = 60^\circ)。
  9. 60° 表示電流滯後電壓 60°，為電感性電路。
  10. PF = (\cos 60^\circ = 0.5)，滯後型。
  11. ( S = VI = 100 \times 10 = 1000 ) 伏安。
  12. ( P = S \times PF = 1000 \times 0.5 = 500 ) 瓦。
  13. 亦可用 ( P = VI\cos\theta ) 計算，結果相同為 500 W。
  14. 小結：由既有相量求得 (\theta)、PF、(S)、(P) 的流程。

參考

  • YouTube：@範例功率因數（10-6 Part C）

日期：2025年08月03日
